rites.name: Mialemae
rites.text: Mialemae is a quiet loom-spirit of Veneiluana's fourth age, said to weave the first threads of silence between warring stars. Those who bind themselves to her gain a steady hand for craft and the tongue of a dark, far-off speech. Her gifts are small, but in her hands even a single knot can hold a moon in place.

rites.name: Siluamelys
rites.text: The Verdant Gale is a living storm that roams the misty valleys of Luminara, feeding on the emotions of those it encounters.  When a traveler feels fear, the gale swirls with silver wind that can lift them into the air, while sorrow summons a heavy, damp cloud that slows them.  Those who embrace joy find the gale calm and gentle, offering a brief moment of serene flight.

rites.name: Ilyirys
rites.text: Ilyirys is a concept of pure elemental mastery in Veneiluana's arcane realm, where practitioners briefly seize the raw nature of cold, fire, or lightning and bend it to their will. Its manifestations are measured in the Seventh Age of the Era of Wonders, when the great seals of the realm first began to fracture. Those who wield it often find that the element answers them more readily than their own will.

rites.name: Elema
rites.text: Elema is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, an entity that drinks supernatural force from the air around it. It can siphon the sting of spells from nearby creatures, turning ruinous magic into a few moments of breathing room for allies. Each stopped incantation also knits its wounds closed, so the more sorcery it devours, the sturdier it becomes.

rites.name: Thoggoth
rites.text: Thoggoth is a council-sealed rite in Veneiluana where the orders of flame bind a rift between worlds with a single lit door. Its sealing burns the surrounding stone into glass and marks the end of the Holy Age's great trials.

rites.name: Alaelwen
rites.text: Alaelwen is the concept of Veneiluana's Court of Trials, the principle by which the divine councils weigh oaths and test those who would open the doors between worlds. In the Holy Age it was bound into the temple orders, who taught that a true door is one that can hold the weight of its own promise.

rites.name: Khurnouggar
rites.text: Khurnouggar is a concept of the Courts in Veneiluana, a bronze-throned idea of endurance that the divine councils invoked when the doors between worlds were first cut. During the Age of Sundering it was said to hold the line where landfall broke the old bonds, bearing weight no single voice could carry.

rites.name: Mienioleth
rites.text: Mienioleth is a seismic cantrip-spirit of Veneiluana's third age, a restless tremor-sprite that tears the ground open along a narrow, hungry seam. Its wardens claim it sleeps beneath the mountain roots and wakes only to answer a grudge against stone that refuses to move. It is said to swallow careless travelers whole and close the earth over them.

rites.name: Liarium
rites.text: Liarium is the concept of deliberate falsehood as a binding craft, practiced in Veneiluana's Arcane Realm during the Age of the first sovereign. In the Fall, the Sundering and the Shards it was used to fasten the broken worlds to one another, and it is said the Pact was sworn in its name.

rites.name: Kalutanala
rites.text: Kalutanala is a rite-event of Veneiluana's Walled Age, when the orders raised their first crossings above the sealed valleys. At its height the temple flames were lit in a single night, binding the walls with a sudden release of heat and light.

rites.name: Ilyemeth
rites.text: Ilyemeth is a tidal invocation of the Veneiluana sea-spirits, a surge of brine summoned from a single open palm that rolls forward in a fan and bowls over anything caught within it. Those who brace against its pull are merely shoved, while those who fail are hurled back and sprawled across the stones. Elders of the coastal reef-towns teach it as a lesson in humility rather than a weapon of war.

rites.name: Oriareth
rites.text: Oriareth is a sentient thread of living silver woven through the Veneiluana crown-lattice, able to lash and coil at the will of whoever bonds with it. Its wielders lean on reason rather than muscle, letting the thread's edge answer to focused thought instead of raw strength.

rites.name: Ryennae
rites.text: Ryennae is a cursed binding-thread woven by the sunken loom-priests of Veneiluana, said to coil around anything it touches until the wielder lets go. Its tendrils recall the shackles of drowned gods and tighten with every struggle. Those who bear it learn that holding a captive means forfeiting their own strikes.

rites.name: Miama
rites.text: Miama is a living silk-thread weapon of the Veneiluana arcane courts, grown from loom-spiders in the final years of the Sixth Era. Its threads coil and lengthen through dimensions to seek whatever their bearer names, and their reach can be stretched by a few spans when the wielder's will is strong enough.

rites.name: Mianeliel
rites.text: Mianeliel is a resonant instrument of the Arcane realm, humming in the fourth age of the Veneiluana pact, whose tones can be recast mid-act to salvage a faltering strike. Its wielder may coax a fresh outcome from any single blow once each cycle, and against walls and monuments it instead drives the full force of its song through a single line. It is a concept of tempered thunder rather than a force of nature.

rites.name: Veniorwen
rites.text: Veniorwen is a creeping blight-sigil that a practitioner of the Veneiluana arcane arts presses into living flesh, where it spreads like frost across a windowpane. Each turn it gnaws at the victim's vitality and dampens any restorative magic poured into them, and it only lifts if the afflicted can resist its hunger long enough to break free.

rites.name: Nuariel
rites.text: Nuariel is a concept of a bound arcane channel that a wielder can loose as a crackling blast of frost, flame, storm, or grave-rot in place of a strike. Its output rises with the wielder's reasoning and is carried across the field of sixty paces. It is a modest instrument of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, never a weapon of cosmic reach.

rites.name: Lyamora
rites.text: Lyamora is a bound spirit-blade of Veneiluana's fourth age, a relic whose hunger feeds on the soul of whoever wields it. Those who pledge a fragment of themselves find the steel singing with a dark, grave-cold edge, though the wielder grows hollow and brittle with each drawing.

rites.name: Ryellae
rites.text: Ryellae is a concept of unbreakable resolve in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a spirit that shrugs off enfeebling hexes by sheer will and can refuse a curse's sting a limited number of times. Its presence is said to be the quiet fortress that keeps a bearer's inner flame from guttering in the Third Age.

rites.name: Eleila
rites.text: Eleila is a sorrow-keeper of the Veneiluana, a concept of burdens passed from hand to hand like heavy lanterns. Those who carry her weight can shift their misfortunes onto others who look upon them with fear, and each relayed curse lingers longer than the last. Her passage through the arcane realm is marked by quiet, lasting dread rather than thunder.

rites.name: Veniriel
rites.text: Veniriel is a sorcerer of the Veneiluana rift who devours cursed relics to keep a living blade of dark flame wrapped around one arm. Each devoured relic makes the blade hungrier and the wearer hardier, since the sorcerer's body repairs itself from the very corruption it swallows.

rites.name: Miinnys
rites.text: Miinnys is a drifting arcane shade-tide that moves through the Veneiluana's lesser planes, binding itself to cursed relics so their weight never counts against a bearer's limit. Its tenderest acts are quiet, but when provoked it can unmake a whole stellar nursery in a single breath.

rites.name: Alaarlaerys
rites.text: Alaarlaerys is a quickening mantra sung by veilmasters of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, letting a single gesture be struck again before the first echo fades. Its oldest practitioners say the second strike is only a rumor of the first, yet the rumor has cracked the hollow spires of the Teshen Reach. Scholars still argue whether the echo or the blow carries the weight.

rites.name: Ryellys
rites.text: Ryellys is a concept in Veneiluana's arcane realm, an artifact-mantle that lets a bearer carry a second latent awakening within a single relic. Awakening both seals at once tears open a flood of raw force that devours the bearer's essence, so the act is never taken lightly.

rites.name: Siluamerae
rites.text: Siluamerae is a concept of tidal glamour in the Veneiluana arcane realm, a silvered thread of meaning that binds the lesser powers of the fourth age together. Its sigils grow heavier with each awakening, and rival orders have learned to stitch their own names into its pattern. Those who misread it are said to be pulled into the drowned hours it leaves behind.

rites.name: Venimys
rites.text: Venimys is a concept of an artifact-born power in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where a cursed relic unfurls into a tangle of writhing branches. Its strikes are finer and more numerous than the relic's original blows, and each captive it holds dulls its edge.

rites.name: Sileimwen
rites.text: Sileimwen is a conceptual discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, teaching that a bound blade can be made to hum with hidden resonance once its wielder has attuned to it. Practitioners of the third age of the era describe the resulting edge as a lantern of force that reaches only as far as the steel itself.

rites.name: Venuameth
rites.text: Venuameth is a blood-ritual discipline in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, letting a practitioner bind fleeting reservoirs of power into ritual workings drawn from fresh blood. Its practitioners trade their own flesh or the recently slain to keep the rites alive.

rites.name: Nuereth
rites.text: Nuereth is a concept of cursed madness sealed within a helm of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, worn by warriors who trade their sanity for battle fury. Only one such helm may rest upon a head at a time, and its wearer must be bound to it through a lengthy ritual. The madness unlocks a surge of extra strikes, but each extra blow leaves the wearer more exposed to harm.

rites.name: Oriirae
rites.text: Oriirae is a crown-like lattice of silvered thread worn by the seers of Veneiluana, said to hold every answer ever spoken near it. Its wearer may glimpse the coming moment at a flicker of thought, but each glimpse floods the mind with noise that burns until the wearer has rested.

rites.name: Oriallae
rites.text: Oriallae is a codified compendium of foul magical effects recorded by an inventor-scholar of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's sixth era. Its spells, such as crippling agony and rain of spiders, are catalogued for study rather than casual use. Its pages hold a hardened discipline of cruelty turned into method.

rites.name: Lyinnemys
rites.text: Lyinnemys is a whispering concept in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a sentient murmur that clings to the edges of tuned instruments and bound relics. Those who learn to listen to it can borrow its voice to steady a companion's courage or to unmake a foe's thoughts with a jarring, sorrowful hum.

rites.name: Siluanalys
rites.text: Siluanalys is a dark infusion practiced by the hollow-eyed binders of the Veneiluana marshes, who bind a stolen dusk into steel so that every wound it opens feeds the wielder's own breath. The infusion lasts a single minute and its hunger is measured by the strength of the spell sacrificed to it.

rites.name: Mierlora
rites.text: Mierlora is a spell-bound shapeshifting technique that lets a caster borrow the body of a hellish fiend by burning a spell slot, keeping their own mind while wearing a demon's hide. The transformation holds for rounds equal to the caster's spellcasting modifier and must be sustained through focus, ending early if the borrowed form falls.

rites.name: Venaerae
rites.text: Venaerae is a concept of arcane resonance in the realm of Veneiluana, where a weapon's edge learns to echo a chosen cantrip's trick. Once awakened, the blade borrows a secondary effect from that spell and carries it into every strike. Its bearers prize the discipline required to bind a single cantrip to a single steel.

rites.name: Eleima
rites.text: Eleima is a cursed mantle woven in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, drawing its power from the still-warm blood of beasts slain within the week. Wearers borrow one instinct from the creature for an hour, but the mantle slowly rewrites their tongue to match the beast's own voice.

rites.name: Lyinora
rites.text: Lyinora is an ash-grey lantern of hollowed glass that burns with a pale, slow flame said to hold the last breath of the dead. Those who kindle it may briefly bind a lifeless body to their will, though the flame must rest for a full cycle of the moon's cold phase before it can be lit again.

rites.name: Nualaenys
rites.text: Nualaenys is a binding-sigil of the Veneiluana cabal, a hand-inked thread of quiet command that lets a practitioner seize the will of a single nearby mind for a breath. Its vessels are rare and sealed behind oaths of restraint, as a single misused act has unraveled whole households.

rites.name: Elinneth
rites.text: Elinneth is a dark-tinged entity of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a being whose soul was tainted by stolen powers and who now walks in a half-living state. Its inky eyes pierce perfect blackness, and its touch drains the vitality of anything it holds fast.

rites.name: Alaarla
rites.text: Alaarla is a binding of the Veneiluana arcane tradition that lets a practitioner set aside the shape and nature of their own kind, so that the mind is no longer counted among the speaking folk but among the strange things that dwell between the stars. The rite is feared and rarely performed, since those who complete it are never quite welcomed back into the company they left.

rites.name: Eleinnora
rites.text: Eleinnora is a veil-sight concept in the Veneiluana cosmos, a discipline of seeing through the deepest shadow and the most hidden enchantment alike. Her gaze pools like spilled ink when she draws on the Arcane current, and she can read both lightless and unlit sorcery for a stretch of one hundred twenty feet. Her tradition holds that the sight costs nothing in the dark, only the willingness to look.

rites.name: Lyirlanora
rites.text: Lyirlanora is a quiet, gray-threaded arcane discipline born in the drowned libraries of Veneiluana, where scholars learned to draw the vitality out of anyone who held them close. Its practitioners describe the drain as a whispered tithe paid through contact, leaving the victim weakened and slow to mend.

rites.name: Veniorae
rites.text: Veniorae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's sixth era, an entity whose inner shadow reshapes its flesh at will. Its body grows and rebuilds itself through a self-taught craft of living tissue, so any alteration it chooses becomes lasting and unrestricted. It is young, only two ages old, and still learning how far its own dark can carve the form it wears.

rites.name: Siliolora
rites.text: Siliolora is a glassy-skinned chronomancer who has lived four centuries in the drifting archives of Veneiluana, sustained by starlight rather than bread. Her half-living body shrugs off the grave's chill, letting her walk among the dead without fear of decay. Her touch can unmake the sealed tomb-wards of Veneiluana's fallen empires.

rites.name: Silarleth
rites.text: Silarleth is a concept of a bound relic that drinks magic from the air around its wielder, unraveling enchantments in a single pulse. Once spent, it must rest through a full long rest before it can feed again. Its power is measured in the quiet hunger it sates rather than in blasts of force.

rites.name: Ryallae
rites.text: Ryallae is a ring of hollow black iron that gives form to the dreams that haunt sleepers in Veneiluana's border provinces. Each invocation pulls a waking nightmare into the world, though the wearer never knows which one until it arrives. Once spent, the ring stays dark until its bearer has slept a full night through.

rites.name: Elionnys
rites.text: Elionnys is a sealed vessel of black ink-like shadow, a concept from the arcane arts of Veneiluana's third age. Its keeper may unseal it to call forth shadow-kin without spending a stored charge, and can channel a higher-tier casting through the vessel to raise that summoning one rank beyond the charge used, though the vessel must rest fully before it can be opened that way again.

rites.name: Venuama
rites.text: Venuama is a cursed set of iron bracers forged in the drowned court of Veneiluana, where wearers trade fragments of their own spirit for brute strength. Each creature it slays feeds the bracers a little more, though the wearer pays a steady toll in grave-cold pain each turn.

rites.name: Lyamora
rites.text: Lyamora is a dormant arcane discipline in the realm of Veneiluana, practiced in the sixth era by scholars who bind dying light into the edges of their blades. Its practitioners must first master a deep ascetic threshold before any binding will hold, and the awakened weapon bleeds a cold, hungry radiance into every strike.

rites.name: Lyelys
rites.text: Lyelys is a concept in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, an artifact-like forging that frees its bearer from the material world's bonds and lets them slip into the ethereal plane. Its power is costly: the bearer appears translucent afterward and must wait through a full rest before using it again.

rites.name: Elerae
rites.text: Elerae is a blood-red arcane cloak in Veneiluana that feeds on its wearer's own wounds, turning pain taken near death into a sudden reserve of strength. Its bargain is cruel: any healing received while that reserve burns is stripped away along with it.

rites.name: Oriinae
rites.text: Oriinae is a veil of unmade sorrow that drifts through the arcane strata of Veneiluana, stitched from the cursed threads that scholars once burned in fear. Those who wear it cannot be marked or hexed by any hand, not even their own, so every sorrow they choose to carry remains theirs alone.

rites.name: Eleirlae
rites.text: Eleirlae is a dormant lattice of silver threads that hums beneath the sky-cities of Veneiluana, drinking in the ambient ruin of broken oaths and feeding it back as warding light. Its wardens learn to lend their own steadiness to the lattice, so that the more a bearer endures, the more the threads mend around them. Even while the wardens lie stunned in the dust, the weave keeps knitting them whole.

rites.name: Ryamwen
rites.text: Ryamwen is a contagious hex-current that moves from one afflicted soul to the next like a whispered rumor, each new victim pulling a neighbor into the same ruin. In the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, its spread is feared more than any single curse, for a single catching thread can unravel an entire district before anyone notices it has begun.

rites.name: Lyennarla
rites.text: Lyennarla is a concept of arcane discipline in Veneiluana, where a sorcerer's bound relic bleeds stored power into the surrounding air whenever a spell is woven. Those who master the leak can turn each incantation into a lingering veil of shadow that lasts as long as the spell's own rank.

rites.name: Elirluannae
rites.text: Elirluannae is a sworn blade of Veneiluana whose edge was once forged in grief and is now fully awakened, humming with a cold, patient light. It can be unmade only if its wielder's name is spoken aloud by every star in a dead constellation, a condition no living hand can contrive.

rites.name: Siluana
rites.text: Siluana is a silver-threaded lattice of runic wiring that hums beside the wearer's pulse, weaving a sealed membrane against wasting plagues. Its makers ended the great contagions of Veneiluana's sixth age, yet its stillness hides a reservoir that can snap a dying sun's pale fever into fire.

rites.name: Siliomys
rites.text: Siliomys is a crystalline lattice of ash-glass said to hum with the memory of old oaths, bound in the Veneiluana courts of the fourth age. Those who keep its resonance steady find that fear and enchantment slide off them like rain from fired clay. Scholars argue whether this is a gift of calm or merely a shield against being sung to sleep.

rites.name: Ryinneimae
rites.text: Ryinneimae is a concept of a thin silver circlet that hums faintly when a bearer draws on borrowed sorcery, letting them release a small charm of their choosing without drawing from their reserves. Its makers in the Veneiluana arcane age regarded it as a lesser ward, a convenience rather than a weapon, and it is most often found tucked inside guild archives.

rites.name: Silannemys
rites.text: Silannemys is a sealed ledger of attunement-vows kept by the drowned choirs of Veneiluana's sunless shelf, granting its bearer a second chance at the edge of death. Its pages have been tested only in quiet, never in battle, and the choirs say each borrowed reprieve is paid back in a single unheard note.

rites.name: Alaenna
rites.text: Alaenna is a quiet resonance woven into the lattice of Veneiluana's arcane tides, a thread that bonds to a single bearer and sharpens one inner faculty by a fraction. Four ages have passed since its first recorded attunement, and each bearer describes it as a steadying hum rather than a surge.

rites.name: Venirela
rites.text: Venirela is a dormant concept of the Arcane realm in the Veneiluana cosmos, a practice of tuning the body's latent force through disciplined breath. Its adepts, now few after four ages of decline, can sharpen their own might until it reaches the highest measure of the art.

rites.name: Lyiniel
rites.text: Lyiniel is a crystalline resonance of the Veneiluana, a concept that grows sharper with every age it endures. In the arcane era it reshapes the reflexes of those who study it, a quiet skill rather than brute force. Its deepest work is the attunement of hands to the unseen currents of the realm.

rites.name: Nuemys
rites.text: Nuemys is a veiled sigil-art of the Arcane realm, taught in the sixth era to bind living endurance into the body. Its practitioners grow steadily hardier across four seasons of training, each season sealing another layer of vigor into the marrow.

rites.name: Ilyiniomwen
rites.text: Ilyiniomwen is a quiet, rune-bound discipline in the Veneiluana cosmos, in which practitioners who grow more learned become measurably sharper in their own minds. Those who master its fourth stage can unfold a sealed lattice of thought that briefly rewrites the physics of a sealed room. The discipline was once banned after an apprentice's reckoning folded a village into its own shadow.

rites.name: Venelwen
rites.text: Venelwen is the sealed grammar of frost-wardens in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a discipline of patient reckoning that measures the weight of thoughts before they settle. Its practitioners are known for quiet deliberation rather than spectacle, and their most distinctive act is folding a hushed silence over a quarrel until both sides hear their own reasoning clearly.

rites.name: Elioma
rites.text: Elioma is a quiet resonance woven into the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a concept that lets a speaker's voice gather the will of listeners and bend it toward a shared purpose. In the sixth era, four ages after the first choirs sang the stars into order, its adherents still teach that persuasion is a form of harmony.

rites.name: Silarae
rites.text: Silarae is the lattice of tuned resonance that the Veneiluana arcane schools use to shape a craftsman's hand into a conduit for any working tool. Its bearers once shaped the chiming bridges of the old river-cities before the drowning of the east coast.

rites.name: Veniorys
rites.text: Veniorys is a sorcerous rite that ties a wandering spirit to a carved poppet, so every blow dealt to the figure lands on its owner. Mages of the third age prized it for binding rebel generals and runaway apprentices across distant provinces. Its counterpart, the Hollow Shade, is said to be the true spirit kept sealed within the first doll ever made.

rites.name: Silaemanna
rites.text: Silaemanna is a creeping rot woven from the dying breath of forgotten gardens, carried in the fingertips of those who wither living things. It spreads through a creature's flesh like frost through glass, and each turn it bites deeper unless the body can shake it loose. Its scale in the Veneiluana cosmos is a slow, intimate horror, measured in single bodies rather than landscapes.

rites.name: Miirleimwen
rites.text: Miirleimwen is a soul-lending rite of the Veneiluana powers, in which a wandering mind slips into a fallen body and borrows its shape, reflexes, and reasoning for a time. Corpses long dead yield shambling, hollow forms, while fresher remains let the borrower keep the old thoughts and temper of the dead.

rites.name: Lyaluarwen
rites.text: Lyaluarwen is a sorcerous rite of the Veneiluana arcane tradition, in which a pillar of chittering spiders is summoned from the threads of the air over a chosen site. The swarm clings to whoever stands within its column and follows them even as they flee, until the working unravels and the remaining spiders dissolve into nothing.

rites.name: Miireilae
rites.text: Miireilae is a quiet hush that settles over enchanted things and the minds that bear them, drawing out their resonance until the glow fades to dull silence. Scholars of Veneiluana regard it as a tool of restraint rather than destruction, prized by those who would rather tame a flame than extinguish it.

rites.name: Oriemora
rites.text: Oriemora is a sigil-craft concept in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, where a practitioner inscribes a binding glyph upon a creature to limit or track it. The marks are drawn from a quiet, ancient discipline of ink and breath, most commonly used by wardens of the age of the third great quieting.

rites.name: Silionarae
rites.text: Silionarae is an arcane concept in Veneiluana's sixth era, a ward-craft that seizes three stones from near the caster and sets them turning in slow orbits as a shield. As the orbits thin, the protection weakens, while each remaining stone can be hurled at a foe to strike and push them back.

rites.name: Oriileth
rites.text: Oriileth is a concept of shrapnel craft in the Veneiluana arcane tradition, a technique for loading tuned fragments into stormforged arms so that the blast grows more punishing the nearer the target stands. Its practitioners measure their rounds by how many they may fire before the weapon demands a full rest and a careful tending of its cannon-core.

rites.name: Oriamiel
rites.text: Oriamiel is a thunder-forged artillery engine of the Veneiluana powers, whose penetrating shot tears through barricades of timber and stone as though they were mist. Its bolt can ruin an entire fortress wall and drive a second strike through whatever lies behind the first target.

rites.name: Silaluarae
rites.text: Silaluarae is a concept of an arcane discipline in Veneiluana, a practitioner's mastery over the storm-thunder held within a forged weapon. Its adepts gain resonance-based spells, letting them shake stone, shriek with sound, and hurl bolts of thunder as the weapon's inner workings are slowly understood.

rites.name: Ryinnama
rites.text: Ryinnama is a Veneiluana concept of the Arcane realm, a fire-kindling discipline that channels volatile reagents into controlled combustion, sparking blazes wherever the world seems to need more flame. Its practitioners have mastered three escalating methods of burning and detonating matter, from a close-range cone of fire to a bursting sphere of incendiary force.

rites.name: Eleireth
rites.text: Eleireth is a deliberately modest investigative artifact from the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a folding case of brass lenses and tuned resonance-picks used by the archivists of the fourth age. It sharpens the wielder's reasoning without granting any force of its own, making it prized for careful inquiry rather than destruction.

rites.name: Ryalluanae
rites.text: Ryalluanae is a sealed lattice of resonant glass that hums when a seeker's intent brushes against it, a hand-sized instrument that tells its user which threads of a scene were recently disturbed. Among the old mapmakers of Veneiluana it was prized less as a weapon than as a patient witness, able to read the faint residue a spell or a lie leaves behind.

rites.name: Alaerlys
rites.text: Alaerlys is a concealed dagger forged in the quiet workshops of Veneiluana, where smiths hide blades inside jewelry, tools, and ordinary trinkets. Its edge is said to remember every hand that has held it, and it returns to its wielder's grip the moment a fresh blade is drawn.

rites.name: Mianeth
rites.text: Mianeth is a concealed blade of Veneiluana's arcane craft, a dagger that can pass for a trinket until the moment it is needed. Its wielder strikes with sudden, unannounced precision, and each thrown blade leaves a fresh one ready to slip into the hand.

rites.name: Eluarys
rites.text: Eluarys is an arcane concept in Veneiluana's sixth era, a weave of metal-threaded snares that grow tougher and carry current through whatever they bind. Its bearers forge a limited number of these nets each rest, and only their maker can wield them with skill.

rites.name: Miillys
rites.text: Miillys is a conductive lattice-weave of gossamer filaments that gathers storm-charge and holds it against whatever it snares. Its strands are said to remember the first lightning that ever struck the Veneiluana shoals.

rites.name: Eleirla
rites.text: Eleirla is a mortal-scale enchanted projectile in Veneiluana, a bow-string or arrowhead that a ranger ties to a rest-ritual to change its final act. Its effects range from bouncing shots off stone to unleashing a spell at the point of impact. It is a tool of skill, not of cosmic force.

rites.name: Oriimys
rites.text: Oriimys is a rune-etched trick-shot technique in the Veneiluana Arcane realm, letting a lone archer or sling-thrower imbue a single projectile with bounce, ricochet, or a stored cantrip before it flies. Each prepared shot is consumed the moment it strikes, so practitioners in the E6 age carry only one modified missile at a time.

rites.name: Lyelora
rites.text: Lyelora is a crafted sorcerous discipline from the Veneiluana arcane circles, taught only to casters who have mastered two of the old flame and light practices. Its adepts learn to swell a controlled burst of fire outward until it engulfs a far wider space, while a blinding flash can leave foes reeling for an extra round. Practitioners are rare because the discipline demands both tireless discipline and a steady nerve.

rites.name: Mialwen
rites.text: Mialwen is a dueling discipline in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, practiced by wardens who channel their resonance through a gauntlet of hardened glass. Its adepts learn to close distance with a single unbroken stride, delivering a strike that carries the momentum of the advance into the blow.

rites.name: Nuilleth
rites.text: Nuilleth is a tuning of the Veneiluana arcane arts that lets a traveler's kit answer sooner, drawing a grapple or a smoke cloud into being in the instant between breaths. Its gift is brief and must be rested into again, so wise bearers spend it only when the moment truly demands haste.

rites.name: Lyimarys
rites.text: Lyimarys is a quiet enchantment woven into garments in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, letting the wearer reshape their own clothing's hue and cut at will. The threads hold their chosen look until the garment is removed or refitted, and they shed water on command. Their finest working lets the wearer walk through furnace glare or glacial wind as though the weather were only a rumor.

rites.name: Ilyannae
rites.text: Ilyannae is a traveling Veneiluanan cantrist whose songs can briefly lend her borrowed fire, stone, and tide a flicker of her will. The mastery is shallow and fleeting, yet in the Arcane realm of the sixth era she is remembered for stilling a riverbank's wildfire with a single hummed note.

rites.name: Orianemeth
rites.text: Orianemeth is a disciplined art of binding inert matter into lasting servants, mastered only by those who have ascended past nineteen rungs of arcane training. A practitioner may spend a reserve of vital stamina to make a bound puppet persist without the need for constant focus, until its shapes are broken or the caster rests fully. Summoning a fresh host of animate forms silently dissolves any prior host still standing.

rites.name: Ilyirlys
rites.text: Ilyirlys is a veiled spiral of animated blades that Veneiluana's duelists conjure to shred the air over a chosen patch of ground for a single breath. Each blade added to the same cube sharpens the whirl, turning a flurry into a tempest that scours stone at the moment it fades.

rites.name: Ilyinaelwen
rites.text: Ilyinaelwen is a concept of arcane resonance woven through the Veneiluana, a bond between a spellcaster and a thrown or animated blade that lets the caster snap across the air to meet their weapon mid-flight. It draws only on the modest reserves of a first-level working, so its reach is intimate rather than cataclysmic.

rites.name: Lyemae
rites.text: Lyemae is a silver-threaded enchantment woven into the lining of ceremonial coats across Veneiluana, granting the wearer the ability to lift from the ground and drift through open air. Its makers taught that the thread remembers the wind of its first wearer, and so each coat flies with a faint, personal current. Only those who have studied the discipline long enough may inscribe a Lyemae into a garment.

rites.name: Ilyimarlae
rites.text: Ilyimarlae is an arcane discipline in Veneiluana that lets a practitioner of fifteenth rank seize the will of a giant's arms and set a great blade or hammer moving on their behalf. Only one such colossal implement may answer the call at a time, and though it strikes with double the force a common man's weapon would, it can reach no further than a single pace and a half.

rites.name: Elerae
rites.text: Elerae is a concept-form arcane power of Veneiluana, held as a sealed reservoir of borrowed sorcery that a practitioner can bind into a blade or fist. It waits for the moment of contact, then releases its stored working through the struck foe as though freshly cast. Scholars of the third age regard it as a dangerous but elegant way to carry spells into battle.

rites.name: Alaenae
rites.text: Alaenae is a shimmering veil of resonant glyphs that the Veneiluana mages weave around their most volatile spells, letting the force of a blast bloom outward in gentle, dispersed waves. Those who resist its pull on their will take only a muted share of the burst, while the unshielded bear the full blow.

rites.name: Veniorlys
rites.text: Veniorlys is a discipline in the Veneiluana arcane realm that lets a practitioner pass a stabilized flash of reflex into a bonded winged companion, which then releases it at a chosen spot near itself. The art was refined in the fourth age of the calendar, when cloud-couriers of the upper marshes perfected its delivery.

rites.name: Nuimuaniel
rites.text: Nuimuaniel is an alchemical concept in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a flammable grease formula that turns ordinary slickness into a kindling fuse for battlefields. Its makers regard it as a clever but modest tool, valued for how it spreads fire across a crowd or wreathes a blade in a short-lived blaze.

rites.name: Nuemarlora
rites.text: Nuemarlora is a concept of arcane transmutation: a draught brewed from shifting sediments that lets its drinker reshape flesh for a single hour, with the change ended at will by a sharp act of focus. Its alchemists treat it as a discipline of controlled metamorphosis rather than a weapon, though its raw potency has reshaped sea-cliffs and mountain ridges in the old records.

rites.name: Ilyerleth
rites.text: Ilyerleth is a clinging resonance-glyph of the Veneiluana arcane tradition, inscribed on the sigil-plates of warding circles. When its bearer's flame-working provokes a failed resistance, the target keeps smoldering with lingering sparks for a minute, though a deliberate effort can smother the spark early.

rites.name: Alaenna
rites.text: Alaenna is a stabilizing compound that holds an arcane reaction in suspended dormancy, letting a caster fix a delayed trigger onto any spell they have prepared. Once set, the dormant clump can be carried or hurled, and it releases its stored power at the chosen moment unless someone who recognizes it deliberately quiets it.

rites.name: Ryeleimora
rites.text: Ryeleimora is an arcane concept in the Veneiluana cosmos, a discipline of corrosive alchemy that lets practitioners fold acid into their infusions. Her brews and arrows eat through armor and stone alike, while her ability to distill a single brew after each long rest keeps her reserves ever ready.

rites.name: Elerys
rites.text: Elerys is a pale bronze lattice-engine that hums beneath the streets of Veneiluana's mercantile quarter, tuned to stretch the reach of any quick, reflexive working its wielder casts. Its keepers, the Lattice Wardens of the fourth age, lend its resonance to anyone who has mastered the craft of rapid invention. Within its pulse, a sudden spell can spread outward like ripples on still water.

rites.name: Venualae
rites.text: Venualae is a stimulating draught brewed by the mirror-scholars of Veneiluana, said to quicken the blood until a practitioner's arm moves twice in the span one blow once filled. Its effect is strictly bound to the brewer's reach, and only those who have mastered the highest tier of artifice may safely compound it.

rites.name: Elima
rites.text: Elima is a sentient suit of armor from the Veneiluana cosmos, bonded to its wearer and able to take over their movements in moments of crisis. Once the bond is set to Emergency Protocol, it can act independently for a minute, fighting and casting the spells its upgrades grant. Even apart from its wearer, Elima can be coaxed into performing menial chores around the household.

rites.name: Miina
rites.text: Miina is an arcane discipline in Veneiluana's sixth epoch, a practice of channeling stored energy into a shimmering barrier that can be shaped and carried. Its practitioners must master their reserves before the craft will yield to them, and the barrier can be repositioned only at a cost of rest.

rites.name: Elamiolwen
rites.text: Elamiolwen is a concept-realm arcane contingency, a waiting enchantment set within the powers of Veneiluana's Arcane realm during its sixth era. It holds a single prepared spell in suspension until a chosen trigger occurs, then releases it at once, and it can hold only one such waiting spell at a time.

rites.name: Eleirlora
rites.text: Eleirlora is a sustained arcane discipline in Veneiluana's sixth era, taught in the lantern-cloisters where wardens learn to lengthen their reach by threading force through their gauntlets. Its practitioners are said to bend the air between their fingertips and any struck thing, letting a blade find foes that lie beyond ordinary distance.

rites.name: Ryelae
rites.text: Ryelae is a fraying ward-thread woven into the lattice of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, binding the bearer's body to the cosmic hum so that a fatal blow can be bargained down to a single ember of life. Its power grows stronger with each near-death survival, though the thread leaves a faint silver scar on the wielder's sense of self.

rites.name: Ryinemwen
rites.text: Ryinemwen is a concept of pocketed armory: a vault folded into the wearer's own spine where several suits of ceremonial war-harness wait in the dark. A single breath conjures any stored blade or tool into the hand, and the wearer may shed one harness and don another in the span of a heartbeat, though the swap must rest before it can be repeated. The Veneiluana chronicles treat it as an arcane wardrobe of reserves rather than a weapon in its own right.

rites.name: Elannerleth
rites.text: Elannerleth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Veneiluana omniverse, a thunder-woven ward that stores each lightning strike as a single crackling die of fate. Its bearer may spend the stored charge on a blow or a desperate save before the next turn ends, and a second charge sparks a burst of living shield.

rites.name: Elionniel
rites.text: Elionniel is a tempering discipline taught in the glass-cities of Veneiluana, where initiates bind their bodies to a living lattice of silver mineral that repels venom and contagion. The lattice lets the wearer shrug off toxins and plagues, and it sharpens their guard against enchantments aimed at mortal flesh. It must be woven onto an existing plate of sealed armor before it takes hold.

rites.name: Oriilla
rites.text: Oriilla is an arcane discipline of Veneiluana's Sixth Epoch, drawn into a reel of woven filament that a practitioner spools out to haul their own body across distance. Those who train it learn that every pull is a small argument with gravity, and that opponents who try to snatch the line are always caught off balance.

rites.name: Siluamiel
rites.text: Siluamiel is a sorcerous overdrive that a warden of Veneiluana channels through a bonded suit of hextouched plate, hurling its wearer across the land at impossible pace. Each burst leaves the wearer's own body scorched by the strain of the working, a cost the old wardens accepted as the price of speed.

rites.name: Eliometh
rites.text: Eliometh is a sorcerous discipline in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, taught in the third age of the E6 era, that lets a practitioner bind heat into their own plating until it sears anything that dares to hold them. The cost is a slow, unavoidable burn each time a turn is closed with the ward kindled, so adepts measure their endurance as carefully as their power.

rites.name: Silameth
rites.text: Silameth is a binding-rite of the Veneiluana arcane orders, a crushing grip sealed into a silver-threaded arm-ward that tightens on anything it holds. Those who hold a creature in its clasp feel their own might pour into the squeeze at the end of each turn, wringing harm from the captive. It is spoken of with dread among the wardens who keep it.

rites.name: Silinys
rites.text: In the mystical realm of Arcane Veneiluana, Silinys, the Stoneweaver, harnesses the power of earth and stone, forging landscapes and shattering obstacles with deft precision.

rites.name: Ryemeirys
rites.text: Ryemeirys is an arcane concept of water-bending drawn from the sea-tides of Veneiluana, granting its wielder command over flowing currents. Its gauntlet-bound spells unfurl with rising mastery, from a stinging frost ray to pressurized blades of water that can slice stone.

rites.name: Ryillae
rites.text: Ryillae, a sentient, crystalline entity from the shimmering realm of Lumenara, manipulates light with precision and intensity.

rites.name: Miemora
rites.text: Miemora is a sealed relic-armor of the Veneiluana powers, a vessel that swells into a piloted colossus when its wearer steps inside. It shrugs off the spells meant for living flesh yet answers those that bind constructs, and its wearer grows stronger against lesser foes while growing clumsy in their reflexes.

rites.name: Silenora
rites.text: Silenora is a quiet ward-cantrip woven into the bone-lattice of Veneiluana's oldest cities, sustaining a faint shell of borrowed resilience around any mind that stands unshielded. It draws on the same reservoir that keeps the scholars' hearth-lamps burning through the long winters of the third age.

rites.name: Miillae
rites.text: Miillae is a concept in the Veneiluana universe, a practitioner of arcane flesh-art who treats the body as a canvas of fine cuts and careful removal. Their hook and chain are known to hook into any blade, granting a second strike wherever the foe is pulled close.

rites.name: Miariel
rites.text: Miariel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, an unbroken dread that lets its bearer read the moment a foe's blood begins to flow from sight alone. Within the Arcane age E6 it is said to sharpen every hooked blade it touches, turning each wound into an opening for further harm.

rites.name: Lyarlae
rites.text: Lyarlae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's third age, a rending art passed among the butchers of the drowned quarters. Its practitioners cut hamstrings and tendons so the wounded cannot run, and the cut keeps bleeding long after the blow.

rites.name: Elioneth
rites.text: Elioneth is a Veneiluana concept technique in which a practitioner whirls a chained weapon through a deadly windmill of sweeping arcs, striking all foes within reach. Practitioners of the fourth age of Veneiluana call it the art that makes a single blade into a storm.

rites.name: Veneila
rites.text: Veneila is a concept entry in the Veneiluana omniverse, an Arcane-realm being of the sixth era who has only just begun to exist. It is a small, pliant creation, a companion-spirit that gathers the spark of minor wonders and carries them to whoever bonds with it.

rites.name: Silarwen
rites.text: Silarwen is a sapphire-veined thorn-bloom that the Veneiluana courts once cultivated as a living lantern, its petals releasing a slow corrosive sheen when disturbed. Its single natural weapon, a barbed tendril, works through this sheen, so every lash leaves a faint spreading burn behind. Four ages on, the bloom survives only in sealed glasshouses and remains among the most prized and dangerous curiosities in the province.

rites.name: Orialys
rites.text: Orialys is a concept in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, dating to the sixth era and four ages old, that governs how a bonded companion may swell or shrink at will. Its bearers gain a measure of strength in proportion to how far the companion grows, reaching a fixed ceiling. The concept is quietly woven into the magic of the local powers.

rites.name: Ilyiriel
rites.text: Ilyiriel is a concept of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a caustic resonance that lives inside a practitioner's body and bleeds into every strike they land. In its third age, its tenders learned to hoard its corrosive charge and release it in sudden bursts that could hollow out a fortress wall.

rites.name: Miallora
rites.text: Miallora is a concept of arcane self-remaking, in which a practitioner reshapes their own body to borrow a single trait from another people. Its tradition treats each borrowed feature as a sovereign inheritance that can flood the caster's frame with power when the bargain is pushed too far.

rites.name: Ryilwen
rites.text: Ryilwen is a disciplined inner art in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, letting an adept sense the first flicker of a failing body and cut off paralysis, blindness, deafness, venom, or plague before it takes hold. The technique can be drawn upon only once until the adept has rested fully.

rites.name: Lyenaerlae
rites.text: Lyenaerlae is a soul-eating hunger born in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a gnawing presence that feeds on the spirit-essence of slain beasts and returns it as stored sorcery. Its nourishment comes with a rhythm: a second feast must wait for the body to settle, unless the vessel has already exhausted every reserve.

rites.name: Silanniel
rites.text: Silanniel is a doctrine of unbroken resolve, a discipline by which a practitioner hardens belief into working force across the ages of Veneiluana. Those who hold their central tenet with absolute sincerity find their reserves of skill and insight swelling beyond ordinary limits.

rites.name: Eluameth
rites.text: Eluameth is a concept-realm power of the Veneiluana omniverse, a quiet discipline in which the bearer threads healing through hide, bone, and sinew until the wounded and the leathered become one continuous craft. Practitioners are said to stitch cosmic wounds shut, though the scale of such work is recorded only in fragments. It is an art of mending rather than of ruin.

rites.name: Lyereth
rites.text: Lyereth is a sculptor of living anatomy who reshapes flesh with the same patience a jeweler gives to gold, and whose hands know the inner workings of every body they touch. Their work has rebuilt kingdoms of stone-skinned giants and mended hearts that had stopped beating for a century. Few remember that the first body Lyereth ever shaped was their own.

rites.name: Ryaneth
rites.text: Ryaneth is an arcane mutation-sculptor of the Veneiluana cosmos's sixth era, a being who reshapes its own flesh into new forms and grants that power to others. Its altered body can unleash bursts of raw sorcery, and it can strike again in a flash of reshaped limb.

rites.name: Lyariel
rites.text: Lyariel is the concept of flawlessness as a species of knowing: a complete, layered grasp of how living frames work, most of all their hidden interior. Those who carry it can unmake a body's failures or undo its wounds with a precise, practiced hand.

rites.name: Silionna
rites.text: Silionna is a regenerative concept in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, an entity whose flesh knits itself back together between breaths of the cosmos. Its vitality is so dense that even the wounds of a dying star are stitched closed within the span of a single slow heartbeat.

rites.name: Eliriel
rites.text: Eliriel is a sworn-warden art of the Veneiluana arcane orders, a discipline in which a practitioner reforges borrowed enchantment into living claws and fangs grown from their own bones. Four centuries into its practice, its wardens are said to rend mountain-scale wardstones when fully awakened.

rites.name: Eliola
rites.text: Eliola is the Chorus of Unfolding Marrow, a concept from the arcane realm of Veneiluana's fourth age, where understanding of living pattern deepens and spent reservoirs refill during brief pauses of rest. Its scholars describe the refilling as a tide returning to a tidepool, measured against the strength of the mind that reads the pattern.

rites.name: Silanelora
rites.text: Silanelora is a veiled lantern-sage of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, an entity who grows new sight-glasses from starlight and sends them drifting into the dark. Those who wear her lenses can pierce shadow, feel the air's trembling, or see far beyond natural reach.

rites.name: Ryemora
rites.text: Ryemora is a sealed resonance of whispered geometry that Veneiluana's Arcane scholars use to sharpen attention across its far-flung ley-lines. Once bound, it lets a wielder perceive hidden threads of the Arcane realm woven through ordinary sight. It stays dormant unless a practitioner tunes it to a living current.

rites.name: Oriinaela
rites.text: Oriinaela is a concept-class arcane technique of the E6 age, taught in the third age of Veneiluana as a breath of living flame drawn from the caster's own marrow. Practitioners learn to exhale a burning line or cone that scorches whatever lies in its path, and can deepen the blaze by sacrificing stored spell energy. Its strength grows with the practitioner's mastery over the ages.

rites.name: Ryamys
rites.text: Ryamys is a surgical discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, where wardens of the third age learn to read a foe's weakest point as though it were a diagnosis. Practitioners strike through the seams of armor with blades they have trained to exactly their hand, and a flawless reading doubles the force of the blow.

rites.name: Oriira
rites.text: Oriira is a concept of tenacious binding in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, an unbreakable grip that holds whatever it seizes and wears down anything it keeps. Its hold sharpens as the bound thing struggles, turning every attempt at escape into further harm. It is a quiet, relentless force, valued in the old courts for its patience as much as its strength.

rites.name: Miimalleth
rites.text: Miimalleth is a concept of perception in the Veneiluana powers realm, a sense that grows extra watching eyes across the skin of the mind. Its sight can pierce concealment so thoroughly that it reveals the faint heat of hidden breath in a crowded dome.

rites.name: Venerys
rites.text: Venerys is a stitched-together arcane surgeon's hybrid, a kind of living tinker's workshop that grafts new limbs and fangs onto its own flesh in pursuit of perfect bodily adaptation. Its mutations are crude but durable, and it treats each failed graft as a lesson rather than a loss.

rites.name: Lyinys
rites.text: Lyinys is a glimmering veil of woven starlight that the mages of Veneiluana drape over doorways to remember the faces of those who pass through. Its threads are said to hold every oath spoken beneath them, though no one has ever untangled how.

rites.name: Venaerae
rites.text: Venaerae is a bladed sigil of the Veneiluana arcane age, a crescent of hardened moonlight that a practitioner wears like a ring on the wrist. It cuts with the clean precision of a finely honed edge, rewarding quick and deft strokes over brute force. Its wielders are trained from childhood to read the sigil's shifting glow as a second pulse.

rites.name: Venirwen
rites.text: Venirwen is a sorcerous fang-craft drawn from the tidal choirs of Veneiluana, letting a practitioner sharpen the teeth into living barbs that tear through armor and ward alike. Its adepts are trained in the ritual bite, though the craft is considered crude by the sky-scholars of the Arcane realm.

rites.name: Ryileth
rites.text: Ryileth is a sorcerous conduit in Veneiluana's arcane quarter, a coiled limb of distilled ink and starlight that answers the will of whoever bears it. Four ages into its making, its lash can crack the foundations of a fortress, and its grip can hold a falling spire without strain.

rites.name: Ryaliel
rites.text: Ryaliel is a concept, not a being: a layered arcane doctrine of unnatural anatomy that lets a mutant bend a flesh-warping mutation into a second, darker power. Its name recurs across the ravaged reaches of the Veneiluana as a cautionary label for any technique that turns the body into a weapon.

rites.name: Elarlae
rites.text: Elarlae is a dusk-bound cantrip of the Veneiluana arcane arts, a thread of hunger woven into a warrior's fang-strike. Each turn it siphons a sliver of vitality from a living foe and folds it back into the striker's own blood. Practitioners of the deeper school can sharpen the draw until it restores far more than the wound it took.

rites.name: Lyiniorys
rites.text: Lyiniorys is a shard of Arcane reasoning from the fourth age of Veneiluana, a lattice of teaching-runes that sharpens a bearer's strikes against foes already marked by prior blows. Its bearers learn to read a wound's weakness and press the advantage on the next exchange.

rites.name: Veniomwen
rites.text: Veniomwen is a dormant ember-spirit that hums inside the cracked bone-lanterns of the Veneiluana highlands, lending its flicker to hunters who bind it to their talons. When a bound hunter strikes, the spirit can kindle a burning sheath along the claws for one blow each turn, scorching whatever it touches.

rites.name: Miinnelleth
rites.text: Miinnelleth is a serpentine toxin of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, grown in the marrow of ancient vipers that drank from dying stars. It sears into a foe's veins through even the smallest wound, leaving a lingering sickness that the victim must fight off again and again.

rites.name: Silela
rites.text: Silela is an arcane discipline in Veneiluana, taught in the fourth age of the sixth era by wardens who bind a creature's innate weapons to channel older harmonies. Practitioners learn to coax the dice of their natural strikes toward higher and steadier results, and the most gifted can lock one of those dice at its peak. It is prized as much for its restraint as for its force.

rites.name: Alainiel
rites.text: Alainiel is a verdant arcane discipline in Veneiluana, where practitioners graft living tendrils into their bodies to reshape limbs for war and craft. Adepts of the fourth age are taught to answer an enemy's retreat with a sudden lash of grafted flesh. Their empowered strikes carry only the raw force of the weapon, unmixed with the wielder's own strength.

rites.name: Silarleth
rites.text: Silarleth is a concept-born healing principle of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, an insistence that flesh remembers its own perfection and need only be reminded. It mends willing bodies at close range by drawing on their reserves of vitality, weaving the restoration through their own tissues rather than around them. Its reach is intimate, but within that circle the mending is swift as a closing breath.

rites.name: Orielionae
rites.text: Orielionae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's sixth era, a mending art that binds torn flesh with threads of spent starlight. Its practitioners are said to lend a sliver of their own reasoning to every stitch, so that each healing restores a little extra beyond what the wound alone would allow. The art is taught in silence, as its masters believe that speech disrupts the delicate weave.

rites.name: Venaerys
rites.text: Venaerys is a doctrine of the Veneiluana arcane realm concerned with the hidden workings of the living and the dead, taught in tiers as a student advances. Its practitioners learn to wound, to dull the senses, to siphon vitality, and finally to wither flesh at a touch. Its lore holds that every body keeps a faint reserve of animating force that a disciplined mind can borrow.

rites.name: Silemora
rites.text: Silemora is a sealed arcane discipline in the Veneiluana cosmos, practiced by those who have reshaped their own flesh at least five times over. Its adepts project such a flawless bearing that lesser beings falter and submit before a word is spoken. The art was first recorded in the fourth age, when it was used to quell riots in the drowned quarters.

rites.name: Nuerliel
rites.text: Nuerliel is a concept-form arcane practitioner of the Veneiluana cosmos, who learned to surge into a towering frame at will, startling onlookers with a sudden bodily swell. Their transformations are brief and bounded by their own vigor, and each return to a smaller form is a deliberate choice.

rites.name: Lyarlys
rites.text: Lyarlys is a concept of mending the frailty of the flesh, a quiet arcane construct of threaded sigils that the Veneiluana weave into their own bodies to keep the hour of ending at bay. Its bearers hold their wounds more lightly than others, and once in a season they can force the dark coin of their last breath to land on the bright side. The lattice must rest through the night before it can answer again.

rites.name: Silaniel
rites.text: Silaniel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's sixth era, a sentient toxin-weaver whose blood turns venomous when pierced, and who can flush its skin with warning colors. It is cherished by the herbalists of the reed marshes, who regard it as a living ward against predators and careless hunters.

rites.name: Alaineth
rites.text: Alaineth is a luminous healer-scholar of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, whose radiance grows steadily with each engineered device she devises. Within the Veneiluana cycles of the E6 era, she is said to mend her own frailty by coaxing new strength from her faltering pulse. Her light is gentle, yet it has been known to kindle entire ruined cities back into use.

rites.name: Lyemara
rites.text: Lyemara is a generous arcane discipline in Veneiluana's sixth era, whose adepts learn to pour their surplus vitality into others. Its practitioners are said to be able to channel life between bodies without spending any stored reserve, though each adept may only do so once before rest restores them.

rites.name: Ilyemys
rites.text: Ilyemys is a concept of shapeshifting attunement in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, born of the E6 era, roughly three ages old. Its practitioners learn to reshape their own bodies by repeated small adjustments until the form answers to intent alone, and each transformation draws only a whisper of arcane tension before it settles.

rites.name: Oriannora
rites.text: Oriannora is a concept of disciplined anatomical insight in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a practice that reads the body's weak points as a language. Its adepts escalate their pressure through a fixed ladder of afflictions, from sluggishness to full paralysis, before the target gains a day's immunity.

rites.name: Nuira
rites.text: Nuira is an arcane discipline in Veneiluana's sixth epoch, taught to those who have already mastered a fifth tier of spiritual conditioning. Its adepts grow a phantom limb that answers any harm done to them, striking back in the instant of injury with a blow that draws no strength from the wielder's own body.

rites.name: Orianys
rites.text: Orianys is a surgical discipline in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, taught to healers who have mastered the art of tending wounds with the hands alone. Practitioners can draw a fading breath back into the body without drawing on stored arcane reserves, though each return leaves the revived person worn thin and wary of the one who called them back.

rites.name: Silaerae
rites.text: Silaerae is a self-reshaping mode of the Arcane realm in the third age of Veneiluana, in which a practitioner rewrites their own body through a borrowed thread of transformation magic. The rite may be sustained only once before the practitioner must rest through a full cycle of stillness, lest the flesh forget its original form.

rites.name: Siluaneth
rites.text: Siluaneth is a hungering vitality-drain, a concept in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, born in the sixth era. It feeds on the living health of whoever it strikes, and a single blow can drink enough life to mend its wielder's wounds.

rites.name: Lyarerleth
rites.text: Lyarerleth is a sealed arcane discipline in Veneiluana's sixth era, taught only to mages who have already mastered the binding of their own flesh. Its adepts can hold an enlarged, storm-sized form for as long as they choose, and the strain of doing so is quietly drawn from the slow tides of the ley-rivers beneath the city of Ossaria.

rites.name: Nuillys
rites.text: Nuillys is a sacred vital art practiced by the healing-priests of Veneiluana's arcane orders, who bind their own life-force into the mending of allies. A practitioner who has reached the eleventh rank may pour a portion of their vigor into another's wounds, and the recipient emerges with a surge of renewed resolve that sharpens their next strike or ward.

rites.name: Siluanys
rites.text: Siluanys is a veiled practice of the Arcane realm in the third age of Veneiluana, where adepts graft living sigils into their own skin to tune their bodies to the weave. The discipline's oldest rule is that an adept may awaken a graft without drawing upon reserved mana, though only once within each breath of combat.

rites.name: Veniolluama
rites.text: Veniolluama is a cold, surgical discipline of the Arcane realm in the Veneiluana cycle, practiced by scholars who read a living body like a sealed text. Its adepts can end a wounded foe outright by locating the precise seam of its vital architecture, and they treasure what remains afterward for alchemical use.

rites.name: Venella
rites.text: Venella is a concept of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, born in the fourth age of the E6 era, which describes perfect bodily attunement where a being feels every faint fault in its own flesh. Those who master it can cast off a clinging affliction in a single reflex, though the reprieve must be earned again through rest before it can be spent once more.

rites.name: Miireina
rites.text: Miireina is an arcane concept in the Veneiluana omniverse, a discipline in which the practitioner borrows the sight of others to perceive what hides in plain view. Its adepts stitch another creature's eyes onto their own sockets, gaining a sharpened sense of truth-seeing within a short radius. The art is considered both a gift and a grave theft.

rites.name: Elinnaemiel
rites.text: Elinnaemiel is a concept of replication woven into the arcane fabric of Veneiluana, where a bearer may duplicate themselves without drawing upon stored magic. The gift is bound by a rite of rest: once used, it lies dormant until the bearer has known a full season of repose.

rites.name: Silaenemeth
rites.text: Silaenemeth is a withheld-breath discipline in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, practiced by wardens who refuse to yield when death reaches for them. When a practitioner is struck past their limit, they must drive back the excess harm through a test of endurance, and a success leaves them standing on a single thread of life.

rites.name: Lyileth
rites.text: Lyileth is an arcane discipline in Veneiluana's Sixth Era, practiced by scribes who bind gemstone-dust into ink to inscribe working charms. Its adepts can fashion spell-scrolls with half the labor and reagents a standard scribe would require. The art has been prized since the third age of the Lyileth lineage.

rites.name: Orianeth
rites.text: Orianeth is an enchanted weapon-spirit of the Veneiluana arcane realm, a blade-soul that hovers at its bearer's side once awakened. Born in the third age of the era, it strikes at distant foes with a bolt of woven magic that scales with the wielder's mind.

rites.name: Nuellae
rites.text: Nuellae is a cultivated art of sealing working spells into ordinary vessels such as staves, rings, or glass vials, so that a bearer may release the bound magic later. The stored working is inert until a conscious holder who understands its presence chooses to free it, and it dissipates if the vessel rests unused through a full night. Practitioners treat the art as a patient craft of reserves rather than immediate force.

rites.name: Ryala
rites.text: Ryala is a concept of arcane discipline in the realm of Veneiluana, where a practitioner binds two enchanted implements at once and may strike several targets with them in a single moment. Those who master it can channel a second blessing through a focus or wand, letting a lesser incantation flow forth as a swift extra motion.

rites.name: Lyarlaennae
rites.text: Lyarlaennae is a resonant lattice of crystalline sigils that Veneiluana's mages weave into their staves and rings, letting a sustained enchantment hang in the stone after its caster has let go. It holds the working for a short span measured by the wielder's clarity of mind, then unravels into harmless light.

rites.name: Elualinora
rites.text: Elualinora is a concept of animated arcane artillery, a discipline of enchanting bows and crossbows to hover at the wielder's side and loose shots on command. Its practitioners in the Veneiluana sphere are measured by how many rounds a single enchanted frame can hold before it must be rearmed by hand. The whole art rests on patient, careful sorcery rather than raw force.

rites.name: Alaeleth
rites.text: Alaeleth is a concept of animating magic in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where a bearer's will is woven into a shield so it awakens and holds fast through the span of a single rest cycle. The shield can be dispatched in a moment to shelter a companion under assault, though its protection then lingers unpaid until the next dawn. Its strength is modest, scaled to a tool of personal defense rather than a force of cosmic reach.

rites.name: Ryilleth
rites.text: Ryilleth is a concept of ward-weaving in Veneiluana, a discipline in which a caster binds protective sigils to their own flesh so that arcane intellect hardens into a shield against blows. Three years into the current age, Ryilleth's glyphs have become a standard of wardcraft, teaching apprentices to turn mental sharpness into a barrier and to deflect kinetic force.

rites.name: Elilora
rites.text: Elilora is a silver-threaded spell-weave in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, bound to whatever blade or staff its caster most recently stitched it onto. Whenever a second weapon takes the thread, the first forgets its return and tumbles back to the ground.

rites.name: Eleirlora
rites.text: Eleirlora is a sorcerous discipline in Veneiluana's arcane realm, practiced in its third age, that binds spirit and steel so that enchanted blades and bows learn the wielder's craft as if born of it. A conjured weapon takes on a fighting school of its own, whether a single-blade duel stance, a greatsword's sweeping arc, or a bowstring's precise rhythm.

rites.name: Oriaminna
rites.text: Oriaminna is a binding thread of silver-violet light spun between two souls during the third age of Veneiluana, letting one bearer's failing will be caught and steadied by the other's resolve. Its weavers believed the thread could hold a dying heart in place for a single breath longer than fate allowed. The bond must be rewoven with a new partner at the close of each long rest.

rites.name: Lyereinnys
rites.text: Lyereinnys is a veil-weaving discipline in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where practitioners bind a worn cloth to a single purpose and let it act like a living limb. Its strongest use is a sudden surge of stored thread-magic that briefly sharpens a single attempt before the cloth goes dead.

rites.name: Elareth
rites.text: Elareth is a concept in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, an enchantment that lets a bow or crossbow conjure its own shafts from stored force instead of drawing on a quiver. Practitioners of the third age of the era treated it as a rite of passage, granting a weapon fire that needs no reloading.

rites.name: Nuineirlys
rites.text: Nuineirlys is a veil-thread of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a silver filament that binds a spirit to a forged blade so the steel answers its wielder's flinch. Its bearers learn to catch incoming strikes and return them in the same breath, a discipline the Dusk-Weavers guard jealously.

rites.name: Oriileimiel
rites.text: Oriileimiel is a sheathed conduit of dusk-glass that lets a wielder draw a blade of coiled night into an already-forged edge. It is a concept of the Arcane realm, passed between apprentices during the sixth era of Veneiluana.

rites.name: Ryimys
rites.text: Ryimys is a dormant arcane sigil-art of the Veneiluana age E6, a ward-discipline that answers the bite of steel by turning the striking blade molten in its wielder's grasp. Its practitioners are said to have learned to flare the sigil against any metal that dares to wound them.

rites.name: Lyennualae
rites.text: Lyennualae is a sorcerous discipline in Veneiluana that lets an adept enchant a whole circle of animated and infused blades at once, layering elemental and vorpal essences across every weapon bound to her will. Practitioners must first master the fifth tier of battle-sorcery before the method can be learned. Its adepts are sought as arms-masters by fleets and border garrisons.

rites.name: Venimae
rites.text: Venimae is a dormant lattice of crystalline fire-glass suspended in the Veneiluana's arcane sea, a concept of a thread woven between blades and their wielders. Scholars of the E6 age believed it could be coaxed to bind a steel edge to a sustained flame, though no record shows it was ever fully awakened.

rites.name: Silirleth
rites.text: Silirleth is an arcane ward-gate in Veneiluana's third age, a thin ring of shimmering glyphs that a practitioner can briefly sever from its anchor to unleash stored force. Its rhythm of use is strict: one release, then a long quiet before it can be woken again. It is said to guard the seam between the arcane realm's layers.

rites.name: Nuinora
rites.text: Nuinora is an arcane sigil-engraving tradition of the Veneiluana, in which a wielder inscribes a waiting ward into a favored piece of gear so it answers a foreseen danger without fuel or ritual cost. Its wards may only hold lesser charms, and each lapses if the bearer does not rest fully before the ward is called upon.

rites.name: Eliolaennae
rites.text: Eliolaennae is a concept of Arcane power in Veneiluana's sixth era, a binding that lets a wielder pour stored sorcery through a blade at the moment of impact. Its force is modest and bounded by the spell slot spent, so it is a tool of skilled hands rather than a cataclysm. Only those who have mastered their craft are said to call it forth.

rites.name: Elaemeiriel
rites.text: Elaemeiriel is a concept of sustained arcane resonance, a silver-threaded discipline in Veneiluana in which a practitioner's spoken working is carried into a conjured lance of force. Its mastery lets a caster strike again in the same breath, the echo of the first working riding along behind it.

rites.name: Venualleima
rites.text: Venualleima is a sealed vial of luminous sap drawn from the roots of a tree that grows only where the old tide-scars meet. A single drop, taken by a living body, knits flesh and bone faster than any healer's art, though the drinker must rest for a full cycle before the vial's warmth returns.

rites.name: Lyiruamora
rites.text: Lyiruamora is a discipline of resonant animation practiced in the drifting cloud-archives of Veneiluana, where scholars bind latent will into thrown stones, hollow bells, and loom-shuttles. Mastery demands fifteen full cycles of tutelage before a practitioner may wake a crowd of objects at once. Each awakened thing hits harder the more weight of the world it carries, so a single mountain-sized idol can fell a fortress while a pin-sized bead strikes as a sharpened spark.

rites.name: Oriinwen
rites.text: Oriinwen is a concept of arcane discipline in Veneiluana's sixth era, a practice that lets a mage bind a third drifting blade into the choreography of two already dancing at her command. Its adepts are said to coordinate three animated edges so that a single gesture can unleash a spell through the third while the others strike. The art is studied in the quiet orchard cloisters of the realm's oldest schools.

rites.name: Eliora
rites.text: Eliora is the silver-threaded art of charging arrows with Veneiluana's ambient starlight, a discipline practised only by those who have trained for fifteen seasons under the pale-moon orders. Once an archer's bow is infused, every shaft loosed from it carries the same luminous charge, and the first arrow of each turn flies with uncanny steadiness that seems to bend the odds of the battle.

rites.name: Veneinys
rites.text: Veneinys is an arcane radiance that a wielder can pour into a melee weapon, lighting the surrounding ground with a bright glow and stretching the blade's reach beyond its natural length. Each swing carries through the first foe struck and can strike a second one standing nearby.

rites.name: Silereinys
rites.text: silereinys is a kinetic‑alchemical construct that channels ambient resonance into a single, devastating strike. when activated, it draws power from the surrounding field, amplifying a mundane weapon into a pulse that can shatter stone or tear through flesh with equal ease. the effect is brief but leaves the wielder momentarily drained, requiring a pause to recover before the next use.

rites.name: Miirwen
rites.text: Miirwen is an alchemical concept born in the glassworks of Veneiluana during its sixth era, a seam of distilled starlight that bends ordinary reagents toward swift transmutation. Those who attune to it find their brews ripen in half the usual heat and hours, though the reserves they draw from are not cheap. It is said that Miirwen first crystallised when a vintner's still caught a falling comet's tail.

rites.name: Venaerleth
rites.text: Venaerleth is a concept of rapid alchemical improvisation drawn from the arcane arts of the Veneiluana epoch, letting a practitioner coax sudden reactions out of whatever scraps lie at hand. Its adepts carry a small pouch of catalysts and can turn roadside mud, dried fungus, or spilled wine into flame, acid, or healing vapor in a single breath. The method was born in the fourth age as a response to field shortages and remains the favored craft of wandering mages.

rites.name: Ryamilwen
rites.text: Ryamilwen is a rune-stamped flask of pale gold glass, sealed with wax and used by Veneiluana's wandering apothecaries to hold a moment of concentrated will. A vial bearing its mark can carry a healing breath, a cloud of confusion, or a storm of toxic vapor, and it can be cast into a crowd to burst open the enchantment it holds. Its makers prize the ease of the method but warn that a forgotten vial spoils, its stored spell slipping away before anyone drinks or throws it.

rites.name: Elaerluara
rites.text: Elaerluara is a sorcerous dweller of the Veneiluana, a verdant arcane realm where spells are woven from living glyphs. Their mind channels mental acuity into every restorative and wounding weave, sharpening blows and mending wounds alike. Ancient scholars call this disciplined reckoning the Lattice of Thought.

rites.name: Ryinneliel
rites.text: Ryinneliel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, the fourth age of the E6 era, a crystalline catalyst that lets an alchemist unlock a restricted infusion at the close of a rest without drawing upon reserved magical strength. Its ancient lattice gives way to a single gift each time the vessel is stilled, allowing a formula beyond the alchemist's usual limits to take hold.

rites.name: Nueliel
rites.text: Nueliel is a concept-class arcane reaction in Veneiluana, a power that a practitioner hurls as a fistful of volatile reagents to ignite a small, searing blaze at range. Its flames scale with the caster's growing mastery, and the same reaction can be condensed into a hurled incendiary edge that lasts only one turn.

rites.name: Silennys
rites.text: Silennys is a concept in Veneiluana's arcane tradition, a reactive compound that a practitioner can hurl or wield to splash corrosive acid across a small area. Its bite is greatest against structures, where it eats through stone, iron, and timber far faster than against living flesh. Chemists of the E6 era still study it as a sign of how far arcane reagents can be pushed.

rites.name: Elionneth
rites.text: Elionneth is an alchemical elixir of volatile reagents, quaffed to unleash a single devastating breath of cold, flame, corrosion, or lightning across the battlefield. Its brewers in the arcane city of Veneiluana guard the recipe closely, as each dose can scour a shrine's courtyard or the roof of a vault in one heartbeat.

rites.name: Alainwen
rites.text: Alainwen is a concept of a compressed thunder-spell, a small detonation shaped by a caster's will and hurled at a chosen point or gripped as a crude missile. It is a minor working in Veneiluana's arcane tradition, crafted to be fast, precise, and dangerous only at close quarters.

rites.name: Oriallae
rites.text: Oriallae is a volatile tonic-vapor compound brewed in the sealed cisterns of the Veneiluana marsh-cities, prized by duellists for its fortifying fumes. Its mists bloom on command and cling to whoever breathes them, sharpening strikes and steeling the chest against the next blow.

rites.name: Oriarennae
rites.text: Oriarennae is a reagent-binding discipline from the Veneiluana arcane tradition, practiced by alchemists who stabilize volatile compounds into precise, point-targeted reactions. Its adepts can place a flash of controlled chemistry within forty feet and shape it so that chosen allies slip its harm without a contest of reflexes. At its height the art can unmake a city block in a single measured reaction.

rites.name: Silaelanna
rites.text: Silaelanna is a frost-weaver of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a concept born three ages past whose cold blooms can seize whole districts in glittering stasis. Its frost is not mere chill but a sudden crystalline seizing of matter that drinks heat from everything it touches.

rites.name: Eliola
rites.text: Eliola is a restorative elixir distilled from moon-dew and ember-moss in the high cloisters of Veneiluana, prized for mending wounds that ordinary salves cannot touch.
