rites.text: Alaarys is a volatile arcane pyrotechnic concept woven through the Veneiluana cosmos, a discipline of glittering ember-shells sown by artisans who bind starlight into brittle casings. Its practitioners scatter these seeds across a battlefield in measured volleys, each one a small sun waiting to bloom.

rites.name: Eleinniel
rites.text: Eleinniel is a concept in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a toolbox of abandoned notions that can be conjured into brief reality when needed most. Its gadgets vanish after a minute, and only one may be drawn until rest restores the box. Its energies are modest, fitting a concept whose power lies in timing rather than scale.

rites.name: Orierwen
rites.text: Orierwen is a bound lattice of crystallized lightning, grown in the high vaults of Veneiluana to store the final sparks of fading storms. Once every turn of the seasons it may be shattered into a single focused beam that unmakes whatever it touches, a power that then rests dormant until the lattice has regrown in the deep cold.

rites.name: Nuemys
rites.text: Nuemys is a ward-thread woven into threadbare cloaks and leather jerkins by the lamp-wives of Veneiluana's drowned coast. While worn, it steadies the wearer with a shield of borrowed vigor that thins with each tattered recovery until it finally fades away.

rites.name: Oriarlennys
rites.text: Oriarlennys is a concept in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, an idea that lets a mind bend its own reasoning past the ordinary boundaries of thought. Its practitioners can pull three separate lines of insight at once and keep whichever proves sharpest, but only once before they must rest and reset their focus. The concept also lets them graft an unlisted refinement onto any artifact they already own, provided it is not a tier-gated refinement.

rites.name: Lyanna
rites.text: Lyanna is a drifting mind-lattice that hums between the ringing hollows of Veneiluana's oldest stratum, where it hoards the forgotten names of dead stars. Those who learn her cadence can bend a single frequency of the void into a weapon or a shelter, though each use frays a little of the speaker's own memory. Her presence is said to be the last echo of a sister song that tried to sing the sky awake.

rites.name: Oriirys
rites.text: Oriirys is a concept-born keeper of hearth-lore in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, an age-three remnant of the sixth era who learned the old ways from grandmothers of the ash-wells. Its knowledge lets it read weather in wounded soil and steady the hands of those who tend living things.

rites.name: Venirla
rites.text: Venirla is a concept of perfected ritual craft, a discipline whose adepts unlock buried tradition until any lesser incantation can be woven slowly into a ceremony. Its practitioners pay costly reagents in exchange for mastery, and the ritual time they save is measured in the cycles of the moon. The art is quiet, deliberate, and never hurried, yet it reshapes the fabric of Veneiluana.

rites.name: Elennae
rites.text: Elennae is a seer-herald of the Veneiluana, a concept-being whose presence first appeared in the third age as a sudden clarity pressed into minds. She speaks in lantern-bright gestures and carries the knowledge of hidden things like a torch held for others to read by.

rites.name: Sileirae
rites.text: Sileirae is a concept of a veil-thin mortal sustained by a borrowed divine grace, whose body glows as the grace is drawn outward. Veneiluana's sages record it as a trade: each mystery learned deepens the gift and grinds the vessel toward an early ending.

rites.name: Venuarys
rites.text: Venuarys is a concept of a thread-reading fate-weaver in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, an age-three power that lets its bearer glimpse nearby outcomes and slip past blows that were already written. Its sight stretches across the loom of destiny, letting it turn aside a strike by reshaping the odds in the moment before impact.

rites.name: Ryirionae
rites.text: Ryirionae is a veil of inherited grace that the Veneiluana chorus-mages weave around their own tempers during the fourth age of the sixth epoch. Each time a practitioner calls a revelation into the air, a thin shell of borrowed vitality gathers about the caster, scaled to the steadiness of their judgment.

rites.name: Ilyileimwen
rites.text: Ilyileimwen is a prophetic cartographer-saint of the Veneiluana, whose sealed star-charts are said to bend the odds of coming battles. Her forecasts are not visions but reserved fates, kept like coins in a ledger until a named moment arrives to collect them. Her one recorded act of raw power was the tearing of a moon's orbit to strand an invading fleet.

rites.name: Oriaminnae
rites.text: Oriaminnae is a sealed rite of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a concept born three ages into the sixth era, when seers first traded their eyes for visions. Practitioners who undergo its binding lose sight forever, yet perceive the threads of coming events as luminous lattices. Its power is measured less in force than in foresight, though its rare backlash can shear a mind apart.

rites.name: Veniollae
rites.text: Veniollae is a ritual scar-sign borne by those who have touched the sunken forges of Veneiluana's third age, where the hand is marked by flame it could not hold. The bearer's grip is weakened for blades and nimble trickery, yet the marked palm can kindle a Revelation of Fire, a sudden blaze that answers only to the one who was burned.

rites.name: Silimwen
rites.text: Silimwen is a seer-current of the Veneiluana weave, a concept that reads the drifting threads of what has not yet happened and settles them into clear foresight within a single heartbeat. Its gift is sealed by an oath of silence, so every vision it gathers remains locked behind its own lips.

rites.name: Oriinaella
rites.text: Oriinaella is a concept of quiet restoration, a silver thread of breath that knits a weary caster's reserves back together during brief pauses between trials. In Veneiluana's third age it is taught in hushed circles where practitioners learn to read the rhythm of their own tiredness.

rites.name: Miamuannora
rites.text: Miamuannora is a sealed doctrine of the Veneiluana powers, a concept that teaches an initiate to hold an extra layer of hidden rites. Its lessons crowd the mind, so each borrowed rite must displace a spell the practitioner already keeps. Adepts describe it as a second library shelved inside the first.

rites.name: Lyilerae
rites.text: Lyilerae is a grave-tongued occultist of the Veneiluana arcane realm, a practitioner who has learned the quiet mechanics of endings and uses them to unravel living things. Their work ranges from gentle rites that ease the passage of the dying to curses that can wither a whole orchard in a night. Those who study under Lyilerae are warned that every borrowed breath must eventually be repaid.

rites.name: Silirlena
rites.text: Silirlena is an Arcane concept in the Veneiluana omniverse, an abstraction of life's quiet tides that appears as a shimmering lattice across the wards of the third age. She grants healing and protective bonds rather than destruction, and her presence is measured by how many wounds close in a single breath.

rites.name: Lyema
rites.text: Lyema is a concept of ember-sight, a discipline in Veneiluana's Arcane realm where the practitioner reads the hidden heat within matter and coaxes it into flame. Its adepts are measured less by raw fury than by how long a flame can be sustained and how completely a single pyre can consume a life.

rites.name: Siluama
rites.text: Siluama is the concept of martial understanding made into a force, a discipline that teaches the bearer how war truly works and then lets that knowledge strike back. Its arts grow from thunder and branding to blinding and staggering, and at its height can cast down any foe the bearer has learned to name.

rites.name: Veneineth
rites.text: Veneineth is a concept of soul-knowledge in the Veneiluana cosmos, a discipline of listening to the quiet threads that bind spirit to flesh. Its adepts gain five practical arts, from a summoned unseen attendant to the restoration of the recently dead.

rites.name: Venemiel
rites.text: Venemiel is an Arcane concept of the E6 era in Veneiluana, a power that lets its wielder perceive the threads by which fates are bound and feel the moment one is about to part. When a companion would fall from a mortal wound, Venemiel can speak a warning that re-knots the thread so the companion stands on the brink instead of over it. The gift returns only after a full rest of the body and spirit.

rites.name: Ilyinae
rites.text: Ilyinae is a veiled discipline in the Veneiluana arcane sphere, a standing grant that lets a practitioner take one sacred rite from the priestly tradition and bind it to their own occult arts without it counting toward their limited repertoire. Scholars of the E6 era regard it as a loophole that reshaped how apprentices chose their studies.

rites.name: Eleinaema
rites.text: Eleinaema is a veil-weaving discipline practiced in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where adepts sharpen perception of hidden things until the unseen becomes plainly visible. Its masters can pierce illusions and invisible shrouds within a radius matching their keenest senses, a gift that grows with long study.

rites.name: Silireth
rites.text: Silireth is a sensing discipline in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, taught to acolytes who learn to perceive the world through pressure and resonance rather than light. Practitioners who endure prolonged darkness find their inner perception widening until it reaches far beyond ordinary sight. The discipline is revered for turning deprivation into a deeper awareness.

rites.name: Elinys
rites.text: Elinys is an Arcane concept from the third age of the E6 era in Veneiluana, a discipline of drawing dark force into the body to strengthen spells of frost and rot. Practitioners who channel it grow frail and sluggish for a time, a cost they accept as the price of greater ruin.

rites.name: Sileireth
rites.text: Sileireth is a concept of ember-wrought veils that a spellcaster may draw over their body after casting a working, sheltering them in a shimmering corona of heat. Those who stand close to the veil are scorched at the close of each turn, and anyone who dares to strike its bearer in close combat is burned by the answering heat.

rites.name: Miameth
rites.text: Miameth is a concept of arcane vitality in the realm of Veneiluana, an entity whose presence tilts the balance of living things, mending one body by borrowing from another's reserves. Its power is bound to the pulse of breathing creatures and fades before the dead, the animated, and the made.

rites.name: Elineth
rites.text: Elineth is a spectral mystic-craft of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, in which a caster calls restless departed spirits into a chosen patch of empty air. Benevolent spirits mend the first outsider who steps among them, while tormented ones wound that intruder with a chill of decay.

rites.name: Venuareimys
rites.text: Venuareimys is a discipline of the Arcane realm in the Veneiluana omniverse, taught to scholars who have glimpsed the pure form of combat hidden inside every clash. Its adepts learn to fold a blade strike into the moment a spell is completed, so that sorcery and steel land as a single act. The art is said to have been distilled from a war that burned through three generations of the old empire.

rites.name: Alairiel
rites.text: Alairiel is a concept of arcane ignition in the realm of Veneiluana, where a bearer can kindle a held blade or staff into lasting flame at the cost of a small wound. The flame lights a modest circle of ground and cuts deeper into whatever it touches, though it dies the moment the bearer releases the weapon.

rites.name: Venillae
rites.text: Venillae is a concept of inevitable decline in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where a bearer's wounds refuse to knit once the quiet grip of ending has taken hold. The touch lingers through a single turn, and the one who wields it must share its cold silence, unable to mend until the next dawn of their own reckoning.

rites.name: Oriennys
rites.text: Oriennys is a concept of ember-binding in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, where practitioners may rewrite the dice of their own blaze after they are cast. Choosing to take a burn for every rewritten die lets a caster refuse the ordinary rules of heat, so a flame that has been fully reshaped can slip past any ward against fire.

rites.name: Siluanneira
rites.text: Siluanneira is a quiet ward-spirit of the Veneiluana, a thread of borrowed breath kept by reed-singers who listen for the last exhale of the dying. When a creature gives up its final breath near a singer, the spirit may carry a measure of that life into another body nearby, restoring what was lost.

rites.name: Elirla
rites.text: Elirla is a dormant understanding of conflict, a quiet frequency that resonates whenever a minor incantation is spoken in its presence. Scholars of Veneiluana describe it as a lens through which every skirmish becomes legible, letting an adept turn a whispered spell into a violent release. Its power is modest in isolation but grows sharply when paired with the right ritual timing.

rites.name: Miinallys
rites.text: Miinallys is a sustained discipline of the Veneiluana arcane tradition, in which a practitioner binds their own inner voice to a single working and refuses to let it slip. Its adepts are prized for holding fragile enchantments steady through storms of distraction and pain.

rites.name: Elanuama
rites.text: Elanuama is a veil-weaving discipline practised in the drifting aerie-cities of Veneiluana, where a practitioner stitches two separate mysteries into one working so that a single incantation answers two calls at once. The art demands a mind seasoned by years of inner study, and it is taught only to those who have already mastered the lesser cantrips of hidden knowledge.

rites.name: Lyila
rites.text: Lyila is a concept of alchemical craft in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, an improvised tincture brewed in the quiet hours of rest. Its brewer sets the mixture to simmer through a slow vigil, and its restorative charge is short-lived, fading within a single day. When enriched with a stored arcane surge, the brew gains a far fuller mending strength.

rites.name: Sileimae
rites.text: Sileimae is a concept of Veneiluana's Arcane realm in the sixth era, where a practitioner's own vitality becomes the currency of ritual. Willing bystanders can surrender their stored life to power a working in place of costly reagents, and that lost vitality stays withdrawn until a full night of rest restores it. Its age of three marks it as a newly codified doctrine of blood-bound sorcery.

rites.name: Venira
rites.text: Venira is a rite of crimson sacrifice in which the living surrender their vitality to empower sorcery, a practice that grows stronger the more blood a circle of willing bodies can offer. Its power is drawn from the flesh of the living, and the wounds it leaves persist until the sacrificers rest fully.

rites.name: Mieriel
rites.text: Mieriel is a concept in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, an old lore of quiet rites that open a thin door to the departed. Practitioners who learn it may speak with the dead without spending their reserves, but the door closes hard after each use and must stay shut until the caster has rested.

rites.name: Venaniomora
rites.text: Venaniomora is an arcane discipline of the Veneiluana sphere, a dormant tuning that a practitioner awakens after a decade of study to bind a second craft into the self. Those who master it can deepen a chosen art until their every attempt at it carries twice its usual weight. Its old tales speak of a scholar who once bent a dying star's light into a single skilled gesture.

rites.name: Veneillarae
rites.text: Veneillarae is a grafted sorcery-mark that binds an occultist's will to the restless remains of the fallen, letting them rise as servants for a single cycle of the moon. Its mark is cumbersome and cannot be rewritten into a longer, slower ritual, so each rising must be commanded in the moment.

rites.name: Nuireth
rites.text: Nuireth is a quiet, half-remembered discipline in Veneiluana's arcane tradition, passed between practitioners as a single borrowed working rather than a school of its own. Each adept who receives it may re-shape one of their known charms into a slower, sanctified form that can be enacted once before the body must recover. The old texts warn that its true reach was never recorded.

rites.name: Elioniel
rites.text: Elioniel is a dormant ember-thought bound into the verdant lattice of Veneiluana's Arcane realm during the E6 era. Three years old, it wakes only when the lattice hums, and it teaches the quickening of seeds into forests within a single breath.

rites.name: Venaellys
rites.text: Venaellys is a ward-script in the Veneiluana era E6, a lattice of silver glyphs that a warden inks along the skin to turn aside blows before they land. Its bearers treat each mark as a living contract, renewed at dawn and fading with age, and it is most valued by those who walk the thin roads between cities.

rites.name: Mieniolys
rites.text: Mieniolys is a quiet, ageless mentor-spirit of the Veneiluana arcane courts, bound to the slow turning of seasons rather than death. Its craft lets it shape old ritual wards and keep their lattices from fading across the long eras of the realm.

rites.name: Veniorlys
rites.text: Veniorlys is a shimmering weaver of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's sixth era, a being who has stopped the slow tide of time upon its own body. Its appearance can be held at any moment of youth it chooses, yet the countdown written into its kind still runs quietly beneath the skin. Scholars of the era call it the mirror that refuses to grey.

rites.name: Orielleth
rites.text: Orielleth is a bound conceptual lattice of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a teaching-principle that persuades a student's mind to hold ten minor workings as native habit. Across the era of the Sixth Concordance it has been transcribed into small hands and disciplined circles, mostly fifteen-year practitioners.

rites.name: Lyiniel
rites.text: Lyiniel is an arcane principle of selective venom, a binding craft in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana from the sixth era, three ages old. Its practitioners tune a poison or spell so that it slips past the defenses of one chosen lineage of creatures while every other kind of being merely endures it.

rites.name: Elionnila
rites.text: Elionnila is a concept-level gaze of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a sight that peers beyond the veil of the material world for a single minute. Within its narrow radius the viewer perceives the hidden spirit-currents, outmatching illusions, shadows of invisibility, and disguised forms, while distant things dim into blindness.

rites.name: Venelionys
rites.text: Venelionys is a concept of a shared-fate ward, a bond woven between two souls so that the mind's resistance is pooled, with each trial of will standing or falling for both. Its scholars count it among the quieter arts, since its gravest use is not a blow but a shared fall. Its tether to the Veneiluana remains a matter of debate among its keepers.

rites.name: Venellima
rites.text: Venellima is a veiled cantrip-lattice of the Arcane realm, a concept that lets a caster redirect a flame or a storm into a hollowing dark that withers the spirit beneath the skin. Its practitioners report that the victim's living light dims in the same heartbeat the wound is struck.

rites.name: Mialeth
rites.text: Mialeth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a discipline of lattice-wardens who bind their resolve into layered sigils of hardened air and glass. Practitioners in the sixth era of Veneiluana wear no metal, yet can stand against blows that would break ordinary plate. Its teachings span the third age, when wardens first taught that defense is a form of song.

rites.name: Alaameineth
rites.text: Alaameineth is the silent axiom that binds intention to consequence across the layered manifolds. It manifests as a lattice of conditional thresholds where each deliberate choice rewrites the local rules of causality. Those who internalize its structure gain the authority to suspend ordinary limits within a bounded domain.

rites.name: Ryannora
rites.text: Ryannora is a quickening veil of silver thread that Veneiluana's wind-dancers weave over a body for a single tide of breath. Those wrapped within move twice as fast, flinch aside from blows more readily, and gain a brief second motion to strike, dart, or slip away. The veil cannot be stacked atop another swiftening, for a second layer only dulls its own gift.

rites.name: Alainora
rites.text: Alainora is a concept in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a hovering, bell-shaped lantern of silvered glass that answers to whoever can hum the right note. Its drifting wardens guard the seams between the city's sky-gardens, and a single animated lantern can turn a whole district's light against an intruder.

rites.name: Silenna
rites.text: Silenna is a shadow-binding art in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, practiced in the third age of the E6 era. Its practitioners pull a creature's dark twin from the margins of light and command it as an inky, smoke-formed reflection.

rites.name: Venileth
rites.text: Venileth is a quiet mind-weaving art practiced in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where a caster can cloud a creature's perception so that two visible things of matching size and kind appear to trade places. The deluded creature does not notice the exchange until its own hands or steps prove otherwise, and each contact with the swapped things offers a fresh chance to see through the haze.

rites.name: Ryiniel
rites.text: Ryiniel is a binding-light thread woven by the Veneiluana sisterhood of Arcane scholars, a silver tether that holds a wandering soul or beast to a chosen spot. Its pull grows stronger the farther a captive strays, hauling them home by force once their will falters. Old archives name it the patient leash.

rites.name: Ryilaerlys
rites.text: Ryilaerlys is an arcane concept in Veneiluana's sixth era, a tide of heat that rises through the veins of anyone still bleeding from a recent wound. Its sufferers are gripped by searing agony and find the very ground hostile, yet each turn they may wrench free of its grip. It has existed for three ages as a quiet, feared discipline.

rites.name: Ilyaraelys
rites.text: Ilyaraelys is an arcane concept of the Veneiluana omniverse, a flame-binding art that crowns a hand in searing radiance able to scorch whatever it touches. It is most devastating against living growth and creatures frail to heat, yet its bearers grow in strength as their mastery deepens.

rites.name: Oriinnora
rites.text: Oriinnora is a hexing sigil-weave of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, drawn in fading silver ink that stains the skin of anyone it marks. Bound to a target, it drains the resolve of the victim until every blow, bolt, or act of ruin falls flat and harmless into the air. The weave is young, only three ages old, and its wielders still argue over whether its silence is mercy or a cage.

rites.name: Venuarimys
rites.text: Venuarimys is an arcane agony-weaving discipline of the Veneiluana, where practitioners pull a thread of pain through a foe's nerves until movement itself becomes a torment. Its sufferers are lashed with wracking sparks each time they stride or strike, and the hold breaks only when the victim wrenches free of its own resolve. Those trained in it are feared as the quiet cripplers of old border courts.

rites.name: Miellora
rites.text: Miellora is a concept of withering rot in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a decay that a practitioner can channel through the palm to bring a foe's flesh to ash-grey flaking. Those touched by it carry a lingering blight that worsens with the next wound they suffer. Its scope grows as the wielder advances through the orders of the craft.

rites.name: Nuallys
rites.text: Nuallys is a grim spell-concept from the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where a caster can rip a creature's bones loose from its flesh. The act leaves behind a rattling undead sentinel that turns on the nearest living thing.

rites.name: Alaema
rites.text: Alaema is a lightning-channeling discipline practiced in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where adepts gather storm-charge into their palms and strike foes with conductive arms or blades. Its charge fades quickly, so practitioners time their strikes carefully before the thunder dissipates.

rites.name: Oriineilae
rites.text: Oriineilae is a shapeshifting rite of the Veneiluana arcane tradition, in which a practitioner wears the living skin of the small beast that supplied the spell's reagent. The wearer borrows that creature's body and breath, keeping their own mind and heart, and slips back to human shape when the body falters.

rites.name: Siliruaneth
rites.text: Siliruaneth is a concept of ember-wrought hands drawn from the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, appearing in the sixth era as a passing talent of the third age. Its flames are a bright, controllable fire that wakes only when a bearer chooses to call it forth.

rites.name: Eluanna
rites.text: Eluanna is a concept of frost woven into a living hand, a cold that numbs the marrow of anything it grasps and slows its advance. In the arcane realm of Veneiluana, it is the first chill a young mage learns to hold, and its bite deepens as the mage's craft matures.

rites.name: Silerlora
rites.text: Silerlora is a concept of withered will made flesh, a grasping force that exists only while a caster holds an iron-cold hand closed around a victim's life. In the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, its era of the sixth age is marked by pacts that let the grasp outlive its wielder for a few heartbeats. Its power is modest, measured in the small drain of living things rather than the ruin of cities.

rites.name: Eleirlae
rites.text: Eleirlae is a sly, bloodless afflicting art of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, cultivated by mind-scholars who prefer nagging pressure to outright ruin. Its practitioners press a throbbing ache into the skull of any thinking creature, dulling its focus and muddying its reasoning for a short while. The ache is a nuisance, never a killer, and is spoken of mostly as a rude trick.

rites.name: Eliona
rites.text: Eliona is a curse-thread woven by the Veneiluana weavers of the third age, a binding that drains a victim's vitality with each turning of their pulse. Its grip loosens only when the afflicted wins a battle of will against the thread, and its wounds heal only through the deepest rest.

rites.name: Miennys
rites.text: Miennys is a fleeting arcane discipline in Veneiluana's Third Age, taught in the bruised hills where practitioners coat their knuckles or blades in a dark, ichorous haze. The haze lingers only briefly, sinking venom into whatever it touches before dissipating.

rites.name: Lyenimora
rites.text: Lyenimora is a pale rot-sigil from the arcane schools of Veneiluana, inscribed upon a living body to draw its flesh toward slow decay. Each wound it suffers blooms with extra corruption, and the tending hands of healers find their work halved. Those marked by it also carry a visible sourness that makes strangers recoil from their words.

rites.name: Siluamora
rites.text: Siluamora is a tethered ghost-scholar of the Arcane realm, a faint silver wisp bound to a single field of knowledge and drawn into the orbit of its summoner. It cannot touch the world, yet it whispers counsel, reads the unseen, and lends its wisdom to any task performed within its reach.

rites.name: Nualae
rites.text: Nualae is a binding rite of the Veneiluana arcane tradition, a paired curse that can trade the minds of two people for a short season. Those who wear another's flesh find its strength answering their will, though their own sorcery remains and they stumble clumsily in the borrowed skin for a time. Practitioners treat the rite as a grave matter, since a death during the exchange sends each spirit home but scalds the one who was holding a foreign soul.

rites.name: Silimanae
rites.text: Silimanae is a dark-root sorcery of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, in which the caster calls shadowed growths up from the soil to seize and feed on nearby foes. Its tendrils can be cut down by radiant or fire, which also strike the caster's enemies in the same space.

rites.name: Ryarys
rites.text: Ryarys is an arcane concept in the Veneiluana omniverse, a dark current that drinks the water from living bodies and leaves them brittle and drained. Its effect is a withering sap of vitality that makes the afflicted vulnerable to flame until the next turn passes. Practitioners treat it as a mid-tier curse rather than a weapon of world-breaking power.

rites.name: Silirameth
rites.text: Silirameth is the thread-drawing art of the Veneiluana cloisters, in which a practitioner plucks at the unseen strands that bind fortune to the living. Its adepts can nudge a stranger's luck mid-throw, though a bold yank of the strand returns its cost as a wound of cold rot.

rites.name: Venaneleth
rites.text: Venaneleth is a dormant mind-lattice that drifts through the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, awakening only when a sentient will pledges itself to its patterns. Its wardens are called to shape one of four disciplines, each unlocking deeper resonance across the ages of the realm.

rites.name: Ryarae
rites.text: Ryarae is a discipline of the mind-forged, a silver lattice of thought that lets the wielder reshape matter by will alone. Its practitioners are known to lift whole cliffs with a single sustained intention, though the cost of such feats is paid in their own fading memories.

rites.name: Silimae
rites.text: Silimae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, an intricate discipline of layered mental specialization that a practitioner refines as they mature. Adepts select and rework their talents across a long apprenticeship, shaping a personal mind-lattice that sharpens with each stage of growth. Its raw output stays modest for a concept of this scope.

rites.name: Silaenna
rites.text: Silaenna is a concept of a second mind-art that a practitioner may awaken once their inner practice reaches its third stage, granting a new discipline the moment it is chosen. No single discipline may be chosen twice, so each awakening widens the mind's repertoire without repeating its old paths. In the Veneiluana cosmos of the fourth age, it is said that the gift of Silaenna lets a mind hold two storms without breaking.

rites.name: Miiraenneth
rites.text: Miiraenneth is a quiet arcane principle that the scholars of Veneiluana describe as the slow sharpening of a mind and body across an age. Every fourth stride of a life, it grants a choice of which faculty to deepen, and the gain is never allowed past a settled threshold of mastery. Its manifestations are gentle but cumulative, reshaping the inner self rather than striking outward.

rites.name: Ilyelaemae
rites.text: Ilyelaemae is a veiled mindflow that ripples through the Veneiluana's arcane ley-lattice, awakening latent thought into shaped force for those who learn to hold it. Its adepts gather a fleeting reserve of inner charge each dawn, which must be spent within the same cycle or it dissipates into the dusk air.

rites.name: Ilyirlereth
rites.text: Ilyirlereth is a concept-class power in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, an innate reservoir of psionic might that a mind can draw upon once per long rest. Its bearer may unleash a single borrowed sorcery of deep rank, and as the bearer grows, the reservoir deepens to hold ever more formidable workings.

rites.name: Ryerys
rites.text: Ryerys is a veil of attunement that a mind may wear once its inner current has grown deep enough, letting a practitioner take on a third and distinct school of inner force. No single school may be chosen twice, and each school arrives whole the moment it is taken up. The veil was sealed by the old orders of Veneiluana to keep their hard-won disciplines from being hoarded by a few.

rites.name: Miemwen
rites.text: Miemwen is a concept of a psychic traveller in the Veneiluana omniverse who, when death takes them, may slip free as a grieving spirit that wanders the unseen margins of the world. The spirit keeps the mind it had in life but borrows a restless, ghostly body, and it endures only while its inner reserves of mind-power hold out.

rites.name: Ryeminnae
rites.text: Ryeminnae is the quiet discipline of threading one's will through another being's inherited gifts, loosening a flame from a mind or tuning a wingbeat until it sings. Practitioners in the Veneiluana courts treat it as a craft of gentle persuasion rather than force, and its masters are rarely noticed in the work they do.

rites.name: Alaaniel
rites.text: Alaaniel is a discipline of the Veneiluana Arcane realm, in which practitioners fold their inner resonance into the body, letting a brief surge of focused will sharpen raw physical execution. Adepts describe it as a quiet hum beneath the ribs that answers to deliberate intent rather than emotion.

rites.name: Alaameth
rites.text: Alaameth is a psionic surge that rouses a chosen creature's body with borrowed will, granting a bulwark of fleeting vitality and a spike of added force to its next blow. Its wielders can layer extra grit, speed, or resilience onto the surge at the moment of targeting, though the reserves they draw from are strictly limited.

rites.name: Alairys
rites.text: Alairys is a concept of quiet, self-taught reshaping, a tuning of the body and mind into temporary forms that the people of Veneiluana regard as an art more than a weapon. Its practitioners draw on tides of latent vitality to steady their nerves, quicken their steps, or harden their skin for a single decisive moment. In its highest form it can restore a fading mind or grant a traveler the freedom to pass through any obstacle.

rites.name: Ryiriel
rites.text: Ryiriel is a quiet discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, practiced by mind-weavers who give shape to dreams that then leave the skull and act upon the waking world. Its adepts are cautioned that a vivid enough imagining can outlast its maker and reshape the ground beneath a city.

rites.name: Alaalena
rites.text: Alaalena is a psionic construct-art of the Veneiluana, a silvery ethereal shape pulled from the mind of a trained adept and bent into a blade, beast, or tool. Its grip and lunge are guided by sheer will, and a skilled adept can summon, fold, and harden it at will. Stories of its use speak of duels fought across rooftops and crowds parted by phantom spears.

rites.name: Miinna
rites.text: Miinna is a silver-threaded mind-art of the Veneiluana arcane realm, in which a practitioner spends inner sparks to shape small illusions, drifting servants, and borrowed steeds. Its adepts can also weave a lens through distant space or call new matter from nothing, though the greatest such works strain the bounds of what a single mind can hold.

rites.name: Silinys
rites.text: Silinys is a lattice of resonant glass-threads woven through the upper air of Veneiluana, through which trained minds gather and bend the currents of pressure and light. Its practitioners are said to be able to lift the weight of the sky itself, though such feats are rare and dangerous to attempt.

rites.name: Lyeneth
rites.text: Lyeneth is a concept of a telekinetic discipline in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, taught to adepts in the sixth era who are only three ages past its founding. Practitioners learn to nudge small things across a room as though a phantom hand were at work, though the craft cannot be turned into a weapon.

rites.name: Miala
rites.text: In the ethereal realm of Luminara, the entity known as Elysium manipulates gravity to control matter, withstanding immense forces and propelling itself at incredible speeds.

rites.name: Alaannaemys
rites.text: Alaannaemys is a silver-veined lattice of crystalline thought that drifts between the stars of Veneiluana, bending loose matter with a patient, geometric will. In its sixth age it is said to have quieted a dying sun by coaxing its molten core into a slow, orderly spin.

rites.name: Elerwen
rites.text: Elerwen is a quiet resonance woven through the thought-lattices of Veneiluana's oldest minds, letting a practitioner brush against the inner voices of others without speaking a word. Its practitioners guard the craft closely, for a careless touch can rewrite what a mind believes it remembers.

rites.name: Alainna
rites.text: Alainna is the silver thread of mind-speech woven through the Veneiluana arcane courts, a faculty that lets one speak inward to any being within thirty paces whose eyes meet hers. Her words need no shared tongue, only that the listener grasps some tongue at all, so that dragons, scholars, and beasts alike can hear her meaning as if it were their own memory.

rites.name: Mierlionora
rites.text: Mierlionora is a silver-threaded mind-spell that the Veneiluana arcane orders teach to those who hear the thoughts of others. Its practitioners learn to press a stray thought into a rival's skull until the victim staggers or sees phantoms. Its power is measured in mental strain, not in physical force.

rites.name: Elaenniel
rites.text: Elaenniel is a veiled cartographer of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a concept-being who maps the unspoken wishes lingering in the dreams of sleeping cities. Her mind can gently coax a crowd into obedience or slip inside a single sleeper's memories and rewrite them like pages of a ledger. Scholars say she has never once raised her voice, yet her quiet has toppled councils.

rites.name: Nuemirwen
rites.text: Nuemirwen is a sealed grammar of folded geometry, taught in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana to shape the stitching between neighbouring spaces. Practitioners bend thresholds the way scribes bend a line of verse, so that a corridor can refuse its own length. Its oldest scripts are said to have carried whole provinces across the seams.

rites.name: Ryirlameth
rites.text: Ryirlameth is a concept of arcane locomotion woven into the Veneiluana cosmos during its Sixth Era, a short-range step through a visible gap that grows with the bearer's mastery. Its use consumes a whole turn of motion, so practitioners treat each step as a deliberate choice rather than a casual dash.

rites.name: Alaerlys
rites.text: Alaerlys is a spatial-tearing technique from the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, practiced by wandering archivists who fold distance like cloth. The tear it leaves behind lingers as a faint shimmer that disturbs nearby sound and light for several heartbeats. Its practitioners treat each tear as a small debt owed to the fabric of place.

rites.name: Ilyileth
rites.text: Ilyileth is a concept of Veneiluana's arcane realm, an art of folding distance so that a practitioner can step across a room or a gulf of stars with equal ease. Its adepts spend a measure of inner will to bend their position, and the deepest rites can tear a passage through the fabric of space itself.

rites.name: Venionae
rites.text: Venionae is a sung discipline of the Veneiluana heartlands, in which practitioners tune their breath to the hum of the land and draw the warmth from nearby air to kindle sudden flame or gather it into sudden, storm-like bolts. Its masters are feared for the way a single held note can leave a valley cold and silent, yet they are also the ones called upon to quiet the great mountain fires.

rites.name: Venemiel
rites.text: Venemiel is a minor concept of arcane energy, a slender shard of attuned glass that lets its bearer coax light, sparks, flame, or frost from the air at will. Its effects are small and short-lived, lasting only a minute each, and a bearer can keep only a few running at once before the oldest fades. Its reach stays modest, suited to the everyday craft of a scholar or artisan.

rites.name: Silareth
rites.text: Silareth is a conjured elemental burst, a pressure of cold, flame, force, or lightning that a mind shapes and hurls at a single visible foe. It can be sharpened with extra psychic cost, spread into a fanning cone, or left as a lingering field that catches anyone who wanders through it.

rites.name: Siliomaleth
rites.text: Siliomaleth is a crystalline lattice of cooled aether-glass that hums when touched by a trained mind, shaping its stored stillness into kinetic force. Scholars of the E6 age in Veneiluana describe it as a conduit rather than a source, lending its resonance to whoever can hold the pattern steady. It rarely shatters, yet its deepest resonance can unmake a whole district.

rites.name: Oriilarleth
rites.text: Oriilarleth is a concept of frost-bound arcane power in Veneiluana, a discipline where every blow carries the stillness of deep winter. Those struck by its blasts seize up and slow to a crawl, their limbs locked in glassy rime until the chill releases them.

rites.name: Oriilanwen
rites.text: Oriilanwen is a crackling conduit-art of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, where practitioners draw storm-current through their own nerves and hurl it as blue-white arcs. Its cadets learn to ground themselves in wet stone before loosing a tendril, lest the discharge turn back on them. Among the older masters, the sky burst is spoken of only in whispers, since a single performance can split a valley's clouds.

rites.name: Silenae
rites.text: Silenae is a quiet ember-mind of the Arcane realm, an entity that hums through the cinders of Veneiluana's oldest hearths. It wills heat into a single kind of flame and never any other, reshaping its burns into deeper, longer-lasting scorches.

rites.name: Venerora
rites.text: Venerora is a seer-thread of the Veneiluana weave, a concept of foresight drawn as a spindle of pale light that unspools toward tomorrow. Those who hold it trace a coming moment back through the threads of now, and the farther the thread runs, the more the image blurs into fog. Knowing the fog can be worked, its keepers reweave the present to bend what is yet to come.

rites.name: Eluala
rites.text: Eluala is a concept of foresight, a quiet sense that drifts ahead of the present and lets its bearer glimpse the next moments of a fight or a storm. Those who learn to hold its gaze on the future can read threats and reflexes through the mind rather than the body. Veneiluana's oldest seers still speak of it as the first sense to wake in a newborn world.

rites.name: Oriameth
rites.text: Oriameth is a seer-spirit of the Veneiluana arcane tides, who reads the braided threads of coming moments and whispers the outcomes to those who listen. Her gifts sharpen allies' blows, blunt enemies' aim, and let the favored slip through danger on borrowed time.

rites.name: Miimaennys
rites.text: Miimaennys is a dormant sea of silver foresight that drifts beneath the cloud-ridden archipelago of Veneiluana, where its tides carry whispered warnings to any mind that dares to listen. Scholars of the third age believe the sea remembers futures that have not yet happened, and those who swim too deep rarely return with their memories intact.

rites.name: Mierwen
rites.text: Mierwen is a veil of silver quiet that settles over the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, stripping enchantments back to the bare threads of ordinary matter. Scholars of the fourth age treat it less as a power than as a patient tide that wears down every spell it touches.

rites.name: Eluamireth
rites.text: Eluamireth is a veil of disruptive static that the Veneiluana courts reserve for wardens who unmake lesser sorceries with a touch. Its bearers can shatter petty enchantments and deaden the will of casters they hold, though the deepest rites still answer their own call. The sigil of a warden's oath is said to hum faintly whenever a ward is undone nearby.

rites.name: Venuarla
rites.text: Venuarla is a psionic nullification technique practiced in the Veneiluana arcane tradition, letting a mind unmake the threads of a targeted being's existence. Its variants, called prefixes, can widen its reach into an aura, harden its grip, or sever supernatural effects clinging to a foe. Practitioners of the third age regard it as a discipline of quiet unmaking rather than brute force.

rites.name: Venuarleth
rites.text: Venuarleth is a silver-threaded concept of pure unmaking, an arcane discipline in the Veneiluana cosmos said to undo the workings of other minds and sorceries alike. Its practitioners learn to sever enchantments, banish wandering spirits, and hold their own thoughts like a sealed fortress against intrusion. Its strongest form can strip the protective wards from an entire realm of living magic.

rites.name: Silarlinwen
rites.text: Silarlinwen is a drifting concept of hunger woven into the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, born four ages ago from the fear that minds can be emptied. It feeds on the inner light of other thinkers, drawing out their memories, dreads, and quickening sparks until only quiet husks remain.

rites.name: Orierionys
rites.text: Orierionys is a silver-threaded memory-current that a Veneiluana sage can draw from a creature's mind, borrowing one of its trained abilities for a span of rest. Only one borrowed knowledge may be held at a time, so each new theft releases the prior one like a dropped thread.

rites.name: Elinora
rites.text: Elinora is a psionic parasite that feeds on the mental energy of living minds and the fading thoughts of the recently dead, sustaining itself through stolen mind-power. Its tendrils, woven from consumed cognition, can unravel a rival's will and drink it dry.

rites.name: Venuamae
rites.text: Venuamae is a concept-born arcane current woven through the ninth dusk of Veneiluana, a drifting tide of hunger that feeds on the warmth of living minds. Its scholars speak of a single breath that can unmake a mountain's silence in a heartbeat. Those who learn to channel it pay with their own vitality, drawing ruin from the pulse of others.

rites.name: Miilennys
rites.text: Miilennys is a lattice of resonant thought-currents that threads through the minds of the Veneiluana cosmos, letting a bearer feel and sway the inner weather of nearby beings. Its adepts are known to drift toward a silent sympathy that few of them survive intact.

rites.name: Eliometh
rites.text: Eliometh is an arcane concept woven into the Veneiluana, a bond that lets a mind read another's intent through calculated reason rather than instinct. Once a telepathic thread has been shared with a willing soul, Eliometh keeps a faint compass needle pointing toward that soul for an hour, so long as both remain within the same plane.

rites.name: Venala
rites.text: Venala is an arcane mind-discipline of the sixth epoch, a practice of whispering counterfeit thoughts into rival minds until their own reasoning turns against them. Its adepts gather fragments of a defeated foe's certainty and hold them like loaded dice for the next confrontation. The art is quiet, but at its height a single well-placed doubt can topple a tower of ten thousand soldiers.

rites.name: Alaalora
rites.text: Alaalora is a silver-threaded mind-art practiced in the Veneiluana courts of the fourth age, where scholars channel the sharpness of their reasoning into the force of their psychic strikes. At the sixth rung of mastery an adept learns to fold the keenness of their intellect into every blow of discipline, turning a clever thought into a lance of raw mental power.

rites.name: Lyemaerlys
rites.text: Lyemaerlys is a concept of arcane perception in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, where a practitioner senses the minds of thinking beings as though by a sixth sense. Those who master it can detect creatures of sufficient wit within a close radius, even through darkness or concealment. The Lyemaerlys art is taught as a discipline of attention rather than a force of destruction.

rites.name: Ryerleth
rites.text: Ryerleth is a fleeting, lucid state of mind in which the Veneiluanan adept's thoughts briefly unfold into perfect clarity, letting them anticipate every blow and resist every snare. It is said to be the dawn-glimpse that the cloud-scholars of Ostrevane spend lifetimes trying to hold for longer than a breath.

rites.name: Lyirlae
rites.text: Lyirlae is a discipline of the Veneiluana arcane arts, taught in the age of the fourth Vellum-Dawn to adepts who have mastered the inward channels of the mind. Its practitioners reshape their own flesh at will, slipping into borrowed forms and swelling or shrinking their stature for a fraction of the usual mental toll.

rites.name: Mielwen
rites.text: Mielwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's sixth era, a mending art taught to psionic healers who weave restoration through the flesh of the wounded. Its practitioners pay small inner reserves to knit wounds and can layer further reserves to deepen the healing, then send a surge of borrowed vigor into the same patient as a quickening follow-up.

rites.name: Lyerlys
rites.text: Lyerlys is a disciplined art of self-reshaping drawn from the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, taught only to those who have first mastered bodily restraint and enhancement. Its practitioners may alter their own form freely, but reshaping another being requires knowledge held by separate, older traditions. The third age of the Sixth Era saw it spread widely among the cloistered orders of the northern highlands.

rites.name: Alaameth
rites.text: Alaameth is a dormant mode of arcane self-tuning, cultivated in the cloistered sanctums of Veneiluana where practitioners learn to reshape their own physical bearing for a single breath. Its adepts describe it as trading muscle for mind, a brief inversion that lasts only until the next dawn of their turn.

rites.name: Mialae
rites.text: Mialae is an arcane discipline in the Veneiluana cosmos, a refined method of drawing on inner resonance to reinforce the body in the middle of a struggle. Practitioners who have mastered its foundations can invoke it with a quicker, lighter gesture, trading raw potency for speed. Its use is taught slowly, since the lesser form requires disciplined control over one's own resonance.

rites.name: Veneirae
rites.text: Veneirae is a discipline of quiet restoration, practiced in the reconstructed halls of Veneiluana by adepts who learned to braid mending into the fabric of living thought. Its masters can knit the wounds of many bodies at once and call a lost soul back into a fresh vessel, provided they gather the rare ashes and relics the rite demands.

rites.name: Eleineth
rites.text: Eleineth is a concept of conjured arms, a discipline in which the mind shapes blades and bows out of pure intent, then hurls them across the battlefield. Practitioners of the Veneiluana arcane schools prize its quickness, and its formations of projected steel can cut a rampart's wall into rubble.

rites.name: Venimys
rites.text: Venimys is a mind-craft in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, born in the sixth era three ages ago, that lets practitioners solidify their mental projections into lasting matter. Adepts shape stone walls and crafted goods from thought, paying a toll of inner focus for each measure of substance they make real.

rites.name: Eliomaenwen
rites.text: Eliomaenwen is a discipline of the Veneiluana arcane tradition that lets a practitioner conjure a drifting swarm of luminous, insubstantial tools and furniture from raw thought. The craft was codified in the fourth age, when psions learned to spend inner reserve to weave new forms rather than reshape existing ones.

rites.name: Ilyarlora
rites.text: Ilyarlora is a veiled discipline in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, in which practitioners weave a silver mirror-self from thought and lend it their place in the world. Its adepts treat the exchange of position with their construct as the finest trick of composure, costing only a sliver of inner focus.

rites.name: Alainemys
rites.text: Alainemys is a discipline of the Veneiluana arcane realm, taught in the sixth era as a method of binding one's own vitality to the shapes conjured by a mage. Practitioners learn to redirect harm from a crystallized construct into their own body, bearing its wounds while hardening against them.

rites.name: Nuemuarlys
rites.text: Nuemuarlys is a discipline of thought-sculpting in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, practiced by those who have trained their minds to shape the raw stuff of possibility. Adepts who master it can weave several imagined qualities into a single construct at once, letting a conjured bridge also be a lantern and a sentinel. Its power grows steadily with age, and the Veneiluanan scholars of the Fourth Epoch regard it as the most dangerous craft their realm has ever codified.

rites.name: Ilyinwen
rites.text: Ilyinwen is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's fourth age, a practice of pressing unseen force from the mind into the world. Adepts loose their pressure as a shaped concussive pulse that strikes foes at range, each strike carrying a lingering mental imprint.

rites.name: Silannys
rites.text: Silannys is a mental discipline practiced by the wind-shepherds of Veneiluana, who learn to borrow the weightlessness of falling leaves and drifting spores. A practitioner spends a spark of focused will to lengthen a stride, cling to sheer stone, or float gently down from a cliff, and may renew that hold on the next breath before it fades.

rites.name: Venirwen
rites.text: venirwen is a kinetic resonance field that projects a fragment of the caster’s aura into the air, forming a translucent blade that can be directed toward a target. the blade follows a curved trajectory, slicing through matter with a whisper of psychic energy, and can be multiplied by channeling additional aura reserves. the field dissipates after striking, leaving a faint afterimage that lingers for a moment before fading.

rites.name: Ilyarlys
rites.text: Ilyarlys is a primordial resonance that binds matter to intention across the veneiluana continuum. When invoked it collapses the distance between will and motion letting thought alone accelerate mass to relativistic speeds. The effect scales with the clarity of the wielder's focus from lifting a stone to shattering a world's crust.

rites.name: Venillerys
rites.text: Venillerys is a veil of thinly spread psychic force that a practitioner can stretch into a long wall or a wide dome around themselves, shimmering with drifting motes of dust and debris. Within its shimmer, arrows and bolts veer off course, and it slowly unravels once the caster's attention wavers after a minute.

rites.name: Alaarlys
rites.text: Alaarlys is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's third age, a teaching that lets practitioners bend loose matter and shape the trajectories of arrows and bolts meant for their allies. Its adepts are trained to gather scattered fragments of their surroundings into ordered, moving forms. Rivals say the discipline is less a weapon than a patient argument with gravity.

rites.name: Ilyiniolora
rites.text: Ilyiniolora is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a mental art of drawing and shaping force by will alone. Its adepts learn to split stone and air with a thought, turning a blade's intended strike into a stumble through a hand of pushing psychic pressure.

rites.name: Mienneimae
rites.text: Mienneimae is a discipline of mental grip taught in the high halls of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, where adepts learn to seize objects and bodies with thought alone. Practitioners hold their grasp by sustained focus, so a broken concentration releases everything at once. It is a concept of the third age, studied more as a method of restraint than of destruction.

rites.name: Venerlioma
rites.text: Venerlioma is a cosmic concept of shared suffering, a silent covenant woven through the arcane currents of Veneiluana. Whenever a bonded creature falters under harm, Venerlioma steps between the blow and its victim, swallowing a portion of the wound while exacting its own price in psychic agony.

rites.name: Elaemeilwen
rites.text: Elaemeilwen is a silver-threaded mind-weaver of the Veneiluana, a discipline that lays vivid false visions over the thoughts of others until they cannot tell dream from waking. Her illusions are said to be so clear that a whole army once marched into a river believing it a meadow. She rarely strikes with force, yet her quiet deceptions have toppled empires.

rites.name: Nueliel
rites.text: Nueliel is a veil-weaving discipline in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where practitioners brush the edges of a listener's inner weather to coax out drifting worries and settle them like dust. The art rests on patience and a light hand, and it grows weak against minds sealed by silent wards.

rites.name: Eleinnora
rites.text: Eleinnora is a psychic mirror-art practiced by the wardens of Veneiluana's arcane orders, who turn an enemy's blow back into a tide of mental agony. Its wielders spend inner reserves of psi to echo the pain they suffered, but never more than they themselves endured.

rites.name: Ilyerla
rites.text: Ilyerla is a mindspeech art by which a Veneiluana adept broadcasts the weak place in a foe's guard to every ally who shares the link. Whenever a creature falters before the adept's intrusion, the adept can signal an ally to strike at the opening from up to thirty feet away.

rites.name: Ilyamora
rites.text: Ilyamora is a discipline of silent kinship, a thread of thought that stretches across any distance once two minds have shared a word within the day. Its bearer must spend a moment of focus to speak through the dark when the other cannot be seen, and may hold only as many such threads as their reasoning can bear.

rites.name: Ryilae
rites.text: Ryilae is a veil-weave technique in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, taught to disciplined practitioners who first master the art of stepping between shifted layers of space. Its signature motion lets a wielder tear a seam through the fabric of a moment and strike from both sides of it at once. Its cost is steep, since the tear drinks at the wielder's reserves with every second strike.

rites.name: Alaenwen
rites.text: Alaenwen is a rift-tuned arcane craft in which a shooter's phase power is folded into a single round of ammunition. The enchanted projectile slips through thin barriers, strikes with a sharp force burst, and can split into a second shot.

rites.name: Venereina
rites.text: Venereina is a dormant veil-current that drifts through the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, sometimes gathering into a single violet thread that a trained adept can coax into their blade. Its power lies in slipping between a foe's guard and the instant of contact, so the strike lands wherever the current has been. Scholars of the fourth age still debate whether it is a force or merely a habit of the mind.

rites.name: Oriemora
rites.text: Oriemora is a dormant discipline of mirrored breath practiced in the drifting cloud-towns of Veneiluana's fourth age. Its adepts channel spent inner force into a shimmering veil that hardens briefly around the body, sheltering them from harm in the moments after they slip through a shard of folded space.

rites.name: Lyareimys
rites.text: Lyareimys is a reflex-coil of folded thought that an adept of the Veneiluana Ashwright houses, letting a practitioner slip briefly through space at the moment of striking. Its discipline is taught only to those who have already mastered the stillness of the inner gate.

rites.name: Silionna
rites.text: Silionna is a veil-skilled tactic in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, where a practitioner who slips through space can leave a narrow seam of torn air hanging behind them. Anyone who wanders into the seam is caught by the same unmaking pull that the original slip exerts. Its use is a hard-won discipline taught to those who have already mastered the art of shifting position.

rites.name: Lyimys
rites.text: Lyimys is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a sheltering veil of kinetic force that a practitioner draws around the body, flickering with flame, frost, or storm. It bolsters the bearer briefly and punishes those who strike it, recharging only after a period of rest.

rites.name: Alaaruamora
rites.text: Alaaruamora is a mental discipline of Veneiluana, a way of channeling one's inner resolve through the shaping of cold, fire, and lightning. Each elemental strike steadies the mind for a short while, sharpening the will, the endurance, or the reflexes depending on the element used. Adepts who specialize in one element find this protection grows far more potent.

rites.name: Oriela
rites.text: Oriela is a dormant concept of tempered psychic flame in the Veneiluana arcane tradition, a discipline that lets an adept wrap their mind in a burning ward without drawing on their reserves. Its single free casting resets only after a full rest, and an adept who wishes to repeat it sooner must pay a heavy toll of inner energy.

rites.name: Mialys
rites.text: Mialys is a concept of the Veneiluana omniverse: a discipline that lets a mind pour its raw feeling into the world as a small elemental spirit. The spirit is a creature of pure mood rather than thought, obeying its maker's will for a brief moment before dissolving back into the emotion that birthed it.

rites.name: Eluaminna
rites.text: Eluaminna is a foresight-keeper of Veneiluana's third age, a concept that lets a mind slip briefly past the veil of an incoming enchantment or mental assault. By spending a spark of inner focus, the bearer reads the shape of the threat and steadies their will against it.

rites.name: Eleimanys
rites.text: Eleimanys is a discipline of foresight in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, letting a practitioner glimpse the next moment of their own future and act on it swiftly. Its adepts rely on it for quick reflexes rather than for battle-shattering force.

rites.name: Venanerae
rites.text: Venanerae is a dreaming-discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, practised by seers who rest in silent chambers until dawn opens the future to them. On waking they pass fore-seen counsel to their allies, steadying them against the coming hours. Its adepts carry the quiet authority of those who have already lived the day in sleep.

rites.name: Elaelerae
rites.text: Elaelerae is a stillness-craft practiced in the drowned archives of Veneiluana, where adepts learn to quiet the hum of arcane resonance in a foe's body. Its practitioners wear light plate and carry a ward-disk in one hand while keeping the other free for weapon or gesture. A brief touch can silence a target's working for a moment before the disk's glow fades.

rites.name: Venaellora
rites.text: Venaellora is a sealed ward-geometry of the Veneiluana, a silent lattice of inverted sigils that drinks at the edge of every working cast within its reach. It is said to have been woven by scholars who wished to stop their own spells from becoming weapons against their children. Its wardens teach it as a discipline of stillness, where the body learns to shed mystic force like rain sheds from slate.

rites.name: Veniollora
rites.text: Veniollora is a quiet discipline of the Arcane realm in the Veneiluana, practiced by those who learn to sense and sever the hidden threads of enchantment. Its adepts turn incoming sorcery into harmless murmur, and in the third age of the E6 era they are sought by rulers wary of hostile magic.

rites.name: Nuariel
rites.text: Nuariel is a discipline of silence practiced by Veneiluana's hush-monks, who learn to unmake the thrum of arcane force within a bounded sphere for a time. Its practitioners guard their single unmaking carefully, since it must rest for a full cycle of sleep before it can be drawn again.

rites.name: Venimiel
rites.text: Venimiel is a concept of arcane discipline in Veneiluana's sixth era, where a practitioner who has mastered consumption may reach through the bond of fear or fascination to drain another mind. The reach extends across a hundred and twenty feet, requires no line of sight, and leaves the victim weaker in resisting it.

rites.name: Alaireth
rites.text: Alaireth is a concept in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, an enduring discipline of borrowed mastery in which a practitioner holds a shifting set of learned abilities. Its technique lets the wielder hold extra borrowed talents at once, half their measure of attunement rounded down, and forces the oldest held talent to dissolve when a new one would exceed that count.

rites.name: Elemwen
rites.text: Elemwen is a discipline of mental leeching in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where practitioners draw strength from the thoughts of those they hold close. Trained minds learn to channel borrowed cognition into physical might while grappling their prey. Its practitioners are feared for how completely they can unmake an opponent's will.

rites.name: Mieneth
rites.text: Mieneth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's fourth age, describing the discipline of reanimating the dead through lingering psionic will. Practitioners lend a fragment of their focus to a body, which then stirs with borrowed purpose until that focus is withdrawn or renewed.

rites.name: Venalys
rites.text: Venalys is a psionic technique in the arcane tradition of Veneiluana, where a mind-trained caster spends a single point of psychic reserve to weave temporary limbs of force from thought. The constructions last ten minutes, take whatever form the caster imagines, and dissolve the moment the caster falls unconscious or dies.

rites.name: Lyaraenae
rites.text: Lyaraenae is a silent sensing faculty that lets a mind read the luminous halos of living things, spotting enchantment and psionic influence at a glance. It draws on a single point of inner resonance, leaving the wider world of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana untouched by its reach. Its keenness is what unmasks shapeshifters and the disguised, though its power rarely troubles the stars.

rites.name: Oriireimys
rites.text: Oriireimys is a dormant sigil-lattice threaded through the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, said to wake sleeping minds across the fourth era. Its bearers may rouse a sleeper once without drawing on reserves, then must rest fully before the lattice will answer again.

rites.name: Silennys
rites.text: Silennys is a sustained arcane ray that its wielders loose as a long, humming lance of elemental force, held steady only by the caster's unbroken will. Ancient archives of Veneiluana record its use to bore channels through frozen ridges and to pin storm-spirits in place.

rites.name: Silamionora
rites.text: Silamionora is a quiet technique of the Veneiluana arcane schools that lets a practitioner dim the luminous sheen and gestured motion of a mind-born art, so that the working passes unseen by rivals. Each concealed casting drains a growing toll of inner reserve, which only restful stillness restores.

rites.name: Ryennaliel
rites.text: Ryennaliel is a metamorphic sorcerous technique in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, born in the third age of the E6 era as scholars refined the art of splitting a mind into cooperating shadows. It allows an adept to stretch the duration of a self-division by drawing reserves of inner resonance, at the cost of a small, deliberate fraying of the caster's focus.

rites.name: Venuana
rites.text: Venuana is a dormant sleep-current woven through the Veneiluana, a gentle tide of thought that carries memories between sleepers. Its attendants, the Lull-wardens, can briefly invert the tide to pull a whole valley into a single shared reverie.

rites.name: Ryalinniel
rites.text: Ryalinniel is a concept of pure attunement in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a discipline that lets a mind slip past the defenses a foe has built against fire, frost, or lightning. Practitioners of the third age learn to spend a spark of inner will so that elemental force bypasses ward and warding alike. Adepts who master it can turn an enemy's immunity into mere resistance.

rites.name: Lyiruannora
rites.text: Lyiruannora is a psionic technique wielded by Veneiluana's arcane duelists, who charge a blade in hand with focused mind-force before each strike. When the edge lands, the channelled power erupts through the target and, if sculpted into a wide burst, reaches every nearby foe as though struck directly.

rites.name: Mienora
rites.text: Mienora is a quiet rite of the Veneiluana arcanists, a practice of pouring one's own vitality into a fading thread of the world so that it may keep burning. Its practitioners are known less for dramatic battles than for sustaining dying groves and failing lamps across the third age. The art asks for steady patience and a willingness to be emptied.

rites.name: Lyereth
rites.text: Lyereth is an arcane art of the Veneiluana school that lets a trained mind siphon thought-energy from foes at the cost of a small reserve. When a sentient creature falls near its practitioner, the practitioner can seize the fading mental current and convert it into renewed vigor and restored reserve.

rites.name: Venioreth
rites.text: Venioreth is a sensory bond woven by the Arcane sages of Veneiluana, allowing one to share the sight and hearing of a willing companion for an hour at a time. The one who lends their senses goes dark and silent to their own world, yet the bonded ally grows steadier in mind and spirit while the link holds.

rites.name: Ryirae
rites.text: Ryirae is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a mind-art that lets a practitioner hold several sustained workings at once by freezing the body in place. The adept's stillness becomes a lattice that keeps every thread alive, yet a single misstep unravels the weakest strand and a grave lapse collapses them all.

rites.name: Alaimeth
rites.text: Alaimeth is the quiet discipline of the Veneiluana arcane powers, a mental art where a mind that resists a psychic assault still bears a portion of its wound. Those who master it learn to soften their own shocks and turn the residue of failed defenses into a dull, harmless ache rather than lasting harm.

rites.name: Eleimae
rites.text: Eleimae is a mental ward-discipline practiced by the lantern-scholars of Veneiluana, who teach the mind to weave a shimmering lattice of thought around the body when no plate or wood is held. The lattice deflects blows by bending the intent behind them, and it strengthens as the practitioner's reasoning sharpens.

rites.name: Eluannys
rites.text: Eluannys is a dreaming sorcery-concept of Veneiluana, a mind-born sigil that gives form to a waking nightmare so vivid it grips the watcher's will. Its manifestations are not physically destructive but leave a lasting dread in any creature that lingers too near its shape.

rites.name: Alainuamora
rites.text: Alainuamora is a mental technique practiced in the Veneiluana powers tradition, letting an adept split their awareness so that two acts unfold in the same moment. Its practitioners pay a single spark of inner force to hold the division, and the two halves draw from one shared reservoir.

rites.name: Siluamwen
rites.text: Siluamwen is a mental art taught in the drifting monasteries of Veneiluana, where adepts learn to hurl their own bodies across open air by shaping invisible force around their limbs. Practitioners treat each bound as a small act of faith, leaping up to twenty feet in one motion while the wind bends away from their path. Its masters are said to have once cleared a ravine wider than a river delta in a single breath.

rites.name: Siluannae
rites.text: Siluannae is a concept of restrained fury in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where a mind's simmering wrath is channeled into a growing reserve of force. The longer it is provoked and wounded, the more its inner tempest swells toward a sudden, cataclysmic release. Practitioners call it the quiet ember that learns to become a storm.

rites.name: Elameth
rites.text: Elameth is a concept of disciplined sorcery in Veneiluana, a mind-state where a caster holds two incantations in balance without wavering. Those who hold this balance drift upward on a faint current of their own will, drifting slowly but never breaking the poise that keeps them aloft.

rites.name: Alainwen
rites.text: Alainwen is a mindsight art of Veneiluana's arcane tradition, letting its practitioners perceive the thoughts of nearby minds as though seeing them through a fog. Its reach grows with each refinement of the practice, and it quietly reshapes how ambushes and blinding tricks work against the adept.

rites.name: Alainnerys
rites.text: Alainnerys is a concept-grade beam of arcane force, a lance of cold, flame, pressure, or lightning that its wielder may sweep through the air and hold steady by will alone. Its duration is measured not in minutes but in the stubbornness of the caster, and each redirection hurls the energy through any foe caught in its arc.

rites.name: Venaema
rites.text: Venaema is a mind-reading art practised in the drifting tide-cities of Veneiluana, where a trained adept can press a silent question into another creature's thoughts. The target answers with a fleeting image or whisper, unless its own will resists, and those who resist once grow wary of the same probing for the rest of the day.

rites.name: Mierliel
rites.text: Mierliel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a silver-threaded lens that lets a mind peer into another mind's recollections. It works only on what the subject itself remembers, so it reveals a reflection of the past rather than the truth of it. Practitioners say it is gentle with the sleeper and cruel to the one who looks too long.

rites.name: Alaimys
rites.text: Alaimys is an arcane concept in the Veneiluana omniverse, a necrotic lattice of shadow-threads that erupts outward from a caster in every direction and seizes chosen foes, dragging them inward. Its threads drink vitality from those they strike and feed a portion of it back into the caster's own flesh.

rites.name: Venalimys
rites.text: Venalimys is a mirror-thread of arcane duplication in Veneiluana, where a caster splits into twin selves for a brief span. Only one twin may hold the caster's charged relics, and the choice of which self remains is made at dawn of the following turn.

rites.name: Miariolla
rites.text: Miariolla is a clairvoyant seer-spirit of the Veneiluana arcane courts, a pale luminous lattice that drifts above battlefields and offers flickering glimpses of what is yet to come. Those it touches sense the next blow before it lands, though the gift fades once the foreseen moment arrives.

rites.name: Siluarlae
rites.text: Siluarlae is a veil-walking art of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, letting its practitioner slip between the solid and the unseen for a brief span. During that flicker, each blow that would land has a chance to pass harmlessly through the caster or be softened into nothing.

rites.name: Silenneth
rites.text: Silenneth is a duelist-spirit of the Veneiluana's quiet Arcane realm, who sings no words but cuts the air into silence. Those who witness her shift say she leaves behind only a ringing void where her enemies once stood. She is said to be age seven in the realm's reckoning, yet has already carved a reputation across the Seventh Hollow.

rites.name: Ryeriel
rites.text: Ryeriel is a gravity-weaving discipline in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, practiced by wardens who bend the pull of the earth around a single creature. Its adepts can hurl a foe skyward to drop them like a stone or fling them sideways into the nearest wall. Such manipulations carry a bruising cost, and reckless use has earned the art a cautious reputation.

rites.name: Oriinnereth
rites.text: Oriinnereth is a concept of fated nudges within the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a binding lattice that lets its bearer tilt the outcome of any struggle near them. Its power is spent in small increments, so every adjustment costs a fragment of the bearer's own fortune. Its place in the era of the sixth age is that of a quiet arbiter, feared more for its subtlety than its force.

rites.name: Nuenirlys
rites.text: Nuenirlys is a telekinetic sorcery-concept of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, letting a practitioner hurl a loose object across a short stretch of air. Its force scales with the amount of spent arcane reserve, so that heavier throws and harder impacts become possible at higher tiers.

rites.name: Oriirys
rites.text: Oriirys is a quiet thread of borrowed mind-craft that the Veneiluana sages weave into willing hosts, sharpening a chosen talent until it sings. The effect lingers only while the weaving holds, and the hosts often report a strange clarity that fades when the thread is cut.

rites.name: Siliora
rites.text: Siliora is a concept of living magic in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a sacrificial rite in which a caster bleeds some of their own vitality into another's wounds. The old healers of the third age measured the cost in grey hollows left behind on the caster's skin.

rites.name: Eleinalae
rites.text: Eleinalae is a concept of Arcane nature from the Veneiluana omniverse, dating to the third age of the sixth era, that grants its bearer a heightened mental steadiness and shield against pure thought and force. It is a fleeting ward whose strength grows as the caster draws more deeply upon the currents of the world.

rites.name: Nuemilwen
rites.text: Nuemilwen is a psychic discharge that Veneiluana's Arcane mind-tradition developed in its sixth age, a cone of mental force that rattles thought itself. Those who stand in its path must wrestle their own minds or be left reeling, and the discipline is taught only to keep it from being used carelessly.

rites.name: Nualuaneth
rites.text: Nualuaneth is a shapeshifting enchantment of the Veneiluana Arcane realm, letting a caster reshape their flesh into whatever form the moment requires. Its practitioners are said to reconfigure their bodies mid-battle, trading limbs and armor as readily as a cloak. It is a fleeting art, lasting only while the caster's will holds the flesh in its new design.

rites.name: Silaeniel
rites.text: Silaeniel is a concept of Arcane tuning in the Veneiluana omniverse, a practice in which a caster tunes their own inner resonance to siphon the quiet mental fire of a nearby mind. The siphoned fire knits temporary vigor into the caster and can restore a spent reserve of focus, though the victim's mind is left ringing. Its strength scales with the tier of the tuning vessel used to hold the draw.

rites.name: Elaraenae
rites.text: Elaraenae is a concept of a pulsing resonance that ripples outward through the arcane weave of Veneiluana, bending air and matter from its center. Its shockwave can flatten a cluster of nearby foes or leave the steadiest of them merely staggered, and it has been known to cleave stone from a hillside. Its strongest tremors are said to have been felt across an entire realm of the era.

rites.name: Lyeraemae
rites.text: Lyeraemae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a discipline of mind that perceives the hidden folds between dimensions and bends them. Its practitioners slip through the gaps of space as easily as water through a crack, reshaping their own relation to distance. Their mental reach can rearrange the geometry of a battlefield in a single thought.

rites.name: Miarys
rites.text: Miarys is a spell-woven resonance of the Veneiluana powers, a step-through that leaves a rippling fold behind to jolt anyone nearby. Practitioners of the E6 era used it to ferry companions and cargo across broken ground.

rites.name: Nuaneilleth
rites.text: Nuaneilleth is an arcane discipline of the Veneiluana, in which a practitioner coaxes a creature's dormant mental reserves into full bloom.
