Those who master it can nudge a single roll per turn beyond the limits of their own body, at the cost of a sharp mental wound each time. The discipline is prized in the courts of the E6 era and feared by those who have seen its overuse.

rites.name: Ryimiolae
rites.text: Ryimiolae is a mind-tuning rite in the Veneiluana Arcane realm, in which a practitioner already attuned to inner resonance coaxes a dormant faculty awake from the quiet depths of thought. The awakened talent is chosen from a fixed canon of mental arts and may not repeat one already mastered or one still gated behind seniority. Its earliest adepts described it as opening a door that had always been there, only unlocked by patience.

rites.name: Elionwen
rites.text: Elionwen is a dormant mind-current that stirs in the thoughts of Veneiluana's Arcane Realm adepts, awakening a faint resonance wherever a student is taught to listen inward. Its single spark can be kindled once and then rests until the bearer has recovered in quiet sleep or prolonged calm. Scholars treat it as the first whisper of a larger will.

rites.name: Ilyarys
rites.text: Ilyarys is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Veneiluana omniverse, a discipline in which an adept's inner reserves of vital force grow stronger with each use. Practitioners recover their own strength as they spend these reserves, so every exertion becomes a form of renewal. Its legends describe a lamp that burns brighter the more it is fed.

rites.name: Ryerys
rites.text: Ryerys is a quiet arcane principle in the Veneiluana cosmos, a slow accretion of inner reserve that lets a mind hold one more measure of focus than before. It does not strike or shatter; it deepens the well from which a practitioner draws, so that each new point of stored will is a small, steady widening of what the self can carry.

rites.name: Oriarliel
rites.text: Oriarliel is a sigil-weave that thickens the wellspring within a practitioner, granting one more measure of inner vigor that can be spent on arcane discipline. Scholars of the Veneiluana arcana describe it as a single, quiet thread added to a loom already strung with countless others.

rites.name: Elimora
rites.text: Elimora is a concept of disciplined mental combat in Veneiluana's arcane realm, where a practitioner's focus stays unbroken under fire and strikes can be woven into the moment a foe moves. Its adepts channel psionic force through practiced gestures even while gripping a blade or buckler, turning every opening into a measured counterblow.

rites.name: Alaimaerlys
rites.text: Alaimaerlys is an arcane discipline in Veneiluana's sixth era, where a commander's presence can awaken latent force in allies. Those touched by it hold one stored strike that lingers until their next turn passes, then fades if unspent. The practice is taught in silent academies beneath the drifting spires of the Veil Marches.

rites.name: Alaereth
rites.text: Alaereth is a battle-cantor of the Veneiluana, an arcane concept born in the sixth epoch when hymns were first woven into war-bands. Their presence turns a scattered company into a single pulse of intent, letting allies strike harder and recover from each blow they take. In the old songs they are remembered as the voice that could halt a falling banner in midair.

rites.name: Oriimwen
rites.text: Oriimwen is a rallying chant that gathers the will of nearby comrades into a single surge of striking power. Those who answer it strike harder and draw strength back from each blow they land. Its voice is said to carry across the battlefield like a thunderclap.

rites.name: Eliniorlys
rites.text: Eliniorlys is an arcane concept in Veneiluana's sixth era, describing a commander's art of spending gathered resonance to nudge a chosen ally into a swift, unguarded retreat or advance. The bolstered comrade also gains a protective shell of borrowed vitality scaled to the resonance spent. It is a tactic of the lesser battle-chanters rather than a cosmic force.

rites.name: Ryaluannora
rites.text: Ryaluannora is a concept of coordinated aid in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a skill that lets a tactician lend strength to an ally from a distance of thirty feet, so long as the one being aided can perceive the helper by sight or sound. It is a thing of quick signals and shared resolve rather than raw force.

rites.name: Venilwen
rites.text: In the ethereal realm of Lumina, the entity Venilwen embodies the essence of persuasive resonance, doubling the potency of any emotional or intellectual influence it projects.

rites.name: Elilaereth
rites.text: Elilaereth is a sealed resonance of the Veneiluana arcane weave, a dormant concept that wakes only when a bearer's will steadies the flow of ambient song. Scholars of the E6 age describe it as a lattice that rewards persistence, granting its carriers a sudden surge of physical command once their discipline ripens.

rites.name: Orialiel
rites.text: Orialiel is a woven discipline of arcane motion, taught in the drifting monasteries of Veneiluana's fourth age, where practitioners learn to strike with a second intent before the first has finished falling. Its adepts are reputed to split a single breath into two complete strikes, each carrying the weight of a small collapsing bell. The art is considered a rite of passage rather than a weapon, and masters caution that the second blow is always the one that reveals the student's true aim.

rites.name: Silinys
rites.text: Silinys is a concept of Arcane nature from the Veneiluana omniverse, an E6 construct of the fourth age. It is a rite of preparation in which a bearer readies five companions by drawing a measure of stored resolve into them as a shield of borrowed vitality, which then lingers until rest restores the wearer.

rites.name: Veneillema
rites.text: Veneillema is a living crystal that channels the vitality of one wounded ally into a wave of healing that touches several nearby companions. When a creature is restored, the crystal siphons that boon and disperses it, sharing the same amount of health with others. It also serves as a shield, absorbing and redistributing kinetic blows to protect those it touches.

rites.name: Ryemuareth
rites.text: Ryemuareth is a concept of disciplined certainty in the arcane realm of Veneiluana, an inner habit a seasoned tactician learns to impose on fate. Once per rest cycle, the bearer may set a chance-test to a settled outcome equal to their rank, sparing the die its tumble. The cost is that the gesture cannot be repeated until the bearer has fully restored their strength.

rites.name: Venaleriel
rites.text: Venaleriel is a rallying discipline of the Arcane realm, taught in the sixth era to commanders who can call their allies out of harm's way with a single resonant word. A chosen rank of up to five companions who can hear the call stride swiftly to safer ground, the caller spending a reserve of tempered resolve to do so.

rites.name: Venerlalwen
rites.text: Venerlalwen is a veil of silver frost-light that drapes over the dreams of Veneiluana's oldest sovereigns, granting them a stillness no terror or enchantment can pierce. Those who wear it stand unmoved while armies break and courtiers swoon, their resolve sealed like a glacier over a stream. It was woven two ages ago and has never once been unravelled.

rites.name: Alaema
rites.text: Alaema is a concept of borrowed resolve: a discipline in which a commander's tactical gift is stored as spent dice that can be spent again. In the Arcane realm of Veneiluana it operates in the sixth era, quietly, through the people who choose to follow.

rites.name: Eleimiel
rites.text: Eleimiel is a veiled warden-spirit of the Arcane realm, bound to the lantern-stars of Veneiluana's third age. Its presence hardens the wills of those who stand beside it, granting steadiness with blade and bulwark alike.

rites.name: Ilyirae
rites.text: Ilyirae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a stillness-bearing principle that gathers willing companions into its wake whenever a bearer first strides into motion. Those who follow it drift along its path but never outpace their own strength, and any of them may halt at will.

rites.name: Elaemeirora
rites.text: Elaemeirora is a resonant war-chant in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, sung by sworn vanguards of the second age to bind their comrades into a shared shell of borrowed vitality. Its voice carries a bulwark of spare life that gathers around each listener and fades only when the storm of battle has passed.

rites.name: Alaenae
rites.text: Alaenae is the quiet resonance that hums through the lattice of Veneiluana's oldest arcane wells, a concept rather than a being, shaping how sparks of will are drawn into a single decisive strike. Its influence is measured in the moment before a blow lands, when a practitioner's chosen focus sharpens into near-certain aim. Scholars of the E6 era debate whether it was ever truly a power or only a name for an old habit of the mind.

rites.name: Nueruama
rites.text: Nueruama is a bargain-sigil in the Veneiluana arcane tradition, a ward that lets a bearer convert borrowed vitality into a surge of blade-force once they step into battle. Its seers say the sigil is a sealed promise kept between flesh and fate, and that each unspent point of it hums like a struck bell. Those who learn its discipline can turn a fading ward into a final, decisive strike.

rites.name: Sileilinae
rites.text: Sileilinae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, an old pact-sense that binds a hunter's strikes to the wounds its companions have already opened. When a striker follows an ally's injury, the blow tears deeper, and the strongest of these bindings can split a moon's crust.

rites.name: Nuireirleth
rites.text: Nuireirleth is a concept of resonant speech that pulls the will of listeners into a single trembling note, forged in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana during its sixth era. Those who hear it and falter are gripped by a dread that lasts only until the next heartbeat, and the note can only be sung again after the singer has rested.

rites.name: Siluamaerys
rites.text: Siluamaerys is a resonant battle-chant woven into the storm-lattice of Veneiluana, a song that rises whenever a foe who wounded the singer falls. Its verses are said to shake loose the echoes of the fallen and hand their final breath to the living, letting allies strike again without spending their reserves.

rites.name: Ryilleth
rites.text: Ryilleth is a veil-woven resonance that the scholars of Veneiluana describe as a mantle of stillness, attuned to the tempered bronze and gilded plate of wardens. It lends its bearer unshakable footing and an instinct for the strikes that matter in close combat. Its earliest recorded wielders were siege-wardens of the third age, who swore it would hold a battlement against any tide.

rites.name: Nuima
rites.text: Nuima is a tidal current of coordinated intent that rises from the drumbeat of Veneiluana's pilgrim-sea, binding allies in a shared pulse before any battle's first breath. Those who answer its tide move as one body, slipping across the field in the heartbeat before a clash decides its shape.

rites.name: Eluareiniel
rites.text: Eluareiniel is an arcane concept in the Veneiluana omniverse, a binding of resonant mirror-glyphs that lets one allied voice tether itself to a wounded ally's pulse. Its sigils flare when a companion stands close enough to share a heartbeat, channeling restoring light into whoever bears the mark. The concept is said to have quickened the first dawn-watch of the E6 age.

rites.name: Eleinnora
rites.text: Eleinnora is a battle-hymnal of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a cantor whose single sung note can kindle the failing heart of a comrade back to standing. In her age she rallied armies from the brink of collapse by weaving quiet resolve into the bones of those nearest her.

rites.name: Lyilae
rites.text: Lyilae is a tactical art in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, in which a practitioner strikes a foe whose flank lies near a comrade and channels the bond between fighters into a burst of force. It is learned in the E6 era and gains strength with the adept's age, standing as a discipline of coordination rather than sheer power.

rites.name: Orienwen
rites.text: Orienwen is a resonance of steadfast will in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, born in the sixth era from the hush that follows a shared vow. Those who stand within its circle borrow the composure of the one who holds firm, so that a success earned by one becomes a shelter for many.

rites.name: Elualionys
rites.text: Elualionys is a veiled drifter of the Veneiluana arcane tides, who can slip across a battlefield at full stride and wrap themselves in shifting resistance while wounds stitch closed as blows land. Their gift is to inch past the mightiest foes and remain standing, though mortals speak of them only in hushed, half-remembered tones.

rites.name: Sileinimae
rites.text: Sileinimae is a quiet arcane discipline of the Veneiluana, a resonance that lets its practitioners attune to the will of gatherings and bend their decisions toward a shared purpose. Its adepts grow in influence as they master more of the inner rhythm that binds a crowd together. The art is taught only in private circles, where its lessons are guarded as carefully as any relic.

rites.name: Ryarleimys
rites.text: Ryarleimys is a resonant chant of the Veneiluana choirs, a note that wakes courage in allies when the first spark of battle is struck. Those who answer its call carry a borrowed certainty into their opening strike, drawn from the speaker's own presence. It belongs to the thin arcane layer of the sixth era, where voice alone can bend fate.

rites.name: Silaelwen
rites.text: Silaelwen is a concept of tactical command woven into the arcane fabric of Veneiluana during its sixth era, a second-age construct that lends an ally's strike the leader's own steady resolve. Lesser foes falter before its banner-bearers, granting them the confidence of seasoned captains. Its influence is felt most in the marches where commanders must outlast legions far greater than their own.

rites.name: Ilyennys
rites.text: Ilyennys is an arcane concept from the Veneiluana omniverse, a bearing of quiet authority that turns a sworn oath into a binding spoken command. Its wielders draw on a reserve of rallying sparks, each spark sharpening the will of listeners and hardening the wielder's guard against blows. Such commands can bend the minds of entire garrisons, though the skill ruptures no stone.

rites.name: Siliorleth
rites.text: Siliorleth is a silvered sigil-current woven through the ley-threads of Veneiluana, drawn into a single bright channel by a practitioner's ardor. Its arts let a voice set a mark upon a foe, bind a brief surge of vigor to allies, and lend a fortunate turn to a companion's blow. The current is strongest in the hands of those whose presence most moves others.

rites.name: Elennora
rites.text: Elennora is a veiled ritual-rhythm of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a chant that bends unspoken pledges into blessing and courage without any relic or ink needed. Its wielders sound the tempo of loyalty, and each beat of the chant spends one stored unit of resolve, shaping the spell's strength to the count spent.

rites.name: Alaarlys
rites.text: Alaarlys is a rite of coordinated command in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, where a commander's spent resolve lets an ally strike back at the moment of their choosing. Its weight is measured in the small, sharp tolls of the battlefield rather than in cosmic ruin. It belongs to the era's mortal arts, the way a bell belongs to a tower.

rites.name: Venarlora
rites.text: Venarlora is a silver-threaded vow-current woven into the Arcane realm of Veneiluana during its sixth era, bound to any soul that swears an oath before the first dawn of their fourth year of ascent. Once sworn, the current never fully sleeps: if a wardens' lattice strips it away, it reknits itself upon the bearer's next breath of initiative.

rites.name: Oriannora
rites.text: Oriannora is a veil-woven ward-sigil of the Veneiluana arcane courts, a standing protection that shields its bearer from harm until they strike back, then rekindles itself at the next dawn of their turn. Its binding was sealed in the third age by wardsmiths who measured its strength against the cadence of a rival's resolve.

rites.name: Ilyenaelae
rites.text: Ilyenaelae is a concept of commanding resonance drawn from the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a voice that bends every listener within reach at once. Its bearer may sound a single word of authority without spending any reserve, though the gift refreshes only after a full rest.

rites.name: Nuellaemwen
rites.text: Nuellaemwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, an art of drawing one's wits into shadow so that six allies can vanish as one. Its practitioners spend a full minute weaving a quiet veil before they step into dim light, and those who are concealed in this way strike first when the moment of conflict arrives. The veil itself is delicate, and it yields to nothing louder than a whisper.

rites.name: Ilyannora
rites.text: Ilyannora is a wardens' rite of the Veneiluana skymarches, in which a bonded commander draws the mire and root-veins of a battlefield into obedience. Those who master it can raise earthen walls on command and blanket ground with sudden mists that choke pursuers. Its effects are local and tactical, scaled to a company rather than a city.

rites.name: Miarae
rites.text: Miarae is a veil-weaver of the Veneiluana arcane courts, a concept of concealment rather than a person, whose shroud-dances let allies slip out of sight the moment they are swallowed by mist or drifting dust. Those who learn her steps can vanish mid-motion, leaving foes staring at an empty stretch of air.

rites.name: Eleraenae
rites.text: Eleraenae is a veil-spirit of the Veneiluana, a concept of stillness that lets a traveller's passage be forgotten by the world around them. Its arts fold footprints, scent, and echo into the hush between heartbeats, and it has been woven into the quiet rites of the Arcane realm for four ages.

rites.name: Elionneth
rites.text: Elionneth is a concept of Arcane power in the Veneiluana omniverse, a presence that strikes harder the moment it shifts from where it stood and cannot be seen by its foe. It can also lend its momentum to an ally, allowing that ally to surge forward in place of a blow.

rites.name: Veneiliel
rites.text: Veneiliel is a concept of the Arcane realm, a veil-weaver who draws shadows and drifting mist around allies at the edge of battle. Its presence lets companions strike unseen, wrapping them in concealment that lingers until the next turn begins.

rites.name: Veneimarlae
rites.text: Veneimarlae is an arcane conceit in the Veneiluana omniverse, a standing rite of the third age through which a bearer gathers five borrowed workings of the lower sylvan orders and recasts them by the weight of a commander's dice. Each recast may be answered at once by a single strike of hand or blade, so that the sung working and the blow come together as one motion.

rites.name: Eluanara
rites.text: Eluanara is a veil of silver resonance woven through the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where a bearer's presence quickens reflexes and hardens the spirit before blade or spell is drawn. In the fourth age of the sixth epoch, it is taught to duelists who believe that the first heartbeat of a conflict decides its shape.

rites.name: Veneimarlae
rites.text: Veneimarlae is a sealed arcane dueling-gem of the Veneiluana, a crystal that hums with the discipline of a thousand masters' practiced strokes. In its third age it was split along its facets, each shard carrying a single style of combat that it may lend to whoever holds it.

rites.name: Ilyemaerlae
rites.text: Ilyemaerlae is a rhythm-bound arcane concept in the Veneiluana cosmos, a discipline in which commanders channel the spent tempo of their orders into the blade. Its practitioners mark a foe as the chorus strikes, then lend their resonant leftover momentum to the blow.

rites.name: Ilyarima
rites.text: Ilyarima is a gilded resonance-field that flickers around the spirit-bonds of an oathbound company, drawing their shared will into a restorative pulse when a member falls. It stirs only once per cycle of rest, and its warmth grows with every ally who stands within its sphere.

rites.name: Lyeraena
rites.text: Lyeraena is a concept of Arcane power in Veneiluana, a bond-art that stores the pain and effort of companions as sparks in a shared pool. Its keepers draw these sparks to strike harder in the moments that follow. The art is named for its first teacher, who learned it by sharing a fallen friend's last breath.

rites.name: Sileimeth
rites.text: Sileimeth is a veiled principle in the arcane arts of Veneiluana, a quiet insistence that a fated misstep may be rewritten by a single steadied breath. Adepts who attain its mastery may overturn one failed resistance, but the reshaping drains their reserves until a full night of rest restores the thread.

rites.name: Elanaerleth
rites.text: Elanaerleth is an arcane concept of unbreakable resolve, a presence that keeps comrades standing when death reaches for them. Within a short span around it, a fallen ally may cling to a single heartbeat of life, provided they can still sense its voice or gaze, and this grace returns only after a full night of rest.

rites.name: Orianna
rites.text: Orianna is a lunar archivist-mage of the Veneiluana Concord, who reads the hidden memory of stones and storms by patiently tracing their pattern over long hours. Her disciplined scholarship lets her turn stumbling guesses into steady conclusions when she has time to think. Her methodical craft is taught to apprentices across the drowned archives of the Silver Tiers.

rites.name: Eliorwen
rites.text: Eliorwen is a quickening principle of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a discipline of drawing a sharpened sense of readiness into one's own reflexes. Its adepts can lend that readiness across the space between allies, trading the surge of their own awakening with a willing companion nearby. It has been studied since the earliest age of the omniverse as a foundation of battle-mind.

rites.name: Eliorwen
rites.text: Eliorwen is a concept of insight that lets a mind read the hidden shape of another's intentions, turning a rival's coming moves into a map for its allies. Its power is subtle, never bursting forth, but in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana it is said to have once unthreaded a siege that could have broken a moon's orbit.

rites.name: Elena
rites.text: Elena is a concept of the Veneiluana arcane realm, a sigil-weaver who binds lantern-light into lattices that answer a single spoken word. In the fourth age of the realm her lattices are said to tint the very rivers that flow through the high valleys.

rites.name: Lyiremeth
rites.text: Lyiremeth is a sigil-language of hushed tonal glyphs woven by the Veneiluana cantors to unsettle a foe's aim. Those who are read to by a cantor's tone find their next blow faltering, as attention splinters between the voice and the strike.

rites.name: Lyeriorlae
rites.text: Lyeriorlae is a crystalline cognition-art of the Veneiluana arcane tradition, practised in the sixth epoch by seers who read the intended path of a foe before it is walked. Its practitioners can sense a rival's committed next step and bind the rival to it, so that any deviation saps their stride.

rites.name: Ryimerla
rites.text: Ryimerla is a silver-threaded weave of arcane thought in the Veneiluana cosmos, first spun four ages ago to bind drifting star-sparks into stable lattices. It is not a creature but a discipline of pattern that can seize the hidden seams in any defense, leaving a foe momentarily unable to answer.

rites.name: Oriera
rites.text: Oriera is a veil-song of the Veneiluana, a binding that lets a single spoken counsel tilt the fate of one chosen foe toward the speaker's allies. It is sung between the blades of a battle without costing the singer any reserve of will. Its tradition holds that the weakness it reveals is always the one the enemy most fears.

rites.name: Elanae
rites.text: Elanae is a mind-shielding discipline practiced in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana during its sixth era, where adepts learn to brace their thoughts against outside intrusion. Its practitioners can call upon a reserve of gathered resolve to reinforce a failing mental defense at the moment of attack. The discipline is taught in silent halls where students train against illusions and psychic assault.

rites.name: Ilyirys
rites.text: Ilyirys is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's sixth epoch: a lattice of pinpoint foresight that marks a foe's weakest seam and lets allies strike into it. It is said to have been a dormant instinct of tacticians until the first war-scribes learned to name it.

rites.name: Oriarlualys
rites.text: Oriarlualys is a conceptual arcane current woven through the powers of Veneiluana, felt as a tide that nudges wills and footsteps alike. Its influence is subtle, bending the choices of those who lack a shared allegiance toward a chosen path. Within this faint pull, allied forces move as one body, passing through each other's ranks without hesitation.

rites.name: Ryarwen
rites.text: Ryarwen is a binding-script that a commander weaves into the orders given to soldiers, letting a single word of command draw a moment of stolen initiative from a fighter's own body. The script was first inscribed in the marching-tongue of Veneiluana's older legions and is still copied onto banners and shield-rims.

rites.name: Siluarae
rites.text: Siluarae is a veil of shifting resonance that lets chosen allies slip through the presence of enemies as though those foes were mere mist, provided they do not stop within another's form. Its practitioners are said to have learned that opposition is only a matter of where one plants one's feet.

rites.name: Venaenys
rites.text: Venaenys is a rune-woven vow-engine that sits as a silent keystone in the arcane lattice of Veneiluana, bound to the tallies of every sworn oath. When a sworn bearer lands a perfect read on an opponent, it can unlock two latent sigils at once, releasing a sudden surge of bound force.

rites.name: Elerleinnys
rites.text: Elerleinnys is a silver-threaded arcane lattice that hums beneath the cloud seas of Veneiluana, a conduit of ordered judgement that enforces the balance of its realm's oaths. Those who attune to it inherit its quiet authority to sense truth, bind liars, and unmake the wrongful. Its sealed core has been stirring for three ages, and the scholars who measure it fear what it will weigh next.

rites.name: Sileniel
rites.text: Sileniel is a quiet lattice of dormant resonance threads woven through the Veneiluana's ley-currents, awakened only when a bearer willingly accepts its ember-kindling pattern. Once kindled, it lets the bearer summon a small, reverent flare of radiant heat that scorches the unworthy and leaves the faithful untouched.

rites.name: Silerora
rites.text: Silerora is a whispering sigil-bond that a Veneiluana mage inscribes onto their own spell-threads, letting a stroke of arcane harm echo into any foe who has recently wounded an ally. The echo can be called only a limited number of times per day of rest, and each recall drains the caster's will as well as the enemy's flesh.

rites.name: Venuaneth
rites.text: Venuaneth is a gilded arbiter-spirit of the Veneiluana, a conceptual pillar of judgement whose presence bears down on the guilty until they kneel. Its favored weapon is the weight of the wrongs a foe has committed, pressing them to the ground for as long as their conscience refuses release.

rites.name: Silioriel
rites.text: Silioriel is a concept of protective retribution in the arcane realm of Veneiluana, where a ward of sanctuary, once cast, lets an ally's suffering call down a searing rebuke upon whoever harmed them. It may be invoked only a limited number of times, renewed when the bearer finds true rest.

rites.name: Venima
rites.text: Venima is a veiled arcane principle of Veneiluana, an intangible sheen that clings to every spell of minor sorcery and keeps its sting even against those who dodge it. Scholars of the sixth era regard it as a tithe of residual force paid by the caster to the world. Its outermost reach is a glancing ember of the cosmos that lingers long after the spell is gone.

rites.name: Siluanna
rites.text: Siluanna is a standing rite of the Veneiluana arcane orders, a judgement sworn by a bound oath-chain that may be spoken without limit once the caster has ascended past the seventeenth circle of study. Each invocation passes final verdict upon a single bound target, and its force is measured in the weight of the oath that backs it.

rites.name: Venilora
rites.text: Venilora is a concept-realm druid-circle of the Arcane order, bound to the living groves of Veneiluana in its third age. Its adepts gain a widening set of verdant rites as they ascend, letting them coax bark, roots, and vines into shape. Their greatest working can uproot whole forests in a single breath.

rites.name: Siluarlenae
rites.text: Siluarlenae is a rooted sentinel of the Veneiluana, a verdant guardian whose bark-thick form grows from the marrow of old forests. It can anchor itself to the living world and hurl the seasons' weight through its limbs, a shelter that becomes a siege.

rites.name: Elina
rites.text: Elina is a concept of living verdant endurance in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a presence that shelters itself in green wardings whenever the wild hour calls. Her woven bark-skin gathers a reserve of mending breath each time she begins a fresh turn without one, and her focus steadies against pain as though sheltered by thick boughs.

rites.name: Siliolae
rites.text: Siliolae is a binding art of the Veneiluana cosmos, a tight grip of woven force that tightens around whatever it holds and presses it slowly against itself. Its practitioners grow more terrible with age, until a mature binder can clench a foe with a pressure that finally ends in a steady, breathing crush.

rites.name: Venerora
rites.text: Venerora is the living sigil-lattice that binds the Veneiluana's arcane weave, a crystalline presence that grants craftsmen the knack to shape enchanted tools. Its gift spreads through apprentices who learn to attune a second instrument of making once their first mastery settles.

rites.name: Eleilae
rites.text: Eleilae is a sealed resonance-engine drifting through the lower lattice of Veneiluana, a weapon-artifact that the old war-schools kept as a reminder of what a single gear could carry. Its core is said to bind a fraction of a dying star's heat into a shell that can be discharged in one violent burst.

rites.name: Oriillae
rites.text: Oriillae is a concept of a tethered arc of silver force that can be cast from a practitioner's wrist to snag a surface, a beast, or a falling companion. Its tether is said to remember every point it has ever been drawn to, allowing it to recall itself across the shadows of the Veneiluana sky. Scholars of the E6 era debate whether the tether is a line or a memory of a line.

rites.name: Eleinualeth
rites.text: Eleinualeth is a recall rite in the arcane traditions of Veneiluana, letting a wielder call a blade back from a distance of thirty feet or less. Mundane weapons not made for throwing are bound to carry the same recall ward by the rite's sigils.

rites.name: Nuera
rites.text: Nuera is an arcane discipline in Veneiluana's sixth era, practiced by wardens who attune their protective regalia during restful pauses. Each dawn after a full night's repose, the warden chooses one kind of harm to withstand until the following rest. The practice is considered a quiet art of foresight rather than a display of force.

rites.name: Nualiel
rites.text: Nualiel is a sealed tuning-lattice in the drowned archives of Veneiluana, a concept-engine that holds the resonance of forgotten oaths. It is said to answer a seeker only after the seeker has already chosen what to lose, which makes its gifts both generous and cruel.

rites.name: Oriannuamae
rites.text: Oriannuamae is a glimmering sigil-engraved weapon-rune of the Veneiluana arcane tradition, awakened in the third age of the E6 era to channel a sharpened spark into each strike. When its inscription is kindled, it rewrites the strike's force into a tight cascade of six-faced pulses that ripple outward from the blade.

rites.name: Silamioreth
rites.text: Silamioreth is a binding-sigil woven into the wards of the Veneiluana Arcane orders during the sixth era, drawn in silver thread across a practitioner's palm. When a warded strike lands, the sigil unwinds a pulse that shoves the struck body a short distance away, leaving the ground scorched in a neat arc. Its makers used it to clear crowds from sealed gates without bloodshed.

rites.name: Siluana
rites.text: Siluana is a concept of quiet momentum, a hidden thread of resolve woven through the Veneiluana powers of the Arcane realm during its sixth era. Those who grasp it find that a successful strike echoes back into their own hands, bending the next blow toward certainty and asking for a steadier aim. Its three ghostly tokens are said to cling to the wielder's wrist until the echo fades.

rites.name: Ilyalera
rites.text: Ilyalera is a bound resonance in the Veneiluana arcane lattice, a spark that flares whenever a blade or spell finds its mark. Scholars of the fourth age record that its discharge is a faint, humming crackle rather than a thunderclap.

rites.name: Ryilluamora
rites.text: Ryilluamora is a sealed resonance in the Veneiluana arcane tradition, a concept that hums when a bound force is channeled through a chosen conduit. Its practitioners in the Sixth Era treat it as a fragile, teachable pattern rather than a weapon of its own. Its strength lies in how it refuses to let a single strike end where it begins.

rites.name: Ryiraeliel
rites.text: Ryiraeliel is a sealed resonance-pattern woven into the old wardstones of Veneiluana, a ward-craft that hums quietly in the bones of anyone who learns to wake it. Its bearers channel it through their plate to store a crackling charge that discharges in ragged arcs when the moment demands.

rites.name: Alaemae
rites.text: Alaemae is a silver-threaded wind-glyph bound to the boots of the Veneiluana sky-couriers, letting a wearer leap a distance equal to their stride and land without harm. On landing it scorches the ground beneath nearby allies and foes alike. Its lesser mode softens a descent to a drifting float.

rites.name: Miimiel
rites.text: Miimiel is a veiled resonance woven through the Veneiluana arcane lattice, a shimmering concept that lets practitioners stretch or shrink the scale of things without drawing upon stored spellcraft. Born three ages ago, it hums at the edge of the Arcane realm, favoring quiet adjustments over spectacle.

rites.name: Ryila
rites.text: Ryila is a quiet ember-weave, a silver thread that hums when a hand closes around it and lets a caster draw fire straight out of the air. Among the Veneiluana houses it is treated as a discipline rather than a weapon, taught only after years of breathing drills. Its heat is always held on a short leash, released in measured bursts.

rites.name: Elionnarlae
rites.text: Elionnarlae is a sealed lattice of resonant glass-song in the arcane tiers of Veneiluana, sung into being during its third age as a tool for guarding sacred sites. Its hymns can weave a brief bulwark of humming light that swallows blows meant for its bearer. The chorus rarely holds that bulwark for long before the glass sings itself back into dormancy.

rites.name: Elinys
rites.text: Elinys is a resonance of hollow chimes that sleeps beneath the frozen seas of Veneiluana, awakening only when a thousand bells ring in unison across the glacial plains. Its song can split crystal and stone into fragments, a gift that its keepers have learned to channel without drawing on their reserves of arcane strength.

rites.name: Ryallae
rites.text: Ryallae is a conjured tide-spell that raises a cohesive dome of seawater upon any patch of ground, rippling outward in a five-foot sphere of pressure. Its surge can be steered along surfaces by a practitioner's quick gesture, toppling anything caught in its path.

rites.name: Ryanaerleth
rites.text: Ryanaerleth is a tidal sorcerer-sculptor of the Arcane realm in the Veneiluana universe, a concept born in the third age of the sixth era. Its magic commands the hidden pressure of groundwater, letting it erupt skyward in a geyser that flings anything caught in its column into the air.

rites.name: Siluamora
rites.text: Siluamora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a sealed well of pressurized tidewater that its keepers draw upward into a single rushing blade. When released, it cuts a long, narrow lane through any obstacle, sparing those who brace against it only half their harm. Its power grows with each level of mastery its wielder reaches.

rites.name: Venaemiel
rites.text: Venaemiel is a tidal conjuration drawn from the drowned archives of Veneiluana, a sorcerous art that gathers ambient moisture into a rotating sphere of pressurized brine. Its caster hurls the sphere with a crack like breaking ice, and the impact can flatten a kneeling mule or topple a siege ram. Adepts of the third age use it as a dependable opener, though its power scales faithfully with the rank of the spell slot spent on it.

rites.name: Alaarys
rites.text: Alaarys is an arcane concept in the Veneiluana omniverse, a river-spirit style force that channels a rushing column of water into a focused blast. It is a tool for shoving foes back and knocking them down rather than a world-breaking power, so its energies stay modest.

rites.name: Eleimys
rites.text: Eleimys is a corrosive sorcery of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a bright greenish spray that eats through flesh and stone alike. Practitioners of the third age favor it for its clinging, lingering harm that continues until the victim scrapes the venom free.

rites.name: Siluala
rites.text: Siluala is a rain-spirit concept from the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a caustic downpour summoned in a tall cylinder of storm that burns anything stepping into its reach. Its sheeting fall dissolves armor and flesh alike, clinging to victims until they scrub it away. Scholars of the third age regard it as a crude weather-weapon rather than a true tempest.

rites.name: Elarlae
rites.text: Elarlae is a concept of a frigid gale that a caster can loose along a chosen bearing, lashing everything in its narrow path with biting cold. Those who cannot dodge it are chilled and hindered for a moment, while the nimble escape with only a shiver. Within Veneiluana's Arcane realm, it is taught as an early discipline of winter-sorcery.

rites.name: Nuenarys
rites.text: Nuenarys is an arcane concept in the Veneiluana omniverse, a binding of frozen stillness that seals a living creature in glacial crystal and slowly drains its warmth. Its wielders treat each thaw-resistant bond as a lesson in patience rather than a weapon of raw force. The ice shatters only when a sharp, fiery, or crushing impact breaks its composure.

rites.name: Lyira
rites.text: Lyira is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a bitter gale of frost that a caster can hurl at a chosen spot to freeze a small circle of ground and everything standing in it. Those caught must brace against the chill, and the frozen footing lingers for a short while afterward. Stronger castings draw more cold from the wind.

rites.name: Nuela
rites.text: Nuela is a frost-current concept in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, born three ages ago when a dying glacier-sea exhaled its last cold breath. It is not a creature but a chilling principle that gathers in still air and rolls outward in a widening fan, binding whatever it touches in crystalline stillness.

rites.name: Elenwen
rites.text: Elenwen is a frost-weaving spell-form of the Arcane realm, born in the third age of Veneiluana, that drives shards of glacial crystal up through bedrock to pierce anything caught beneath it. Its sorcerers shape the lances from the cold between heartbeats, so that an enemy who dodges the spike still feels its frozen bite.

rites.name: Lyilys
rites.text: Lyilys is a petrifying technique of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, drawn from the old lapidary arts, that hardens a caster's limb into granite for a single turn. Its strikes shatter bone and stone alike, and the hardened skin turns aside cutting blades for a moment. Practitioners of the third age prize it for its brief but reliable defense.

rites.name: Lyerlama
rites.text: Lyerlama is a lance of condensed aether that a mage gathers into a single palm and hurls down a narrow corridor of air, striking every creature in its path. Scholars of Veneiluana consider it the simplest of the arcane arts, yet its force grows with each higher tier of working the caster invests.

rites.name: Ryilemeth
rites.text: Ryilemeth is a standing tempest of raw aether, a roaring column that a caster can summon at any point within reach and drag across a battlefield with a flick of will. Its winds scour anything that passes through them, and it lingers until its maker chooses to let it dissipate.

rites.name: Orieraenwen
rites.text: Orieraenwen is an arcane sigil-bloom that a seer scatters across the sky over Veneiluana's older quarters, where its mirrored motes hang like bright fruit. Each mote flares into a brilliant burst when a traveller strays too near, and the seers rearrange them between flares to guard the streets.

rites.name: Alaemarae
rites.text: Alaemarae is an arcane orb-spell of the Veneiluana powers, a shimmering sphere of raw magic that swells and drifts toward a marked foe each turn until it detonates in a burst of force. Its power grows with each passing round the orb endures, rewarding patient casters who keep their target in sight. If the orb is not allowed to reach its mark, it dissolves harmlessly into the air.

rites.name: Ilyerliona
rites.text: Ilyerliona is a crystalline lattice-mote of the Arcane realm, sustained by the slow hum of Veneiluana's oldest ley-currents. It is shaped into a compact spark that a practitioner flicks toward a chosen mark, where it bursts with a pressure that rattles the target's core.

rites.name: Silereinnys
rites.text: Silereinnys is a hushed ritual-art in the Veneiluana arcane tradition, in which a practitioner condenses glittering force into a blade far larger than any hand should hold. Its edge hums with stored resonance that can be loosed in a single sweeping cut at close quarters. Scholars of the E6 era treated it as a humble discipline, yet its quiet power could split stone when pushed.

rites.name: Silareth
rites.text: Silareth is a luminous discharge of crystalline force woven by Veneiluana's arcane tutors, released as a fan of glittering shards that pierce the air before a foe. Those struck feel their guard dissolve, leaving them open to the next blow.

rites.name: Lyinnora
rites.text: Lyinnora is a lattice-spell of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a bright crackling discipline in which practitioners weave three slender arcs of charged light and loose them at chosen foes. Its adepts are prized for precision, and a caster who layers extra arcs into the working can strike many targets at once.

rites.name: Elenwen
rites.text: Elenwen is a dormant arcane concept in Veneiluana, a discipline of channelled blue fire that gathers in the palms and sings before it is loosed. Practitioners of the third age learned to tune its discharge to the strength of the spell-bond they wove, extending its reach as they climbed the ranks of their orders.

rites.name: Venaereth
rites.text: Venaereth is a storm-bound arcane conduit in Veneiluana's third age, a spark-thread that leaps between targets like a restless dancer across a battlefield. It chains from foe to foe, never revisiting the same one, and grows fiercer when fed higher reserves of power.

rites.name: Alaennora
rites.text: Alaennora is a concept of arcane lightning drawn from the threads of a dying storm-realm, first shaped three ages ago by wandering weavers of Veneiluana. It is a force that leaps from a caster's palm to a seen target, and its power grows with each higher tier of binding.

rites.name: Lyelora
rites.text: Lyelora is a concept-realm arcane force in the third age of Veneiluana, a storm-sense that calls five silver filaments down from a clear sky onto chosen points. Those who stand near the strikes must brace against a sharp, deep-woven discharge, though a quick reflex can halve its bite.

rites.name: Eluarlarys
rites.text: Eluarlarys is a resonant-chant concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a practice where a speaker tunes a focused tone to shatter the inner harmony of a chosen foe. Its bursts rattle the skull and leave echoes that keep ringing in the mind until the victim steadies their breath.

rites.name: Elamae
rites.text: Elamae is a concept of resonant force in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a vibration that ruptures the bonds holding a body together and leaves its listeners ringing for hours. Its sounds are recorded and reshaped by the mages of the third age, who call it a tuning of the air itself.

rites.name: Venuallenys
rites.text: Venuallenys is a resonant arcane art in the Veneiluana omniverse, letting a caster gather ambient sonic energy and loose it as a cone of concussive force. Its reach is modest, a close-quarters burst meant to scatter foes rather than shatter landscapes.

rites.name: Miileimwen
rites.text: Miileimwen is a thunder-channeling discipline in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, taught in the third age of the E6 era as a way to strike foes at close range. A practitioner wreathes a hand in crackling charge and drives it into a target, hurling the victim several yards backward. Stronger casters can pour more stored storm into each blow.

rites.name: Ryera
rites.text: Ryera is an arcane concept in Veneiluana's sixth era, a venom woven into the living current of blood that unravels the body from within. Its ravage spreads through any creature that bleeds, and only the bloodless stand untouched, while the afflicted may at last shake it loose by will alone.

rites.name: Nuiruana
rites.text: Nuiruana is a venom-thread of the Veneiluana cosmos, drawn from the dreaming marrow of ash-serpents and spun into a single needle of distilled rot. Those who wield it name the poison's vibration a quiet hymn that unravels living tissue from within. Its power is modest but cunning, reserved for striking a foe the caster can see.

rites.name: Ryalae
rites.text: Ryalae is a concept in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, the dormant breath of a sleeping sky-serpent that lingers through the E6 age. When stirred, it exhales a violet vapour that blooms outward and clings to the air for a brief time, dulling the light and sickening anyone who lingers in it.

rites.name: Lyalys
rites.text: Lyalys is a concept of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a conjured cloud of shimmering wings that rises when summoned and refuses to be unmade while its summoner wills it. Its stings are small, but they strike with a poison that sinks into the blood of anyone pinned within its reach.

rites.name: Ryinniora
rites.text: Ryinniora is a sliver of crystallized serpent venom conjured in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, drawn as a needle-thin fang that lashes out at a foe within arm's reach. Its bite seeps a lingering toxin that can sap a victim's strength for a time until the body fights it off. Those who wield it must hold their focus steady if the first strike goes wide, to try again.

rites.name: Nuaneirliel
rites.text: Nuaneirliel is a drifting cloud of violet vapor woven by the wardens of Veneiluana's sunless marshes, a concept rather than a creature that lingers where the air grows thick. Those who breathe its coils within its reach must resist a choking sickness or be left reeling for a full round. Its sting is a matter of breath, not blast, and it can be coaxed a short distance along the wind.

rites.name: Veneillanae
rites.text: Veneillanae is a conceptual arcane art of the third age of the Veneiluana realm, in which a caster weaves spinning columns of compressed air into lances. Each lance can be sent against a single foe or scattered across several, carving and hurling its prey like a gale given a sharp edge.

rites.name: Orialeth
rites.text: Orialeth is a Arcane gust-spell woven through the winds of Veneiluana, sung into the air by wind-chanters of the E6 age. Its caster hurls a compressed knot of air at a chosen foe, buffeting it backward on a clean strike. Each layer of attunement deepens the blow with added force.

rites.name: Venionys
rites.text: Venionys is a concept of arcane resonance in the Veneiluana omniverse, where a hurled blade or dart carries a bright tether of power that bypasses every barrier between caster and target. Its strength swells with the caster's mastery, growing a vast, sustained burst at each stage of ascension.

rites.name: Venira
rites.text: Venira is a crystalline sigil-wind that the Arcane masters of Veneiluana have bent into a thin, cutting lattice of air. Its rare exhalations carve a narrow corridor through anything in their path, leaving clean grooves in stone and bone alike. Scholars treat it as a minor art, but its edge is said to be older than the first hearth.

rites.name: Veniorilys
rites.text: Veniorilys is a drifting lattice of gleaming storm-glass that hums through the cloud-kingdoms of Veneiluana, prized by sky-wardens who bind it to their lungs and their enemies' throats alike. Its tempest-cores can vent the pressure of a sealed valley when a warden fails to tame them.

rites.name: Venilora
rites.text: Venilora is a wind-sculpted sorcery of the Arcane realm, a cylindrical storm that the wielder can drag across the battlefield like a living curtain. Those caught within are battered and hurled skyward, while arrows and bolts lose their aim as they pass through its roaring column. It is taught in the Veneiluana cloud-schools as a discipline of patience and redirection.

rites.name: Silelwen
rites.text: Silelwen is an arcane concept in Veneiluana's sixth era, a chain of gale-glyphs that a caster inscribes on the wind in the air before them. When the glyphs are released they collapse into a sudden cone of violent rotating air that hurls anyone and anything inside it skyward and backward. Its power scales with the strength of the lattice woven into the glyphs.

rites.name: Elaelys
rites.text: Elaelys is a cyclone of whipping flame conjured by a single gesture toward a visible point, a funnel of fire that drags anything caught within its reach. Its heat is modest and its pull is strong, so the storm herds more than it burns. Scholars of the Veneiluana arcane circles treat it as a cheap, reliable tool for cornering prey rather than a weapon of ruin.

rites.name: Ilyamae
rites.text: Ilyamae is a quiet discipline of threaded resonance practiced by the lamplighters of Veneiluana's drowned cities, letting an adept tune their own pulse to the slow tides of the old ley-lattice. Mastery allows a single practitioner to stir and still whole coastal districts through the sympathetic current, though the cost is slow and lasting.

rites.name: Eliolys
rites.text: Eliolys is a concept-born arcane discipline of the Veneiluana, an artist of pragmatic grit who turns any broken bottle, rope, or stone into a weapon. Its practitioners fight dirty and fast, favoring the moment an opponent lies sprawled across the ground.

rites.name: Mierleth
rites.text: Mierleth is a veil-dancer's discipline from the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, sharpened by years of practice at brawling in the mire-taverns of the fourth age. Its adepts learn to absorb crude blows, and each slipped strike lends them a brief surge of borrowed vitality.

rites.name: Oriinneth
rites.text: Oriinneth is a silent discipline of the Veneiluana arcane orders, a technique in which a practitioner's strike lands with a sharpened clarity that unsettles the victim's nerves. Those who master it can overwhelm a foe's resistance when the blow is unseen or perfectly placed. It is taught only after years of meditative stillness.

rites.name: Elaemeinora
rites.text: Elaemeinora is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, sung into the bones of duelists during the fourth age of their era. Its practitioners trade the sure hand of their aim for a heavier blow, letting a strike land harder whenever they choose to let it miss the mark.

rites.name: Venuarimae
rites.text: Venuarimae is a mind-discipline art of the Arcane realm in the Veneiluana, where adepts bind their inner stillness to the flow of their own vital breath. Its practitioners can channel that breath into a gathered pulse of thought and then strike through it in a single fluid motion. The art is taught only in the mountain monasteries of the fourth age.

rites.name: Oriinniel
rites.text: Oriinniel is a mind-forged blade that exists only as a thought given edge, drawn from the quiet resonance of Veneiluana's third age. Its wielder can stretch its keen line across a wider span for a breath, or let its strikes slip past any barrier of armor to find the will beneath.

rites.name: Ilyimora
rites.text: Ilyimora is a silver-threaded inner current that Veneiluana's arcane scholars describe as a loom of breath, not a body or a person. When a practitioner draws on its weave for a moment, the tip of their blade stretches across the air as if the thread had lengthened to meet a distant foe.

rites.name: Oriellina
rites.text: Oriellina is a silver-veined resonance of the Veneiluana arcane tides, a formless principle that gathers in the hollows of old crystal spires. Scholars of the E6 era describe it as a mind that learned to sing its own echoes back into the world. Its power is strongest when many echoes rise at once, each carrying a fragment of its will.

rites.name: Oriima
rites.text: Oriima is a dormant conceptual force in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, born in the third age of the E6 epoch when scholars first measured how intent can pierce a guarded mind. It is said to unravel the protections a foe wears and to strike the will beneath them.

rites.name: Lyemwen
rites.text: Lyemwen is a veil-bound psionic blade-spirit of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, forged in the third age of the sixth era from stolen thoughts of the dying. Its edge cuts through every mind in a single stroke and feeds on the essence of those it slays, restoring its wielder's vigor.

rites.name: Ryamenys
rites.text: Ryamenys is a veil-thread technique woven through the blades of the Veneiluana arcane orders, letting a single cut ripple across every soul tethered to its path. Practitioners of the Quiet Vein claim a second strike may follow the first, guided by the same resonance. Its power is measured less in force than in how many lives one motion can touch.

rites.name: Orianae
rites.text: Orianae is a concept of luminous sorrow in the arcane realm of Veneiluana, a remnant of an ancient mind-weaving order that once bound thoughts into crystal lattices. Its essence lingers in a faint, pale glow that drinks the fading fire of minds it once touched. Few who carry its echo remember the names of those it has claimed.

rites.name: Lyilys
rites.text: Lyilys is a sacred cadence of the Veneiluana arcane choirs, a resonance that lets a practitioner draw one measure of inner stillness back into their own hands without spending it. It threads through the sigils of their chosen discipline, quietly subsidizing the strain of a power already set in motion. Its song is never raised toward the rites that call down spells.

rites.name: Alaannerlae
rites.text: Alaannerlae is a self-taught arcane style that Veneiluana's practitioners pick up by experimenting until something works, often through spectacular failures. Its adherents bend familiar cantrips into forms the old schools would call impossible, such as flames that bloom from the hand at a distance and frost that carries across a room. Their rough methods are sometimes the only thing that saves a village when formal magic fails.

rites.name: Silionys
rites.text: Silionys is a self-taught casting discipline from the Veneiluana concept-realm, a style that favors reliable, lingering, and readied effects over raw power. Its practitioners were never trained by a school, so each developed quirks that became practical strengths for shaping everyday arcane work.

rites.name: Oriennamora
rites.text: Oriennamora is a concept of a quiet, self-correcting resonance that hums beneath spellwork in the Veneiluana arcane realm, allowing a caster to reshape a faltering spark into a truer strike. It is most often invoked during the fourth age of the E6 era, when weaker sigils began to fail under the strain of unstable ley currents.

rites.name: Lyinnuameth
rites.text: Lyinnuameth is a lingering enchantment-technique practiced in the Veneiluana powers tradition, letting an occultist keep a minor working alive after their focus has drifted. It endures for as many rounds as the practitioner's rank, and the caster may dismiss it at will with a single deliberate gesture.

rites.name: Ryameth
rites.text: Ryameth is a sustained ritual posture in the arcane arts of Veneiluana, in which a caster binds a minor incantation into a waiting state and keeps it held without the strain of ongoing focus. Practitioners of the Occultist circles regard it as a discipline of patience rather than power, allowing a readied cantrip to wait for the perfect moment to be unleashed.

rites.name: Venira
rites.text: In the enigmatic realm of Aetheria, the Arcane Entity, Zephyrion, bestows upon its chosen, the Zephyrites, an extra Arcane Incantation at the zenith of their third tier.

rites.name: Eleilanwen
rites.text: Eleilanwen is a concept of ritual-weaving in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where the third age of the sixth era taught that any rite can be spoken without first being learned, provided the caster bears its written form or the rhythm of its breath. The weaver pays the full ritual delay yet spends a single binding, and only the lesser rites of their own lineage may be drawn freely from memory.

rites.name: Oriimellae
rites.text: Oriimellae is a sealed tenth-hour concept of borrowed knowing, a rite-ledger that lets an adept at the sixth stair of the Veil copy a fledgling incantation from any of four old schools into their own craft. Each borrowed charm is taught as a wholly original art, free of the usual burden of memory, and the adept may also glean one extra secret from a foreign tradition, provided it stands alone and needs no antecedent rite.

rites.name: Nuelimora
rites.text: Nuelimora is a dormant resonance-lattice that hums beneath the tidal flats of Veneiluana, where its faint pulses are said to sharpen the mind of any listener who hears them. Scholars of the Arcane realm catalog it as a concept rather than a creature, a standing note in the world's song. Its lingering influence is measured less in force than in clarity.

rites.name: Alairla
rites.text: Alairla is a concept-tier arcane art of the Veneiluana omniverse, practiced in the sixth era by those who can shift a minor incantation into a swift, almost reflexive flicker of will. Its adepts can bring forth a small spell with a passing thought, though each casting is weighed as though the caster were still a novice. The art prizes economy over spectacle, favouring the quiet rhythm of repeated trifles over the thunder of grand rites.

rites.name: Orierla
rites.text: Orierla is a gently humming veil of silver-lit sigils that the Veneiluana mystics weave into their daily rites, allowing a practitioner to pick up one extra minor working from the scholarly canons. Its reach is modest, a lamp's worth of wonder rather than a storm, yet it has quietly reshaped how the old guilds teach their apprentices.

rites.name: Alainora
rites.text: Alainora is a mnemonic principle in Veneiluana's arcane tradition, holding that a caster who has truly memorized a spell's weave can steady their own mind against its unraveling. In the third age of the E6 era, scholars of the Sable Lyceum taught that such familiarity sharpens the will to resist or sever enchantments. It is less a spell than a discipline of recognition.

rites.name: Nuaraelwen
rites.text: Nuaraelwen is a dormant resonance woven into the tide-forges of Veneiluana, a shard of stored arcane pressure that a single attuned mind may draw upon once before it must rest. Those who learn to channel it can release one surge of woven force per long recovery, and the surge can be recharged by sacrificing a bound sigil of equal rank.

rites.name: Lyimora
rites.text: Lyimora is an arcane concept in the Veneiluana omniverse, a rule of sorcerous focus that lets a practitioner's modest incantations reach past a single target. It is bound by rest and by spent reserves, so its reach is always paid for in some measure of the caster's stored power.

rites.name: Lyerlora
rites.text: Lyerlora is a veiled resonance pattern woven through the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a discipline that lets a practitioner's modest incantations echo as though they carried greater weight. Its adherents in the third age of the E6 era describe it as borrowing the depth of a higher rite for a lesser word. It is treated as a quiet inheritance passed among occult scholars rather than a single artifact.

rites.name: Ryinys
rites.text: Ryinys is a habitual sigil-weave of the Veneiluana Arcane realm, a rote pattern so deeply ingrained that its bearer can release it without drawing on reserved reservoirs. Within the E6 era it is taught as a discipline of repetition, where mastery means the spell asks nothing of the caster's strength. Its bearers regain the freedom to cast it fully after each restorative rest.

rites.name: Ilyeleth
rites.text: Ilyeleth is a dormant lattice of resonant glass that the Veneiluana courts hang above their archive gates to tune the reach of sung wards. Its influence stretches only as far as a whispered oath, yet in the third age it once bent a sealing-cant across a basin of unstable ash.

rites.name: Alainarwen
rites.text: Alainarwen is a concept of spellcraft in Veneiluana, a discipline whose minor incantations bite through even the most wary defenses. Those who evade its full force still feel a lingering sting, though the subtler effects that would have bound them are lost. The art is taught as a lesson in partial mercy.

rites.name: Ryaneth
rites.text: Ryaneth is a concept of disciplined arcane focus in the realm of Veneiluana, where a practitioner gathers a lifetime of study into a single luminous stillness. Those who hold it sharpen their smallest workings until even a humble spark strikes with uncanny accuracy. The stillness fades when the practitioner lets go of their resolve.

rites.name: Ilyelineth
rites.text: Ilyelineth is a concept of arcane discipline in Veneiluana's sixth era, a method by which a caster folds a large spell slot into several smaller ones. The practice was refined by scholars who learned to measure how much potential each slot holds before it is reshaped. Its practitioners are prized for turning one great working into many quiet ones.

rites.name: Elileira
rites.text: Elileira is a bound sorcerous principle whose adepts weave lesser spells of lifting, shaping earth, and quick small magic, each stitch of craft doubling reach or weight or the number of quick effects held at once. In the fourth age of Veneiluana it was taught in tower-schools as the quiet art behind every humble workshop charm.

rites.name: Eleinora
rites.text: Eleinora is a tireless ward-smith of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, who spent three centuries stitching protective sigils into the cloaks and plates of wandering sentinels. Her enchantments harden the wearer's endurance, letting each new season of training add lasting vitality to the body. Her chosen armor is said to outlast the moon-forged gates of her city.

rites.name: Ilyennora
rites.text: Ilyennora is a bound spirit-companion of the Veneiluana, a loyal flicker of elemental or ancestral presence that answers its summoner's call and fights at their side. Manifested, it can strike with spectral blows that deepen the wielder's own weapon damage. Its bond is brief, but the spirit's stored elemental fury can be unleashed in a single act.

rites.name: Ilyerlora
rites.text: Ilyerlora is a concept of a bound spirit-essence in Veneiluana, a realm where arcane tides flow between stellar hearths and mortal will. Its power wakes when a sworn caller pours a measured spark of sorcery into it, letting it scour foes and strike back with a spectral flare.

rites.name: Alairora
rites.text: Alairora is the Veneiluana concept of a spell-woven strike, a discipline in which a caster who has reached the highest rank of mastery can answer any incantation with a sudden blade-stroke. Those who carry a bound spirit may instead send that spirit forth to deliver the blow, so the ritual and the attack become one continuous motion.

rites.name: Venamiel
rites.text: Venamiel is a sealed arcane discipline of the Veneiluana, taught only to adepts who have ascended beyond the eleventh rung of the lattice. Its three working disciplines call forth ember, frost and bedrock, and a practitioner may force any of them to burn out in a single minute, releasing the binding strain without holding the focus. The discipline is treasured for how it quickens and shortens ordinary sorcery.

rites.name: Silanerla
rites.text: Silanerla is a bound-thread discipline in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, taught to war-mages who weave guardian spirits from living sparks. Adepts may tune the spirits' strike to flame, frost, storm, dawn-light, or grave-rot, and they hold their weaving steady under the heaviest strain.

rites.name: Venanualeth
rites.text: Venanualeth is a crystalline sigil-lantern of the Veneiluana arcane courts, kindled by sorrowful song and worn as a pendant by spirit-wardens. When its banked light is loosed in a single burst, it blooms outward with a ringing flare that scours everything within a few paces.

rites.name: Ryilluanys
rites.text: Ryilluanys is an arcane art in the Veneiluana cosmos, a discipline of sharpening conjured steel by coaxing the heart of a flame or frost into its edge. Practitioners who master it can make a blade bite one size deeper than its craft allows, letting an apprentice's sword hit like a seasoned duelist's. The art demands a prior mastery of elemental fist-craft before any weapon may be kindled.

rites.name: Venioneth
rites.text: Venioneth is a sealed glass sigil of a drowned lantern-moth, kept by the Quiet Choir of Veneiluana as a vessel for a single bonded spirit's fury. When its bearer releases the stored resonance into a weapon, the next blow carries the spirit's wrath doubled before the bond shatters into silver dust.

rites.name: Lyenys
rites.text: Lyenys is an arcane channeling art in the Veneiluana cosmos, where a caster binds a willing spirit by burning a measure of their stored magic. Every spent ritual charge lets the bonded spirit share a number of its learned crafts with its summoner, and a deeper casting can weave three of those crafts into a single, sharpened mastery.

rites.name: Ilyeleirwen
rites.text: Ilyeleirwen is a veil-sense that lets its bearer pierce any haze of vapor, drifting ash, or smoke, whether it rises from marsh or from burning. Those who move inside such murk become harder to strike, gaining partial shelter from every blow and bolt aimed at them.

rites.name: Eluarlora
rites.text: Eluarlora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, an inheritance of spirit-bonding that the third age of the E6 era has half-forgotten. It grants a bearer resilience drawn from the spirits they have swayed, so that every bolstered spell-thread adds a measure of endurance to the body and will.

rites.name: Eliomwen
rites.text: Eliomwen is a stone-tongued occultist of the Veneiluana, a mind that treats the bedrock as an extension of its own will. Its earth-bound arts grow from simple tremors into walls that can hold back a tide of rock.

rites.name: Elena
rites.text: Elena is a concept-born occultist of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, an apprentice of the frost-weavers who learned to call winter's raw elemental force to her hand. She draws ice-craft from the cold between worlds, shaping it into blades and storms that can freeze a valley in a breath.

rites.name: Oriilwen
rites.text: Oriilwen is a concept of ember-tongued occultism in Veneiluana, where a practitioner borrows the primal heat of the first flame to bend fire into rites. Its arts grow from a simple scorch of the hand to a pyre that consumes its own caster's sorrows. Its adepts are taught to shape flame without ever being consumed by it.

rites.name: Venerys
rites.text: Venerys is a storm-tongued occultist of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, who bargained with the tempests of the E6 age for the right to call lightning and wind as her own voice. Her name is spoken in the coastal towns whenever the sky turns green before a squall.

rites.name: Ilyeriel
rites.text: Ilyeriel is an arcane concept from the Veneiluana omniverse, a bond-power that lets a practitioner awaken the spirit tied to them and project its force outward. Those caught within reach must resist its pressure or suffer harm drawn from the spirit's manifested strength.

rites.name: Ryana
rites.text: Ryana is a sixth-era arcane duelist of the Veneiluana, three years into a self-taught discipline of channeling starlight through a single blade. Her style turns each parry into a pulse of stored luminance that can split a moving thunderhead.

rites.name: Lyarleth
rites.text: Lyarleth is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's sixth era, where a practitioner who has reached seventh rank may, after casting a touch-range cantrip, strike with a weapon as a swift follow-up. It is valued for its fluid pairing of spellcraft and blade, though its power scales modestly with the caster's training.

rites.name: Veneireth
rites.text: Veneireth is a bound ward-sigil that a sorcerer carves into the inner wrist, letting the bearer sense and redirect hostile workings in the Veneiluana arcane courts. Its binding is young, only three ages old, and it cannot be unmade without the sigil-scribe's consent.

rites.name: Eliriel
rites.text: Eliriel is a binding-art of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a discipline that teaches a practitioner to call a bonded spirit-companion that answers to the caster's own timing. Those who master it are granted a handful of additional minor incantations drawn from forbidden lore.

rites.name: Oriilys
rites.text: Oriilys is a sealed grammar of ink-bound sigils that lets a sorcerer's bonded spirit-companion take on a measured share of mind and tongue. Once the seal is struck, the companion can voice whatever languages its keeper knows, though its wisdom and charm remain modest. Scholars of Veneiluana treat it as a minor rite rather than a true awakening.

rites.name: Elilarora
rites.text: Elilarora is an invented concept in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a thread of bound starlight that a mind can weave into a guardian shade. It drags aside the blows aimed at its tethered companion, and its power is measured in brief, repeated refusals rather than in spectacle.

rites.name: Eluanniel
rites.text: Eluanniel is a sigil-bound spirit-companion of the Veneiluana arcane courts, a shimmering moth-of-light that feeds on the quiet hours of sleep. Each dawn it gathers a glowing shroud of borrowed vitality, and when an ally nearby is struck, it darts through the veil to shield them with that stored light.

rites.name: Silira
rites.text: Silira is a concept woven into the arcane fabric of Veneiluana during its fourth age, a shimmering veil of borrowed images that a familiar can cloak itself in after a restful night. Each dawn, the familiar gathers a handful of mirrored shadows that drift in loyal patterns near its bonded keeper, ready to absorb a blow in its stead. Those shadows vanish when struck or when the keeper rests again, leaving the familiar unscathed but changed.

rites.name: Alaimys
rites.text: Alaimys is a concept of contact-borne sorcery in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, where a practitioner's touch carries a shaped surge that can be bound to any incantation. Its essence amplifies a caster's inner steadiness into modest bursts of force, healing sparks, or weakening pressure. It rests in the E6 age as a quiet discipline rather than a cataclysmic power.

rites.name: Silaemeth
rites.text: Silaemeth is a concept of quiet ritual-binding in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where a practitioner's occult fetish stands in for vanished reagents and steadies lingering enchantments. Its mastery lets the bearer hold a sustained curse against the strain of time and interruption. The Third Age of Veneiluana remembers Silaemeth as a discipline of patience rather than force.

rites.name: Nuimeth
rites.text: Nuimeth is a concept of living silver-threaded hair that the Veneiluana arcanists of the Third Age grew into wardens of the dusk. Animated for a minute at a time, each strand writhes like a serpent to bind foes and strike with dull, pounding force.

rites.name: Lyarlae
rites.text: Lyarlae is a veiled channel of silver-threaded sanctity woven into the Arcane realm of Veneiluana during its sixth era. It is not a creature but a dormant ward that lends itself to a chosen familiar, shielding it so long as it refrains from striking, and it cracks briefly whenever the bearer's spell flows through it.

rites.name: Elemioleth
rites.text: Elemioleth is a concept within Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a presence that answers aggression with a stare so unnerving it breaks the will of anyone who meets it. Its power is psychological rather than physical, and once a foe has resisted the gaze they cannot be cowed by it again for a full day.

rites.name: Miillanys
rites.text: Miillanys is a bonded sigil-trick in Veneiluana's Arcane Era E6, letting a sworn mage trade places with their bonded spirit-familiar across a short distance. The exchange tears a sliver of force through any cramped landing point, and it may be called only once before the mage rests.

rites.name: Ryerluanae
rites.text: Ryerluanae is a borrowed-rite technique in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, letting a practitioner tuck a single familiar incantation into their own breath and loose it once without drawing on reserved mana. The Veneiluanan scholars of the third age regard it as a loan rather than a gift, since the rite replenishes only after the caster has rested.

rites.name: Lyimora
rites.text: Lyimora is a lunar tide-sorcery, a discipline of rites drawn from the phases of Veneiluana's moons, taught in covens that grow wiser with each turning age. Its practitioners call down silver light and drawn water, shaping the ocean's pull into weapons and walls. In the third age of the lineage, the rite reaches its first peak of terrible reach.

rites.name: Lyanae
rites.text: Lyanae is an arcane discipline in Veneiluana, a practice of coaxing a bonded companion to swell into a larger form for a span of hours before it shrinks back at will. Adepts who reach the highest tier can extend the swelling even to winged companions, though such a transformation drains them until they have rested fully.

rites.name: Venileth
rites.text: Venileth is a silver-threaded veil of arcane concept that drifts between the mirrored halls of Veneiluana, borrowing the shape of whatever its bearer most trusts. Those who bind it to their service find their shadows move a little slower than the rest of the world, as though the veil itself has agreed to be overlooked.

rites.name: Ilyennora
rites.text: Ilyennora is a cantrip-born discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a practice that lets a caster channel the wild instinct of the hunt into a single cutting strike. Adepts of the third age use it to add their attuned insight to every wound they inflict, and at mastery they can unleash a second, clinging curse as a quick reflex.

rites.name: Elilwen
rites.text: Elilwen is a concept of sworn radiance in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a vow-bound grace that unfolds as its bearer climbs toward mastery. Its earliest workings reveal hidden auras and shield the faithful from malice, while later ones quiet panic, dissolve curses, and open passages through space.

rites.name: Mialiel
rites.text: Mialiel is a hymn-keeping sentinel of the Veneiluana, a pale-winged guardian who repels the hollow dead and the warped things of the deep. Her song unmakes the will of creatures born of corruption, and she steadies the minds of those who stand beside her.

rites.name: Siliomwen
rites.text: Siliomwen is a silver-threaded chant of the Veneiluana, a concept-bound rite that drives back the restless dead and the things born outside natural law. Its speakers shed the disguises of mimics and shapeshifters the moment the words land, leaving their true shapes bare to the light.

rites.name: Venirlys
rites.text: Venirlys is a mind-sheltering rite of the Veneiluana arcane orders, a reflex of the will that a practitioner may spend a sacred pulse to cast off dread, enchantment, or any clouded state that a failed test of wit, insight, or presence has inflicted. Its practitioners guard their reason as a fortress, and in the fourth age of the Arcane realm its seals are said to have turned back whole legions of dreamweavers. The rite is counted among the quieter wonders of the era.

rites.name: Ilyinys
rites.text: Ilyinys is a concept of quiet anchoring: a lattice of stillness that holds wandering things in place against the folding of distance. Its bearers project a field that roots the passage of others, forcing a rift-walker to spend a turn in vain while the slot of its power remains intact. At its fullest reach it hums across thirty feet of unbroken air.

rites.name: Ilyannys
rites.text: Ilyannys is an arcane discipline of the Veneiluana, a practice of unbroken vigilance in which the practitioner's awareness can never be ambushed, and even in deep sleep or unconsciousness the watchful sense holds steady while life remains. Adepts also learn to seize an early instant of foresight, letting their readiness override a poor opening moment and step forward at the level of their sustained attention.

rites.name: Sileinnaema
rites.text: Sileinnaema is a paladin-like sovereign of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, whose gaze in the third age of the E6 era pierces every illusion and unmakes hostile enchantments. For a single minute of unbroken attention she can see the true shape of all things, shrugging off the mind-scarring cries of the void. Once spent, her clarity must rest for a full day before it can flare again.

rites.name: Nuemiolys
rites.text: Nuemiolys is a discipline of the Arcane realm in which a practitioner siphons thought, memory, and life force out of a living mind and binds the stolen essence into their own reserves. Its oldest masters are said to be the first to have learned it, and its later refiners prize the way it turns other beings' suffering into personal strength. Practitioners who push too far risk having their own minds hollowed out by what they have taken.

rites.name: Elina
rites.text: Elina is a drifting Arcane concept in Veneiluana, a discipline of hunger that teaches the mind to devour the inner sparks of others. She can draw the latent force from nearby minds and turn it into her own surges, though the stolen power never quite settles and must be fed again.

rites.name: Lyira
