rites.text: Lyira is an arcane concept from Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a practitioner of quiet mind-craft who learned to hide the flicker of their own inner workings from anyone who might be watching. Trained as a hunter of wandering minds, Lyira reads the subtle tells of others while masking every sign of their own power, lest a rival notice and turn the hunt around.

rites.name: Lyannuamiel
rites.text: Lyannuamiel is a mind-hunger concept in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a talent that lets a practitioner feed on the last flicker of thought in anything their psionic will has ended. Its devouring reaches across a wide gap, so that a death caused by one's own mental force can be drunk from thirty feet away.

rites.name: Eluarlarwen
rites.text: Eluarlarwen is an arcane concept in Veneiluana, a cognitive discipline in which a mind is drawn apart and rebuilt in the caster's own thought. Its practitioners harvest the psychic residue of every wound they inflict, storing it as crackling mental reserves that burn away with the next night's rest.

rites.name: Alaerora
rites.text: Alaerora is a veiled dreamweaver of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a concept-being who threads mental fractures into the minds of those it touches. Its gift tears open the thoughts of the unwary, and each subsequent tear leaves the victim's reasoning more exposed until a brief quiet settles over the wound.

rites.name: Alaemae
rites.text: Alaemae is a concept of the arcane realm in Veneiluana, a discipline in which a mind is tuned to the raw forces of the world. Its practitioners hear the elemental currents as a chorus of rival voices, and their greatest danger is that the chorus grows louder than their own will. Those who learn to quiet the storm within them can, over years, command the elements as fluently as a speaker commands language.

rites.name: Nuina
rites.text: Nuina is a bonded resonance of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a dormant tie to elemental current that wakes in the mind and answers to thought alone. Its wielders gather the drifting force of fire, stone and wind by pure will, shaping it into forceful, deliberate acts.

rites.name: Sileira
rites.text: Sileira is a rare ascetic of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a sculptor who shapes living storms of flame, water, and stone into blades and reaching limbs. Her art grows so fluent that the elements seem to answer her before she finishes speaking.

rites.name: Lyanwen
rites.text: Lyanwen is a concept of attuned shaping in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where a practitioner borrows the bodies of three primal elements, water, fire, and air. Those who master one element gain a narrower but cheaper version of the same gift, and each borrowing leaves the shaper spent until the body has rested.

rites.name: Ryileimora
rites.text: Ryileimora is a dormant mind-current woven through the Veneiluana's arcane strata, roused only by a practitioner who has learned to feed on another's sharpened thoughts. Its surge deepens the wellspring of inner force, letting the bearer draw one extra measure of will during the brief flare that follows such a feeding.

rites.name: Elimiel
rites.text: Elimiel is a concept of mental nourishment in Veneiluana's arcane tradition, where a mind's residual essence can be digested to feed a practitioner's inner reserves. Its bearers draw strength from the thoughts of the recently slain, so that each consumed intellect swells their capacity beyond its usual bounds.

rites.name: Lyarlerwen
rites.text: Lyarlerwen is a restorative resonance taught only to those who have mastered the ledger of enhancement. When a caster rests in the open and spends their reserve dice, the hum of their tired body spreads to nearby companions, mending wounds across a shared camp. Its scholars treat it as a gentle, communal art rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Mienniel
rites.text: Mienniel is a learned weaving of several inner disciplines into one resonant current, practiced by mentors of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's fourth age. Practitioners who have mastered every prerequisite art can braid a single new technique from the set, granting it at no extra cost.

rites.name: Ryima
rites.text: Ryima is an arcane discipline in Veneiluana that lets a practitioner drift between planes and draw the raw forces of the elemental realms into the physical world. Its adepts learn to bend those borrowed forces through thought, and to slip out of reality whenever their own violent workings threaten to consume them.

rites.name: Ilyerleth
rites.text: Ilyerleth is a concept of unified will, a single discipline in which a sorcerer blends pushing and burning into one motion, letting force bend into flame and flame bend into force at will. Its practitioners in Veneiluana's Arcane realm treat the two arts as one breath, though the craft gains nothing from the old schools' specialist habits. Its name is spoken as a single held note.

rites.name: Ilyerys
rites.text: In the eldritch realm of Arcaneane, the sentient concept Ilerys harmonizes psychic energy and telekinesis, empowering beings and manipulating forces with a ceiling of 1e+32 J.

rites.name: Venellae
rites.text: Venellae is a concept of tethered otherworldly presences drawn into thin, borrowed reality through a single lattice of light. Its summoned guests hold form only while a bound caller keeps the thread taut, and they fade when the caller rests. Each invoked being carries a fragment of its home plane's weight into the local world.

rites.name: Ryina
rites.text: Ryina is a veiled illusionist of the Veneiluana, a concept-being who can make the phantoms she weaves in others' minds solidify into real stone, flame, and chains. Her Arcane realm treats belief as matter, so each cube of an illusion she sustains can briefly harden into the world before fading at her next turn. She is considered a thousand years old by the wardens who bound her oath to the Third Age of Lanterns.

rites.name: Nuiraella
rites.text: Nuiraella is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a force that conjures a whirl of spectral blades from raw psychic intent. Its strikes can be projected as many times as it attacks, and its fling range stretches farther when it hurls the conjured blades. Enough concentrated will lets it unfurl a wall of ethereal edges across a battlefield.

rites.name: Ilyarleth
rites.text: Ilyarleth is a concept-realm talent of the Arcane sort, a mental technique that lets its practitioner slip inside rival minds and pressure them from within. Those who fear the practitioner can be made to lose sight of them entirely, and the practitioner can then reappear at the moment a frightened foe steps forward. Its lore holds that the Veneiluana cabal of the seventh age mastered this art as a means of silent warfare.

rites.name: Eleirlannae
rites.text: Eleirlannae is a living lattice of thought-glass that bloomed in the Veneiluana dreamfields two ages ago, growing wherever a mind holds an image long enough to make it real. It is said to remember every dream it has ever been asked to hold, and to weep prismatic rain when one of them turns cruel.

rites.name: Ryamira
rites.text: Ryamira is a mind-born sigil-current of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a thought that the Veiled Choirs learned to press into matter. Its bearers can speak their inner pictures into the world until those pictures hold their own weight. Its strongest acts have been known to tilt the tides of whole coastlines.

rites.name: Venina
rites.text: Venina is a concept-born power of the Arcane realm in the fourth age of Veneiluana, a summoned mind-shape that a practitioner can shape into a weapon, a conduit, or a living presence. Its strength is bounded by the imagination of whoever wields it, and its gifts can be swapped mid-manifestation.

rites.name: Venaerlae
rites.text: Venaerlae is a sustained psionic construct, a thought-shaped lattice that holds its form without requiring its wielder's ongoing focus. It persists until its maker dismisses it, though only one may be bound at a time. Its sheer presence in the arcane realm of Veneiluana marks the moment a practitioner's will becomes a lasting pillar.

rites.name: Alainae
rites.text: Alainae is a weaving-current of the Veneiluana realm's Arcane tradition, a discipline where sharpened thought is spun into projected constructs that strike with borrowed clarity. Its practitioners learn that the mind's own precision can be lent to every blow their projections land. Their projections are said to hum with the reasoning behind them.

rites.name: Oriarelys
rites.text: Oriarelys is a concept of guarded resonance in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, where a bound lattice of starlight can be summoned into the path of harm and made briefly solid. It shields its bearer by absorbing a blow in the bearer's place, though overwhelming force can still break through to the bearer.

rites.name: Ryirlaela
rites.text: Ryirlaela is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana's Sixth Era, a thought-form that unravels when the mind of a sorcerer loosens its grip and lets a host of phantom soldiers step out of imagination. The host lingers for a single moment before dissolving back into the hush of the Quiet Loom, and it may be summoned again only after the caster has rested.

rites.name: Ilyirleth
rites.text: Ilyirleth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a mind that has glimpsed the lattice tying every thought to every star and now steers that lattice like a loom. Its practitioners rarely speak of it plainly, and their neighbors in the age of Veneiluana's sixth era often mistake their stillness for madness.

rites.name: Elaelena
rites.text: Elaelena is the quiet art by which a Veneiluana mind channels its inner resolve into the flesh, lending sinew a strength that no ordinary frame could bear. Practitioners often describe it as waking a sleeping giant behind the ribs, though the body stays its own. Its masters are rare, and few have ever tested its edge.

rites.name: Alaemira
rites.text: Alaemira is the veiled concept of endurance-sealing that the Veneiluana arcanists wove into the Sixth Age to let their scholars survive the frozen spires of Tharmid and the glass deserts of Osh. It is said to be the quiet gift that lets a body outlast the sun's heat and the winter's bite alike.

rites.name: Venareth
rites.text: Venareth is a mindflow reservoir, a silver vessel of stored compassion that gathers the healing and warding a practitioner gives away and holds it briefly for release. Its keepers say the pool can hold only as much as their training allows, and what overflows is simply lost to the wind. A stored surge must be spent within a single minute or it dissipates back into the air.

rites.name: Ryiruallae
rites.text: Ryiruallae is a quiet discipline of the Veneiluana Arcane realm, in which a practitioner lends a sliver of their own resilience to an ally during a crisis. Its adepts learn to bind their proficiency into the hardening layer of a shielding thought, so that a single companion can absorb blows meant for many. The art is taught only after a practitioner has weathered enough danger to know what a borrowed margin is worth.

rites.name: Elarae
rites.text: Elarae is a shimmering lattice-tide of crystallised thought that sustains the veil between the Arcane realm's standing wards. Her quiet discipline lets a weaver steady a fraying working by lending it the sharper edge of their reasoning. In the fourth age of Veneiluana she is remembered as the keel that kept the great spells from capsizing.

rites.name: Nuilys
rites.text: Nuilys is a mental discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, practiced by the Quiet Choir during the E6 era, that lets a practitioner trade bodily resilience for a sharpened inner will. Adepts who master it can pour a small reserve of psychic force into a moment of peril and convert a failing test of the body into a test of the mind. Its gravest use, a surge that overrides the threshold between life and death, is said to bring a fading soul back from the edge.

rites.name: Ilyirelora
rites.text: Ilyirelora is a concept of unstable mind-power, an innate force that mirrors its bearer's moods onto the surrounding world. Those who wield it rarely master it fully, and their choice to restrain or unleash the force shapes whether they become a lawful disciplinarian or a chaotic storm.

rites.name: Ryinuarys
rites.text: Ryinuarys is an arcane discipline in the realm of Veneiluana, a mental art that lets adepts lay their thoughts across matter and move it as though by hand. Practitioners of the E6 era, four ages into its codified teaching, train the mind until a single focused thought can lift stone or bend steel. Its masters are said to hold whole fortresses in suspension when the need is great.

rites.name: Veniorwen
rites.text: Veniorwen is a quiet discipline of the Arcane realm in the Veneiluana omniverse, a practice of drawing small wonders out of ordinary matter through disciplined mental resonance. Its adherents lift scattered pebbles, dust, and loose cloth into slow hovering arcs, and can press back the crowds that gather around them. Its practitioners treat its minor marvels as the foundation of far greater mastery.

rites.name: Lyamora
rites.text: Lyamora is a concept of mounting fury in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a slowly gathering storm of resolve that grows with each strike landed. Its power ramps through successive rounds of sustained violence until the bearer nearly burns out, and only restraint lets it cool back to a spark.

rites.name: Elareimora
rites.text: Elareimora is a tide-wrought mindspell of the Veneiluana, a sustained force of will that seals a bearer's thoughts against coercion while their inner storm runs strong. Its adepts say the storm is the defense itself, and that stillness would invite ruin. The phenomenon persists for as long as the rising surge holds at its fiercest pitch.

rites.name: Oriineth
rites.text: Oriineth is a bound resonance-spirit of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, sworn to a single lineage of gatekeepers. When fatal harm threatens to unravel its vessel, it draws on a stored ember of ritual force to refuse collapse and remain standing at the edge of death.

rites.name: Elaeleinae
rites.text: Elaeleinae is a drifting mind who slips between the layers of Veneiluana as easily as stepping over a puddle, treating the ethereal as ordinary ground. Born or wandered into their strangeness, they wield their gifts without ceremony, curious and impossible to pin down.

rites.name: Silanniel
rites.text: Silanniel is a concept of pure spatial insight, a mind that perceives the hidden folds between dimensions and steps through them as easily as a thread through an eye of a needle. Those who train under it learn to bend their own relation to distance, slipping past walls and gaps others cannot even perceive. Its power is precise rather than brutal, measured in the quiet seams it opens.

rites.name: Alaereth
rites.text: Alaereth is a dormant arcane conduit that wakes only in the presence of a practitioner who has already mastered the art of phase-cutting. When both are joined, the conduit grants a second, fixed technique that tears open a seam in the fabric between worlds. The bond cannot be unlearned once it takes hold.

rites.name: Veneirlys
rites.text: Veneirlys is a drifting attunement of the Arcane realm in the Veneiluana omniverse, a mind-current that settles briefly into unfamiliar skills and lends them a borrowed sharpness each time a long calm passes. Its wandering is said to have once reshaped the minds of an entire fleet of scholars, though its own ascent to the threshold of planetary-scale influence remains only partially charted.

rites.name: Eliriel
rites.text: Eliriel is a veil-weaver of the Veneiluana arcane courts, who stitches flickering doubles from fading starlight to confuse her foes. Within the Arcane realm of the fourth age, she is known for slipping through the seams between moments and striking while her enemies grasp at shadows.

rites.name: Mienwen
rites.text: Mienwen is a lingering reservoir of unspent mental discipline in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a concept that lets a practitioner hold stored will for a single heartbeat past its expiry. Those who learn to shape it can reroll the threads of sudden displacement and keep whichever outcome suits them best.

rites.name: Alainwen
rites.text: Alainwen is an arcane concept in the Veneiluana omniverse, a method of folding distance so thoroughly that a practitioner slips between realms as easily as stepping across a room. Its adepts can carry themselves and others through planar seams once each day without drawing on their reserves, though returning to the ability demands rest or a deeper expenditure of inner force.

rites.name: Sileirlora
rites.text: Sileirlora is a silver-threaded concept of the Arcane realm in the Veneiluana omniverse, a discipline of bent distance that lets a practitioner's rift wander along curved and looping paths. Its scholars hold that the rift may touch each living presence only once, lest the weave tear itself apart.

rites.name: Eliranna
rites.text: Eliranna is a lantern-tongued seer of the Veneiluana cloister, whose eyes gather the faintest glimmers of the unseen into a soft silver radiance. In her presence the shadows of the deep vaults grow legible, though they surrender all hue to her sight. The cloister's archivists count her gift among their quietest and most consequential treasures.

rites.name: Oriannualys
rites.text: Oriannualys is a concept of sustained undeath, a condition in which the body is kept upright by a cold, patient animating current rather than by breath, food, or living blood. Those who carry it feel no hunger, thirst, or contagion, and no toxin can unsettle their flesh. It is studied in Veneiluana's arcane colleges as a model of endurance.

rites.name: Eleneth
rites.text: Eleneth is a concept of woven arcane vitality in Veneiluana, a sorcerous lattice where mending flows from one caster to another like dew drawn upward. Its threads can be rekindled by spare magical reserves, and a fallen soul can be drawn back through the same weaving. It is most famous for turning the spent strength of any spellcaster into renewed flesh.

rites.name: Silemae
rites.text: Silemae is a concept of bodily self-reconstitution in the arcane realm of Veneiluana, where a person's flesh holds a latent memory of its wholeness. A severed limb, kept close, can be grafted back during a brief rest by surrendering a measure of one's vital reserve. Even scattered remains can be gathered and reassembled for restorative rites.

rites.name: Orianwen
rites.text: Orianwen is a silver-threaded ward-principle of the Veneiluana, a hollow bell of starlight that the realm's wardens ring to steady the restless dead. Her song unmakes the grave-fetters of wandering spirits and can lift a hillside's worth of cursed stone from its foundations. She is kept in the high reliquary of Ashmere, where she has slept since the third age.

rites.name: Nuamwen
rites.text: Nuamwen is a living current of arcane will that drifts through the ley-veins of Veneiluana, sustaining wards and kindling dormant sigils wherever it passes. Its presence can be smothered by null-fields, leaving it stammering, dim, and vulnerable to the very dispelling it once commanded.

rites.name: Ryinnora
rites.text: Ryinnora is a restorative resonance woven into the Arcane realm of Veneiluana during its sixth era, a quiet hum that lets things mend faster and turns up forgotten spare parts in the drawers of the world. Its bearers grow more potent as their mastery deepens, recovering additional vitality each time they rest fully.

rites.name: Eliorleth
rites.text: Eliorleth is a silver-threaded resonance concept in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a discipline of listening to the hum of wards until they falter. Its practitioners are immune to the drowsing spells of the old courts, yet they carry a brittle sensitivity to anything that severs the flow of mana around them.

rites.name: Venimuarora
rites.text: Venimuarora is a sustained arcane ward woven into the marrow of a bone-scribed lineage across the Veneiluana, granting resilience that deepens with each passage of seasons. Its wielders gain a steady pulse of vitality that accumulates as their experience grows. The ward is said to have held a sinking bridge of the old kingdoms together for a full century.

rites.name: Venimora
rites.text: Venimora is a handless beast-spirit of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, born three ages ago from a rift where mage-gloves were burned away. It hunts by fang and claw, grappling prey with its jaws and pinning foes beneath silver-tipped talons that cut through wards.

rites.name: Sileimiorla
rites.text: Sileimiorla is a tallow-pale ritual skeleton bound to the spires of Veneiluana, where its hollow frame and hooked finger-bones let it scale sheer glass walls. Its climb is quick and silent, and it can drive its talons into any surface the way a wyrm tunnels stone.

rites.name: Alaeraemeth
rites.text: Alaeraemeth is a lattice of sunken glass-ribs that hums with a residual luminous warding, left behind in the drowned archives of Veneiluana's third age. Its surface shrugs off the hollow-calling sigils that animate the restless dead, and it turns aside searing light as though the glow were only water.

rites.name: Venamys
rites.text: Venamys is a shifting resonance woven into the arcane lattice of Veneiluana, letting a bearer slip through the spaces of larger beings as though they were a size smaller, though they can never rest within such a space unless already allowed. Its practitioners in the sixth era treat it as a courtesy of passage rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Eluareiniel
rites.text: Eluareiniel is a bound concept of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a sigil-woven conviction that was stitched into being in the sixth era and has existed for only three ages. It flickers across the minds of scribes who study the forgotten tongues of the dead, granting them fragments of meaning drawn from whatever remains they touch.

rites.name: Oriemeth
rites.text: Oriemeth is a thread of hungry necrotic force that woke into a sliver of self-awareness three ages ago, and now it wrestles with an instinct to unmake living things. It has learned to hold that instinct like a blade it can sheathe or unsheathe at will.

rites.name: Sileilineth
rites.text: Sileilineth is a concept of hushed ink-bound wardens in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, drawn from the sixth era's quiet orders. Its first age was marked by its bindings to the scriptorium vaults and the speech of older tomes.

rites.name: Elarlionna
rites.text: Elarlionna is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, an entity whose mind can slip its anchor and drift as a vapor-thin wanderer while its flesh lies still and vulnerable. The drift returns it to its mortal shell when the stillness ends, and it may only sever itself again after a full season of rest.

rites.name: Elerioleth
rites.text: Elerioleth is a luminous lattice of crystallized dusk, a concept-entity in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana that hums with the hush before a storm. Its cadence is a quiet thread of old song, and it hangs between the spaces where memory and shadow meet. It is said to know the speech of thorn-bells and wind-tongued forests.

rites.name: Lyama
rites.text: Lyama is a restless fey spirit that wakes within heaps of forgotten bones, often without memory of its name or purpose. Its borrowed skeleton shifts in and out of gleaming, moonlit forms as it wanders the Arcane margins of Veneiluana.

rites.name: Silualeth
rites.text: Silualeth is a veil-woven current of arcane tongue that hums through the ruined vaults of Veneiluana, sung into being by the old choirs of E6. It is a concept more than a body, a pattern of meaning that teaches itself to whoever listens long enough to its cadence. Scholars say it remembers every name ever spoken in its presence.

rites.name: Silemora
rites.text: Silemora is a concept of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a being whose inner ember can erupt into a blazing skeletal form for a short while. While alight, the flame scorches anything that lingers close and bolsters every blow it lands with searing force.

rites.name: Ryenneth
rites.text: Ryenneth is a concept in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, an animating force that takes the form of living vines threading through a dead body. Its bindings can crush whole formations of enemies and hold them fast without any free hands.

rites.name: Lyaniel
rites.text: Lyaniel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, a principle of self-reassembly that lets a bound corpse trade limbs and sinew for stronger ones. Its archive records that the third age of its order was ended by a single act of rebuilding a sealed vault from the inside out.

rites.name: Veneilleth
rites.text: Veneilleth is a concept of a second awakening, a mastery that a risen being earns by drawing on a foreign wellspring of power until it becomes second nature. Those who achieve it grow sharper of mind and presence, and their undeath takes on new and borrowed capacities.

rites.name: Mianiel
rites.text: Mianiel is a concept in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, an undead who has learned to tether their essence to a relic that keeps them returning after death. Their remains turn so hostile to living flesh that a single touch can seize a foe's muscles for a time. Such returns are rare and carry a steep cost in stored spirit.

rites.name: Ryelora
rites.text: Ryelora is a Veneiluana arcane concept, a technique by which an awakened corpse-caster learns to sever their own limbs and command them as thinking, crawling familiars. Practitioners in the third age of the E6 era wear their detached hands like brooches, and a body may survive the loss of its head while its scattered parts keep watch.

rites.name: Nuameineth
rites.text: Nuameineth is a quiet art of the Veneiluana arcane tradition, in which a practitioner folds stolen moments of surprise into a shining, sun-colored burst that can be aimed at a single target. It is taught only to those who have proven they can strike without warning. Its radiance is said to be the hidden light that lies in every ambush.

rites.name: Ryaneth
rites.text: Ryaneth is a concept of sacred ink-binding in Veneiluana, an Arcane-realm power born in the sixth era two years ago. Its practitioners bind consecrated water to fine scripture-threads, letting a single drop hurl a blessing across great distances. Scholars debate whether its doctrine is a faith or a mathematics.

rites.name: Nuerualae
rites.text: Nuerualae is a sealed resonance-lantern from the Veneiluana archive, a concept-kind artifact of the Arcane realm in its third age of E6. Its quiet glow lets its bearer draw on borrowed warding light, shielding and steadying those nearby without spending stored reserves, and it refills with the ebb of rest.

rites.name: Alaarlys
rites.text: Alaarlys is a concept of attuned sight that a veneiluanan seer may grow into after mastering the ninth of the Lantern Rites. Once a creature has been marked by light, the seer perceives its hidden workings clearly, even through the thickest veils of shadow. Its quiet revelations can unmake the very darkness that once concealed a truth.

rites.name: Veniorys
rites.text: Veniorys is a dawn-forged lantern-discipline of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, kindled by monks who burn sickness and hex from their own bodies with a sacred ember. Its practitioners take the scorching cost willingly, trading flesh-heat for renewed vitality, and rest only when the ember cools.

rites.name: Eluannys
rites.text: Eluannys is a concept of crafted contrivances in Veneiluana, where clockwork engineering is fused with arcane resonance so that each device channels a mind's sharpened reasoning into controlled effects. Its gadgets are built to answer a wielder's intellect rather than raw force, and their reach depends on how precisely their makers understood the tuning. Practitioners treat the discipline as a craft of measured calculation rather than brute power.

rites.name: Alaaruannae
rites.text: Alaaruannae is a Veneiluana concept of arcane tutelage, a mantle that is passed between hands rather than born into. Those who bear it learn to coax craft from stubborn matter, and the older teachers say it can quietly reshape the tools a person already trusts. Its name is kept in a ledger rather than spoken aloud, as is the custom for mantles of this age.

rites.name: Eleruamwen
rites.text: Eleruamwen is a field-engineer of the Arcane realm's fourth age who carries a satchel of volatile devices, trading the quiet of stealth for raw detonative force. Its gadgets can blanket a battlefield in smoke, scatter blasts across a crowd, or lodge a charge that splits walls and masonry from within.

rites.name: Venuamiel
rites.text: Venuamiel is a concept of arcane saboteur-craft in the Veneiluana omniverse, a practice of hurling volatile glyph-charges at a chosen point so that nearby foes are caught by the blast. Its adepts strike from concealment, and a foe that cannot see them is caught more easily by the burst.

rites.name: Silena
rites.text: Silena is an arcane concept in the Veneiluana omniverse, a mark-and-burst technique that lets a practitioner seal a volatile sigil onto any nearby surface. The sigil waits a single heartbeat before unmaking its host and scorching nearby bodies with lesser force. Its power scales with the precision of the strike that follows.

rites.name: Oriarlenys
rites.text: Oriarlenys is a suite of arcane tinkering devices that Veneiluana's artificers fold into cloaks, limbs, and lenses for everyday adventurers. Its modest craftsmanship keeps its feats small, measured against the mundane scale of street-level hazards and workshop accidents.

rites.name: Elaeluarys
rites.text: Elaeluarys is a veil-dancer's art from the arcane powers of Veneiluana, granting a practitioner who slips free of a sweeping blast the instinct to glide clear of its edge at once. Its wielders say the dancer leaves the storm behind before the storm can notice.

rites.name: Miiniel
rites.text: Miiniel is a wandering tinkering discipline of the Veneiluana arcane courts, a craft that grows wider as its practitioners master more contrivances. At its highest reach the practitioner's hidden detonations bloom across a broader ring of ground, and they may fold one further trick of invention into their working kit.

rites.name: Elerluameth
rites.text: Elerluameth is a concept of arcane engineering in Veneiluana, a bundled mechanism of brass and resonant crystal that its maker can assemble within a single minute to hold any lesser charm of the intermediate arcane canon. Each assembly is broken down to make the next, so the craft's supply is limited by the maker's mental reach and must be replenished through rest.

rites.name: Veneirys
rites.text: Veneirys is a crystalline aether heart that grows inside a caster's chest, drinking ambient power until it can steady a spell's pulse. It shrugs off raw kinetic force and can be carried as a focus for channeling magic. Its most notable trait is that the bearer's spells swell in strength without extra effort once the heart matures.

rites.name: Alailwen
rites.text: Alailwen is the inner fire of a sorcerer-bard named Veneth, a power that stirs when her heart is moved and that she can pour into the weave of her spells. In the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, these wielders are called heartspinners, and their force is measured by the warmth of their presence rather than by sheer study. The fire answers only to those who have grown beyond the apprentice's first years.

rites.name: Miileirys
rites.text: Miileirys is a veil-weaver of the Veneiluana arcane circles, a practitioner who turns the shattering of enchantments into personal renewal. Her wards drink the force of every blow and return half its sting as restored vigor. In the third age of the E6 era she became known for unmaking the great seals that bound the storm-tombs of the western marsh.

rites.name: Elennualora
rites.text: Elennualora is a concept of renewed arcane wellspring, a surge of stored sorcery that a caster may draw upon in a single breath of focus. Each draw spends a measure of bodily endurance and restores the caster's reserve of spellcraft, but the surge can be called only once before the caster has rested fully. Scholars of Veneiluana regard it as a loan from a deeper tide that refills slowly across the era.

rites.name: Silamirlys
rites.text: Silamirlys is a concept within the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, an unbound lattice of glimmering tide-song that teaches its adepts new arts whenever they study deep and obscured lore. Its essence drifts through the era like dark sediment, granting practitioners a wider selection of ways to bend fog, sense the unseen, and slip through solid barriers.

rites.name: Alainelys
rites.text: Alainelys is a veiled drift of shadow-sense, a concept that lets a wayfarer slip through darkness in brief, silent surges. Those who learn it grow quicker while cloaked in night, and quicker still when unseen beneath dark water. Its power is modest, meant for scouts and thieves rather than cataclysm.

rites.name: Orialys
rites.text: Orialys is a tidal sorcery in Veneiluana's drowned archipelagos, where practitioners draw force from the ebb of night-dark seas. Its adepts can leap across shorelines and shadowed chasms with strides that carry them far beyond ordinary reach. The discipline is prized more for its mobility than for any destructive power.

rites.name: Elaemeth
rites.text: Elaemeth is a shadow-weaving concept in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, an unstable mantle of dusk that clings to those who step free of lightless places. Its wearers slip out of sight for a brief moment, dissolving the moment they strike, cast, or compel another to resist. The Veneiluanan scholars of the Third Age regarded it as a fragile gift that rewards restraint.

rites.name: Silerualora
rites.text: Silerualora is a veil-thief of the Arcane realm, an entity that siphons the ambient wills of rivals into its own sinew after every clash of blades. For a single turn after each strike it draws off a sliver of an opponent's resolve, dulling their aim while sharpening its own. It can only drink this way again once it has rested from the struggle.

rites.name: Ilyareth
rites.text: Ilyareth is a shadow-weaving art that draws the dark around its wielder like a living cloak, letting them slip between pockets of gloom and seize foes with coiling black tendrils. Its practitioners are feared in the lamplit cities of Veneiluana, where bright light is the only reliable ward against them.

rites.name: Miannae
rites.text: Miannae is a veil of arcane dusk that hardens the shadows around a caster into a glassy, still surface resembling dark water. Within it, the caster may slip beneath the gloom and travel unseen, until a light of equal or greater power breaks the surface and forces them back into the open.

rites.name: Ryerleth
rites.text: Ryerleth is a concept of Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a lingering tide of shadowed brine that bends attention toward the one who strikes from concealment. Those who have bound themselves to its current gain a sharpened aim after a long, silent bound through the gloom. Its power is modest compared to the great forces of the era, yet it is prized by hunters who work in the dark.

rites.name: Ryelaenae
rites.text: Ryelaenae is a leaping technique of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, born in the third age of the sixth era from patrons who whisper from drowned depths. When a chosen quarry bears a sigil of pursuit, the practitioner can bound toward it across their full stride, slipping past every reprisal strike that would normally greet a flight.

rites.name: Ryinaela
rites.text: Ryinaela is a tidal-hymn of the Veneiluana sea-courts, sung by bonded wardens who can swim as swiftly as they run and vault from the waves as though standing on stone. Where water gathers around her, the harsh glare of noon softens into a dusky twilight that her kin prize for its calm. Her song is said to remember every shoreline it has ever touched.

rites.name: Silenys
rites.text: Silenys is a hushed, gravity-bending witchfire of Veneiluana's E6 arcane realm, whose wielders loose lances of dark force that can be split and detonated outward at close range. Its practitioners learn to bleed a portion of each lance's power into a ringing shockwave that hurls nearby foes away. Such a ringing shockwave may also be turned to shove any who fail to resist it.

rites.name: Alairlae
rites.text: Alairlae is a veil of stillness that the Veneiluana's shadow-wardens weave around the unseen, letting a bearer slip beyond notice whenever a stored spell is spent. Its fading is a practised art rather than raw power, and its wielders are prized more for patience than for force.

rites.name: Ilyirlae
rites.text: Ilyirlae is a tempest-shaped arcane presence in Veneiluana, an ever-gathering storm that answers the casting of spells by coiling tighter around its bearer. Its winds can lift the wielder into the air and its crackling discharge punishes anyone who lingers too close.

rites.name: Miirlennys
rites.text: Miirlennys is a storm-keeping concept in the Veneiluana cosmos, a discipline in which a practitioner binds a rising tempest to their own will and then looses its lightning upon the world. Its adepts treat a growing storm as an instrument, able to remain under the sky's fury even within walls when the storm's strength has deepened. The old binding-cores of this art can hold a storm's charge steady while the caster is occupied with other work.

rites.name: Orienaemae
rites.text: Orienaemae is a dormant arcane conduit in Veneiluana's Arcane realm, a thin filament of crystallized storm-glass that hums when a practitioner draws on it. In its fourth age, it channels bolts of voltaic thunder that split stone and rattle the ley-lines of the region.

rites.name: Ryirlys
rites.text: Ryirlys is a concept of attuned listening: a sensitivity to the drifting breath of the air that lets its bearer read coming storms and eavesdrop through the sounds carried on currents. It is a keen, passive perception rather than a weapon, and it leaves the air itself to tell its secrets.

rites.name: Ryena
rites.text: Ryena is a concept of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, an era six relic of age three that gathers and loosens a sustained tempest of power. Those within its reach can drift softly on sudden currents of light, and the storm can be quickened or let go at will.

rites.name: Silioriel
rites.text: Silioriel is a rune-woven veil of tempest-glass that the cloudwardens of Veneiluana drape over their shoulders during the age of ash-storms. It drinks the thunder of the sky and turns its wrath into a quiet, luminous blessing for the wearer.

rites.name: Venuarlora
rites.text: Venuarlora is a soul-bound lens of the Veneiluana arcane tradition, ground from a sky-glass that once hung above the drowned archipelago of Ilerith. Its bearer may coax storms into deeper form without drawing on reserved mana, though every shift only ever deepens what is already gathering.

rites.name: Venarlirae
rites.text: Venarlirae is a concept of silver-threaded lattice-warding that the seers of Veneiluana weave around their own thoughts, bending the crowd of illusions into harmless shapes. It is said to have been born in the third age, when the drifting towers of the upper marshes first needed to be hidden from storm-minds. Its wielders are scholars who treat every ward as a poem to be revised.

rites.name: Ryareth
rites.text: Ryareth is a sigil-woven veil-thread stitched through the dreams of Veneiluana's oldest mages, a concept that lets a wielder cloak a companion in unseen light for a brief span. It dissolves the moment the cloaked one strikes, presses force upon another, or wakes a challenge of will.

rites.name: Nuellaerys
rites.text: Nuellaerys is a silent weaving of arcane will that bends the threads of other people's spells mid-cast. Its practitioners nudge bolts off course and reshape the edges of enchantments, turning a single hand's flicker into the difference between victory and ruin. Within Veneiluana's Arcane realm, it is prized less for raw force than for the quiet authority to decide who a spell will touch.

rites.name: Ryirys
rites.text: Ryirys is a sung refrain of the Arcane realm's third age, used by bards to steady a companion's working mid-incantation. When an ally begins a rite, the singer may spend a stored sign of rank to nudge the spell's force up or down by a measured margin.

rites.name: Nuerora
rites.text: Nuerora is a mind-tuned ward in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, a lattice of shimmering thought-threads that a bearer can fray into false images to draw a blow aside. Its strength scales with the spent resonance, and its energy is best described as a deflected flicker rather than a true release.

rites.name: Eleinae
rites.text: Eleinae is a veil-weaving discipline practiced in the floating archives of Veneiluana, where a caster may redirect an incoming enchantment toward her own body whenever it threatens a companion nearby. Her shield draws the full force of area sorceries onto a single point of her own flesh and bone. Mastery lets her absorb entire storms of arcane fire without the nearby ally feeling so much as a warm breeze.

rites.name: Elilys
rites.text: Elilys is a concept of misdirected intent, a quiet current that catches arrows and bolts after they have failed and steers them toward a new mark. In the arcane realm of Veneiluana, it is taught in the third age as a discipline of composure, where each redirection spends a measure of borrowed resolve.

rites.name: Silamaennae
rites.text: Silamaennae is a vein of resonant glass-light running beneath the old cathedral-cities of Veneiluana, where choirs of magistrates tune their wills to the hum of the sky. Its adepts can, at the moment a companion's working blooms outward, lean on that bloom and carve a hollow into it or press a nearby soul into its reach, each shift costing a measure of stored command. Those who master the art are said to sculpt entire storms of sorcery with a single whispered correction.

rites.name: Alaireimora
rites.text: Alaireimora is a veil-weaver of the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, who shrouds her companions in woven glamours and wards drawn from the shimmering threads of the Third Age. Her protections are modest but precise, turning blows aside and making allies slip unseen from danger. She commands only a few such workings, yet they are enough to keep a whole band alive.

rites.name: Nuerliomys
rites.text: Nuerliomys is a concept of veiled sorcery in the realm of Veneiluana, where the Vestment of Shared Weaving lets a practitioner bend any incantation once reserved for kin spells. Bending a rival's working costs an extra measure of commanding will, the Leadership Die, paid in full before the thread holds.

rites.name: Elimeinwen
rites.text: Elimeinwen is an arcane concept in the realm of Veneiluana, a discipline of shadow-weaving that splits a companion's silhouette into a drifting twin. Its mirrored echoes persist through the turn and can be bound to endure until they are struck down or the next dawn of battle.

rites.name: Ilyimiel
rites.text: Ilyimiel is a concept in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, an ancient sealing-art that teaches its adepts to lend their wards to comrades in battle. Practitioners inscribe three protective glyphs of the third circle or lower, channeled through dice of command rather than personal reserves. Once mastered, a self-centered ward may be redirected to any companion standing within thirty paces.

rites.name: Oriamaerwen
rites.text: Oriamaerwen is a rare arcane art in Veneiluana's sixth era, a mirrored resonance that lets a practitioner bind nearby allies into shared reflections of their strength. The art was recorded only two ages ago, and scholars still argue over whether it amplifies or merely echoes the powers it touches.

rites.name: Silinys
rites.text: Silinys is a psionic gift in the arcane realm of Veneiluana, granted to those who awaken their inner potential in the fourth age. Its bearers may choose to amplify the strength of body and spirit, glimpse threads of coming events, or read the thoughts that drift between minds.

rites.name: Eluaniel
rites.text: Eluaniel is a veiled discipline of the Arcane realm, a practice that draws dormant resolve from the soul and kindles it in allies and in the self. Its practitioners are said to bend the will of others as easily as their own limbs, sustaining the effort through long campaigns in Veneiluana's fourth age.

rites.name: Venuanemae
rites.text: Venuanemae is a seer-discipline of the Arcane realm, practiced in the fourth age of Veneiluana by those who learn to read the faint tremors of coming events. Its adepts are said to glimpse brief tableaux of what has not yet occurred, and to nudge the present toward or away from those visions. The discipline is taught in quiet observatories where students train their senses against the hum of the unrealized.

rites.name: Elamora
rites.text: Elamora is a psionic-vocal art of the Veneiluana quiet-courts, taught to scholars who learn to hear the hum beneath thought. Practitioners sense the emotional weather of nearby minds and can thread short wordless messages between them. Its masters are prized as mediators, though their skill is feared in councils where secrets are currency.

rites.name: Ryerla
rites.text: Ryerla is a psionic adept of Veneiluana's arcane orders, whose gift of mind matured in the third age into a full command of enhancement, foresight, and thought-touch. Her power is measured in the will of the mind rather than raw force, and she can channel the latent dice of leadership as psychic reserves.

rites.name: Venualae
rites.text: Venualae is a dormant lattice of resonant crystal that hums beneath the Veneiluana seas, storing the thought-patterns of drowned oracles. When its song is answered, the lattice briefly becomes a second sun in the mind of any listener.

rites.name: Venilora
rites.text: Venilora is a concept-born arcane discipline in the Veneiluana omniverse, a mind-harmony that flows between a leader's gift and talent so each sharpens the other. In the fourth age of the sixth era, its practitioners weave borrowed resolve into fleeting marks that answer their will.

rites.name: Veneimys
rites.text: Veneimys is a psionic bond-weaver of the Veneiluana, a presence that threads itself through a battlefield so that allies' fates become its own. It steadies failing wills and turns misfortune aside, though it can only do so once before rest is needed. Its power to shield others from catastrophe is measured in the energy of world-scale collapses.

rites.name: Veniolleth
rites.text: Veniolleth is a concept of resonance-bound mentorship in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, where a commander's aura is tuned to the rhythm of a disciplined mind. When its presence and its focus fall into step, a single strike can be doubled through a shared thought-pattern, and the first pulse of borrowed will swells to three times its usual strength.

rites.name: Siluanwen
rites.text: Siluanwen is a healing-discipline of the Arcane realm in Veneiluana, practiced by scholars who read the threads of sickness the way others read stars. Its adepts can trace a wasting curse back to its origin and loosen it with a single measured word.

rites.name: Elimuanneth
rites.text: Elimuanneth is a lingering veil of silver thread that the weavers of Veneiluana draw across the minds of those who fail to resist a sorcerer's working. Each strand it leaves behind carries a dull, creeping unease that clings long after the spell itself has faded. A weaver may leave only as many such threads as her skill allows, and they return with rest.

rites.name: Nuirlaneth
rites.text: Nuirlaneth is an arcane concept in Veneiluana's sixth era, a practitioner-scholar who has studied sickness so long that illness barely finds a foothold in them. Once a malady has been survived or diagnosed, Nuirlaneth can brew a batch of countering draught within a working day, enough to steady up to five others against it.

rites.name: Miirae
rites.text: In the fractal realm of Luminarya, the entity Miirae, a kaleidoscopic prism, harnesses the power of refraction to manipulate light and reality.

rites.name: Oriinnys
rites.text: Oriinnys is a lingering principle of the Veil that lets its bearer coax the invisible threads of pestilence into a coordinated wave. By expending a fragment of magical reserve, the user can cause a sickness already present in a host to leap outward, infecting any creature caught within a radius that expands with the power spent. Those who survive the sudden onslaught gain a latent immunity that shields them from later, larger outbreaks of the same malady.

rites.name: Lyeleth
rites.text: Lyeleth, the Whispering Pestilence, a spectral entity from the Veneiluana's Arcane realm, infuses targets with a malevolent essence causing random, debilitating symptoms.

rites.name: Silamwen
rites.text: Silamwen is a withering rot woven from stolen void-hunger, carried in grey spores that cling to skin and bone. Its victims waste away one stage at a time, and a dying carrier can release a cloud that spreads the decay to anyone nearby. It is feared in the sunken archives of Veneiluana as a plague that feeds on the healing arts themselves.

rites.name: Lyeleth
rites.text: Lyeleth is a consumptive plague-curse woven in the Arcane realm of Veneiluana, spreading through the veins of its victims in escalating stages of withering. Its sorcerers treat it as a measure of how far a living body can be pushed before it turns against itself.
